jobs.title: Sales Operations Manager
jobs.excerpt: About Rhapsody: Healthcare is innovating fast and AI is accelerating the pace.
jobs.description:
About Rhapsody:

Healthcare is innovating fast and AI is accelerating the pace. But AI is only as good as the data it can securely access. Today, moving data between providers, payers, and digital health innovators is still harder than it should be, and inconsistent data quality creates risk, rework, and stalled initiatives.

Our mission is to accelerate innovation by reducing the burden of data access and data quality so teams can build, deploy, and scale solutions with confidence. Rhapsody provides behind-the-scenes interoperability and data quality foundation that helps information move reliably between systems, across formats, and at the speed modern healthcare demands.

Most people won’t ever see our products during a medical visit (that’s infrastructure). Think of Rhapsody as the connective tissue and increasingly, the “data readiness” layer that enables digital transformation, analytics, and AI initiatives by making data accessible, trustworthy, and actionable.

If you want to help solve one of healthcare’s hardest problems, turning fragmented data into safe, usable information—apply at rhapsody.health.

About the Role:

We are looking for a hands-on, people-oriented Sales Operations Manager to work side-by-side with our sales leaders and reps. This is not a systems or analytics-heavy role — we have those covered. What we need is someone who thrives on making sales teams more effective: cleaning up the pipeline, building and improving processes, creating training and documentation, and being a trusted operational partner to sales leadership day-to-day.

At Rhapsody, we are an AI-first company, meaning we actively use and embrace artificial intelligence to enhance how we work, collaborate, and deliver. We expect our team members to be open to adopting AI tools in their roles, continuously exploring ways to work smarter, improve efficiency, and drive innovation while maintaining high standards of quality, security, and ethical responsibility.

Key Responsibilities:

Sales Leadership Partnership

  • Act as a dedicated operational partner to sales managers and leaders — joining pipeline reviews, forecast calls, and team meetings to understand where the team is struggling and help solve it
  • Help sales leaders identify patterns in their pipeline and team behavior that indicate process gaps or coaching opportunities
  • Support onboarding of new sales hires by facilitating process walkthroughs and ensuring they ramp quickly on how we sell
  • Serve as a sounding board and thought partner for sales leaders as they make decisions about territory, coverage, and team structure

Pipeline Hygiene & Inspection

  • Own and enforce pipeline hygiene standards — ensuring opportunities are accurately staged, properly documented, and consistently maintained in the CRM
  • Run regular pipeline reviews and audits; proactively flag stale deals, data gaps, and forecast risks to sales leadership
  • Work directly with reps to coach CRM discipline and reinforce best practices around deal documentation and stage progression
  • Partner with our data analyst on light reporting needs — pulling pipeline snapshots, deal aging reports, and coverage analysis to support weekly and monthly reviews

Process Documentation & Improvement

  • Document existing sales processes end-to-end, from prospecting through close, creating a clear and accessible playbook for the team
  • Identify process gaps and inconsistencies; lead cross-functional working sessions to align on improvements and get buy-in from stakeholders
  • Translate complex processes into simple, practical guides and training materials that reps actually use
  • Own the ongoing maintenance of process documentation — keeping it current as the business evolves

Training & Enablement

  • Design and deliver process-focused training sessions for new and existing sales reps — covering selling methodology, CRM usage, and deal management expectations
  • Build a culture of operational excellence by reinforcing process standards in a way that is collaborative, not policing
  • Coordinate with sales managers to identify knowledge gaps and build targeted enablement to close them
  • Develop quick-reference tools (cheat sheets, job aids, templates) that help reps execute the right behaviors in the flow of their day

AI:

  • Transforms workflows to be AI-first by connecting tools, building scalable automations, and standardizing best practices across teams to drive efficiency and consistency.
  • Leads AI adoption by coaching others, identifying high-impact use cases, and balancing experimentation with governance and quality standards.

Qualifications

Required

  • 3–6 years of experience in Sales Operations, Sales Enablement, or a similar role working directly with sales teams
  • Demonstrated ability to build trusting relationships with salespeople and sales leaders — you know how to earn credibility on the floor
  • Strong process documentation skills — able to take a messy, undocumented process and turn it into something clear, practical, and scalable
  • Experience managing pipeline hygiene and running pipeline review processes in a CRM environment (Salesforce preferred)
  • Comfortable facilitating training sessions and coaching reps on process and tool adoption
  • Highly organized with strong attention to detail; able to manage multiple projects without dropping the ball
  • Excellent written and verbal communication — you can explain complex processes simply and get people on board

Preferred

  • Experience at a B2B SaaS or technology company
  • Background in sales enablement, sales training, or sales coaching
  • Familiarity with sales methodologies (e.g., MEDDIC, SPIN, Challenger, Command of the Message)
  • Exposure to working alongside a dedicated RevOps, CRM admin, or data/analytics function

The expected pay range for this position is $120,000 – $150,000 USD annually, representing the anticipated base salary range for a full-time, exempt hire. Actual compensation will vary based on factors such as experience, skills, and work location.

This role is also eligible for a discretionary annual bonus based on company and individual performance, as well as participation in Rhapsody’s comprehensive benefits program, which includes health coverage, retirement savings, paid time off and other programs that support your overall well-being.

What we have to offer you:

  • Comprehensive benefits package on day 1 (medical, dental, vision, life, disability)

  • An innovative, inclusive, and fun work environment

jobs.description:
At Counterpart Health, we are transforming healthcare and improving patient care with our innovative primary care tool, Counterpart Assistant. By supporting Primary Care Physicians (PCPs), we are able to deliver improved outcomes to our patients at a lower cost through early diagnosis and longitudinal care management of chronic conditions. We value diversity — in backgrounds and in experiences. Healthcare is a universal concern, and we need people from all backgrounds and swaths of life to help build the future of healthcare. Clover's engineering team is empathetic, caring, and supportive.

We are looking for a Software Developer, Engineering Productivity with expertise in backend infrastructure, platform engineering, and SDLC observability to join our globally distributed engineering team. You won't just write code to spec — you'll understand the business problem, engage with stakeholders, and shape the solution. In this role, your customers are our own engineers: you will act as a high-leverage technical bridge between Quality and Eng Core, building the automated safety nets and engineering telemetry required to increase deployment velocity while driving code-related incidents to zero.

Our engineering team is spread across time zones, and this role works closely with colleagues in Hong Kong. In practice that means regular early-morning or evening calls — we keep the load shared fairly, but comfort with that rhythm matters for this role.

As a Software Developer, Engineering Productivity, you will:

  • Design and champion internal Quality Programmes: Drive engineering-wide process changes and ensure pods adopt new reliability standards without friction. You will operate with a product-owner mindset to define and evangelize the internal reliability roadmap.
  • Build SDLC observability pipelines: Harness the APIs across our existing stack (GitHub, Linear, GCP, Sentry, Grafana, incident.io) to collect, aggregate, and visualize engineering and quality telemetry — delivering self-service dashboards that give Engineering Managers and pod leads clear visibility into delivery efficiency and SDLC bottlenecks.
  • Define and enforce hard metrics: Establish and automate reporting for the Key Quality Indicators that objectively describe deployment health — Change Failure Rate, Deployment Frequency, Lead Time for Changes, Time to Restore, Regression Rate, Release Failure Rate, PR-failure rate, and code review depth — creating a quantifiable baseline for platform reliability.
  • Architect Shift-Left Pipeline Gates: Weave automated Performance, Security, and Accessibility checks directly into the CI/CD pipeline at the PR level in tight partnership with Eng Core.
  • Build Real-World Load Testing: Shift load and performance testing left for every customer onboarding, validating real-world assumptions using tools such as k6, Locust, Gatling, or JMeter.
  • Engineer Synthetic Data & Production Canaries: Build the architecture for safe synthetic data injection to unblock heavy load-testing and live-production canaries, strictly isolating test data from authentic user telemetry.

jobs.description:
Grafana Labs, the company behind the open observability cloud, is founded on the principles of open source, open standards, open ecosystems, and open culture. Grafana Cloud, our fully managed observability platform, is flexible and built for scale. With Grafana Cloud's actually useful AI, organizations can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data to move at the speed of their ambitions. Today, more than 35 million users and 7,000+ customers – including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce – trust Grafana Labs to ensure reliability of their applications and systems, resolve incidents quickly, and optimize their telemetry to reduce noise and cost. We are a 100% remote company with 1,600+ team members across 40+ countries, and we’re backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

This is a remote opportunity, and we would be interested in applicants located in Spain, Sweden, UK, Ireland or Germany.

Software Engineer - Synthetic Monitoring

The Opportunity:

The Synthetic Monitoring squad builds and operates Grafana Cloud Synthetic Monitoring, used by teams globally to proactively verify that their critical user journeys, APIs, and services work as expected - before their customers notice they don't.

Synthetic Monitoring is a multi-tenant distributed system implemented in Go, running on Kubernetes across all major cloud providers (AWS, GCP, Azure), executing billions of synthetic tests each month from probe locations around the world and from customer-operated private probes.

The product is in a scale phase, and our focus is on making Synthetic Monitoring a deeply integrated part of Grafana Cloud: connecting checks to real user experience and cross-product investigation workflows, making check results a trusted signal for AI-assisted workflows, and enabling large organizations to operate the product at enterprise scale on our infrastructure and on their own private probes.

The role is full-stack in the real sense: the same engineer who designs how a check execution flows through scheduling, probes, and the telemetry pipeline should also be able to build the workflow that lets a user understand and act on the result.

As a company we are remote-first and global, we embrace people of different experiences and backgrounds to build diverse teams where every person brings a new perspective to the software. We are looking for Software Engineers who are passionate about building reliable systems and providing seamless experiences for our customers to join our growing team! Our stack is Golang, Typescript and React, but we build tools for people using many other stacks.

What you'll be doing:

As a Software Engineer on the Synthetic Monitoring squad, you will work across the whole system - Go services and agents on the backend, a TypeScript/React application on the frontend and you'll be expected to reason about it as one system, not two halves. Specifically, you will:

  • Own features end-to-end across the stack: from API and data model design in Go, through the execution pipeline, to the user-facing workflows in TypeScript/React
  • Design and evolve systems, not just features: contribute to architectural decisions on scheduling, probe lifecycle, telemetry ingestion, and API design that shape how the product scales
  • Build the cross-product and AI-assisted workflows that connect Synthetic Monitoring to the wider Grafana Cloud platform
  • Make the product operable at enterprise scale: the governance and organization primitives that let teams with hundreds of checks manage Synthetic Monitoring as code and with confidence
  • Break down complex, ambiguous problems into incremental deliverables and iterate quickly based on feedback
  • Ensure quality through testing, observability of your own systems, and documentation: our checks are something customers alert on, so reliability is a feature
  • Be a part of the team's on-call rotation and take ownership of the services you're running

We invest heavily in developer productivity. You can use modern AI coding assistants as part of your daily workflow (your choice of tools, within security guidelines), backed by a company-funded usage budget so you can iterate quickly without unnecessary friction. We encourage pragmatic AI-assisted development: faster prototyping, test generation, refactors, documentation, and incident follow-ups—always with strong code review and quality standards. You'll also have access to the latest frontier models from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google.

Technologies you'll work with:

  • Go (backend services, APIs, and the synthetic monitoring agent)
  • TypeScript / React (the Synthetic Monitoring app in Grafana)
  • Kubernetes across AWS, GCP, and Azure
  • k6 (the execution engine behind scripted and browser checks)
  • Grafana ecosystem (Mimir, Loki, Prometheus)

What Makes You a Great Fit:

  • You are comfortable working in a remote-first company; communication is key.
  • For us, working together means being collaborative, friendly, kind, and respectful. We operate by consensus. You can contribute to a discussion, disagree constructively, and commit to the team's decision. You are able to communicate design decisions clearly in written and spoken English.
  • Strong Go, or a path to it. We build Synthetic Monitoring in Go. Deep experience building and operating production backend systems in another systems language (Rust, Java, C++) translates well; backend experience limited to JavaScript/Node.js runtimes does not.
  • Operational mindset. You've run what you've built: you've owned production services, understand what it means to carry a pager, and treat reliability and toil reduction as part of the product.
  • You are a systems thinker: you reason about how components interact - data flow, failure modes, cost, and operational behavior - not just how a single feature works in isolation.
  • Pragmatism and short feedback loops. You break complex problems into increments: analyze, design, deliver an MVP, learn, iterate. You are able to design a solution, get feedback, and write a prototype by yourself - the ability to work on your own is crucial.
  • You have a good understanding of a software development process that takes a user-centered approach. You easily build an understanding of the users' context and goals which will help you build the right solution with the maximum value.
  • You use AI tools as a natural part of your engineering workflow - whether for accelerating exploration, code review, or reasoning through design tradeoffs - and you're thoughtful about where they help and where they don't.

Bonus Points For:

  • Experience designing or operating multi-tenant SaaS systems at scale
  • Experience with observability tools (Grafana, Datadog, New Relic, Sentry, etc.)
  • Experience with Kubernetes in a production environment
  • Familiarity with k6, Playwright, or browser automation at scale
  • Experience contributing to or maintaining open source projects

Compensation & Rewards:

In Germany, the Base compensation range for this role is EUR 76,000 - EUR 95,000. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed in the interview process. Benefits include equity, bonus (if applicable) and other benefits listed here.

Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:

  • 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
  • Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
  • Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.

  • Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.
  • In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.
  • Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable.

Columnists also write to a general audience interested in learning how to improve society's understanding and treatment of disease/disability communities.

All columns are reviewed with a critical eye by professional editors who will work with columnists to smooth rough spots and help the columnist grow as a writer. This is a contract position.

  • Complete training assigned by Bionews HR.

  • At least three months’ direct experience with caring for someone with LGS.

  • Fundamentals of how LGS works.

Knowledge Preferred

  • The content needs or wants of the LGS community.

Skills Required

Abilities Required

Bionews is a leading online health, science, publication, and research company with one purpose: to serve patients with a rare or chronic disease. This content is delivered regularly and provided by actual patients as well as professional journalists, writers, editors, scientists, and experienced media executives. Our end customers are truly patients living with rare and chronic diseases. Visit www.bionews.com for more information.

To empower, inspire, and champion the patient voice as the preeminent resource that engages, informs, and connects the global rare and chronic disease community.

We connect rare and chronic disease communities by providing a unified and distinctive space to engage, educate, and empower those affected by rare diseases to help improve patient health and quality of life.

We believe human intellect paired with data-driven AI is the winning combination. It always has been. And we're on a mission to bring that winning combination to automotive dealerships with easy-to-love software. We're a software company that thinks about people first. With every innovation, we seek to put humans back in the starring role.

If this sounds like the kind of company you want to be a part of, there’s good news. We’re hiring for a Data Integrity Analyst!

The Team

The Data Integrity team is an integral part of the Foureyes organization, contributing results and action items for our clients and internal team members. As part of the team, we expect collaboration and clear communication - amongst each other and with other teams. The team operates at high levels of technical expertise to ensure we have a path to resolution for any obstacle thrown our way. The team thrives on autonomy and teamwork to proactively and reactively identify issues & process improvements.

The Position

The Data Integrity Analyst cares about the quality of data and is always seeking ways to improve current processes. Enjoys and is motivated to solve problems, and effectively hands-off/partners with engineering when appropriate. Solves problems in a timely manner and utilizes processes, tools, and resources to ensure completion of work. Maintains client configurations and evaluates and improves data quality to ensure the overall health and stability of our platform and product efficacy.

On a day-to-day basis, a Data Integrity Analyst will be responsible for identifying and resolving client configuration issues, answering product questions from internal team members, partnering with the development team to provide detailed feedback on current data trends, and handling maintenance of core product integrations. This role ideally will be able to identify areas of opportunity for improvement of our product and our processes, and have a passion for being proactive as opposed to reactive. You will develop and strengthen a desire for continuing to improve the quality and delivery of our data.

Responsibilities

You are responsible for routine maintenance tasks, ad hoc maintenance, and data quality projects. This includes, but is not limited to:

  • Leveraging technology. Your role will include working with various tools including SQL, Snowflake, Tableau, Insomnia, and the Fourbot admin tool among others.

  • Fielding Questions: You will act as a subject matter expert on Foureyes client configuration (this will include assisting with escalations from other teams on configuration related issues).

  • General Maintenance: Our products need support too to keep running smoothly and effectively. You will be responsible for managing our more complex maintenance reports and systems that will indicate action items needed for our clients and products to stay happy. This includes in-depth data quality and integrity testing.

  • Understanding our backend systems. Foureyes is a big platform, and you’ll be responsible for learning all the ins and outs of it.

  • Mastering capabilities. The most important question to ask is “Is everything working how it’s supposed to?” In order to answer that, you need to have a nuanced understanding of what the expected behavior is.

  • Research. Whether via reading our external knowledge base, diving into internal documentation, digging through old JIRAs, or thumbing through Slack threads, effective research is essential to finding the right answer.

  • Collaborate. You will work closely not only with your team, but with many teams within the company. This includes working closely with developers to debug issues.

Qualifications

  • You are comfortable and effective communicating with technical co-workers (you aren’t a developer yourself, but you understand enough to have productive conversations to solve problems and move issues forward)

  • You have experience working with code (SQL, CSS, or Javascript a plus)

  • You are an analytical problem solver, you love digging into an in-depth problem to get to the root issue and coming up with creative solutions

  • You have strong communication skills

  • You are known for your attention to detail. You spot the error or data discrepancy that most people miss

  • You are comfortable working with large data sets

  • You are a quick learner

  • You are highly organized

Bonus if you have experience working with a software engineering team (or similar technical team)

jobs.excerpt: Rockstar is recruiting for a company that provides innovative software and services for urban forestry, GIS, and green infrastructure management.
jobs.description:
Rockstar is recruiting for a company that provides innovative software and services for urban forestry, GIS, and green infrastructure management. Their tools and data help cities, organizations, and consultants plan, preserve, and enhance the urban forest – creating greener, healthier communities. They are at an inflection point – scaling their customer support and professional services operations while fundamentally rethinking how they deliver support through AI, automation, and smarter processes. They are looking for a strategic, technically strong leader to own this transformation: someone who can manage a team through change, bring order to complexity, and build a support operation that’s dramatically more efficient and scalable than what exists today.

About the Company

They are at an inflection point – scaling their customer support and professional services operations while fundamentally rethinking how they deliver support through AI, automation, and smarter processes. They are looking for a strategic, technically strong leader to own this transformation: someone who can manage a team through change, bring order to complexity, and build a support operation that's dramatically more efficient and scalable than what exists today.

The Role

This is a hands-on leadership role. The Manager will manage a team of 6 (employees and contractors) across customer support and professional services, owning both the day-to-day execution and the strategic direction of how the company supports customers. Today, nearly 60% of the company's PS team's work requires direct database access – writing SQL queries, diagnosing data issues, performing migrations. While they are actively building UI tools to reduce this dependency, database expertise will remain critical for the foreseeable future. The right person brings real technical depth here, not just management experience.

The Manager will also inherit a large backlog with multiple stakeholder groups – internal CSMs, services teams, direct customers, and reseller partners – each with competing and often unspoken priorities. A core part of this role is turning that ambiguity into clear, actionable priorities for the team. The Manager needs the customer acumen to know when to go the extra mile, and the judgment to know when and how to draw the line.

Key Responsibilities

Team Leadership & Change Management

  • Leads, coaches, and develops a team of 6 across support and professional services – running 1:1s, team meetings, and performance management.
  • Drives the ongoing restructuring of the team for efficiency, including redefining roles, workflows, and day-to-day responsibilities. Supports team members through these transitions with clear communication and hands-on guidance.
  • Builds systems for workload management, prioritization, and accountability that scale as the team evolves.
  • Creates clarity from ambiguity: translates competing stakeholder needs into well-defined priorities and execution plans the team can act on.

Technical & Database Expertise

  • Brings hands-on proficiency with SQL and relational databases (PostgreSQL preferred) to support, troubleshoot, and mentor the team on complex data issues.
  • Understands how database-driven workflows underpin the company's support operations – from data imports and migrations to query-based investigations and bulk updates.
  • Serves as a technical escalation point for Tier 3 issues involving database integrity, schema inconsistencies, API integrations, and GIS data workflows.
  • Bridges the gap between the support team and Engineering by providing detailed technical context on bugs and systemic issues originating in the data layer.

AI Strategy & Automation

  • This is not a nice-to-have. The company expects this person to fundamentally rethink how the team operates using AI and automation.
  • Identifies and implements AI-driven solutions across the support function – automated customer responses, AI-assisted triage, knowledge base generation, proactive outreach, and self-service tools.
  • Evaluates and deploys AI tools (e.g., Zendesk AI, ChatGPT/Claude integrations, custom workflows) to reduce manual effort and accelerate resolution times.
  • Builds toward a future-state vision where AI handles a significant share of routine support volume, freeing the team for higher-value work.
  • Stays current on AI capabilities relevant to support operations and continuously pushes the team to adopt smarter ways of working.

Stakeholder & Backlog Management

  • Manages competing priorities across internal teams (Customer Success, Services, Sales) and external stakeholders (customers, reseller partners) with diplomacy and decisiveness.
  • Owns the support and PS backlog: triages, prioritizes, and communicates status clearly to all stakeholders.
  • Brings a service-minded attitude paired with the confidence to set boundaries, push back when needed, and communicate trade-offs effectively.
  • Represents the voice of the customer in cross-functional discussions while balancing operational reality.

Process & Systems Optimization

  • Owns and improves support processes including ticketing workflows, SLAs, escalation paths, and documentation.
  • Optimizes the current multi-system environment (Zendesk + HubSpot) – Zendesk expertise is strongly preferred.
  • Tracks and reports on key metrics (resolution times, CSAT, backlog health, team utilization) to drive data-informed decisions.
  • Identifies inefficiencies and leads rapid-cycle improvements that make the team measurably more productive.

Customer Experience & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Ensures timely, high-quality, empathetic customer support across all channels.
  • Collaborates with Product, Engineering, Customer Success, and GIS Consulting to resolve complex issues and improve the end-to-end customer journey.
  • Supports customer onboarding, training, and data workflows as needed, including GIS data preparation and review.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years in technical support, solutions engineering, professional services, or application support.
  • 2+ years managing or leading a team, with demonstrated experience coaching through organizational change.
  • Proficient in SQL with hands-on experience working with relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, or similar). Comfortable writing queries, diagnosing data issues, and mentoring others on database fundamentals.
  • Strong AI literacy – actively uses AI tools in their work today and has a point of view on how AI transforms support operations. Experience implementing AI-driven workflows is a significant plus.
  • Experience with Zendesk (strongly preferred) and familiarity with multi-system support environments (e.g., HubSpot, Jira).
  • Excellent stakeholder management skills – able to navigate competing priorities, create clarity from ambiguity, and communicate trade-offs with both internal teams and external partners.
  • Strong organizational and prioritization skills with a bias toward action and rapid iteration.
  • Clear, confident communicator (English) who can translate technical complexity for non-technical audiences and deliver difficult messages with empathy and professionalism.
  • Comfort working with GIS data formats and tools (Shapefiles, GeoJSON, QGIS) or strong willingness to learn.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience with PostgreSQL/PostGIS or spatial database extensions.
  • Background in GIS, urban forestry, arboriculture, or environmental science.
  • Experience building or deploying AI chatbots, automated triage systems, or knowledge base automation.
  • Familiarity with APIs, REST/JSON, and common web technologies.
  • Scripting ability (Python, JavaScript, or Bash) for data processing or automation.
  • Experience managing distributed/remote teams.
  • Fluency in a second language (Spanish preferred).

Success Metrics

  • Team Performance & Stability: Clear role accountability, successful team restructuring, strong retention, and measurable improvement in team capability and morale through the transition.
  • Backlog & Resolution Efficiency: Reduced backlog, faster resolution times, SLA adherence, and fewer escalations through better process and prioritization.
  • AI & Automation Impact: Measurable reduction in manual support effort through implemented AI tools and automated workflows within the first 6–12 months.
  • Customer Satisfaction: High CSAT scores, positive stakeholder feedback, and a reputation for responsive, high-quality support.
  • Process Maturity: Documented, repeatable processes across ticketing, escalation, and cross-functional handoffs with clear metrics and reporting.
  • Stakeholder Confidence: Internal teams and external partners have visibility into priorities, status, and trade-offs – reducing friction and escalations.

Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.

Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. Participation is project-based, not permanent employment.What this opportunity involves:
We're building a dataset to evaluate AI coding agents - how well a model handles real-world developer tasks.

You'll create challenging tasks and evaluation criteria within realistic simulated environments:

  • Build realistic developer environments - a virtual company with codebase, infrastructure, and context (tickets, docs, conversations) that forms a believable development history
  • Design tasks from intermediate states of these environments - craft the prompt, define what "solved" means, and ensure the task is solvable by an AI agent
  • Write tests that verify agent solutions - accept all valid approaches and reject incorrect ones, neither too strict nor too lenient
  • Iterate on tasks and tests based on QA feedback - review agent solutions, analyze failures, and refine until the evaluation is fair and robust

What this is NOT:

  • Not data labeling
  • Not prompt engineering
  • Not writing code from scratch - the agent writes most of the code; you guide and evaluate

What we look for:

  • 8+ years in software development
  • Core stack: Python (FastAPI), JavaScript/TypeScript (React), Docker, Postgres, Kafka, Redis
  • Experience writing tests (functional, integration)
  • English proficiency - B2+

Why this is hard:
Frontier models are already good at coding. Creating a task that genuinely challenges the best models is non-trivial. Overview

DecisionPoint seeks an Identity & Access Management (IAM) Engineer to support enterprise identity operations and authentication services for a large federal and DoD-aligned mission environment. This role manages identity governance, access control enforcement, single sign-on (SSO) integrations, and multi-factor authentication (MFA) capabilities across cloud and on-premise environments. The IAM Engineer will contribute directly to the implementation of the Zero Trust identity pillar, ensuring secure, reliable, and policy-driven access to mission-critical systems.

This position is fully remote.

Duties & Responsibilities

The Identity & Access Management Engineer will:

  • Manage SSO integrations across enterprise applications and services.
  • Configure and maintain identity governance workflows, account lifecycle management, and access approval processes.
  • Implement and manage MFA, conditional access policies, and identity verification mechanisms.
  • Support development and enforcement of identity-based access controls aligned with Zero Trust principles.
  • Configure IAM roles, permissions, and policies in cloud environments, including AWS IAM.
  • Conduct access reviews, entitlement audits, and privileged access assessments.
  • Partner with cybersecurity teams to align identity controls with DoD security and compliance requirements.
  • Troubleshoot identity issues related to SSO, MFA, directory services, and authentication flows.
  • Assist with identity roadmap planning, modernization activities, and capability enhancements.
  • Maintain identity standards, configuration documentation, and architectural artifacts.
  • Support incident response activities related to identity threats or compromised accounts.
  • Contribute to the development and refinement of IAM procedures, playbooks, and governance models.

Qualifications

Clearance Requirement

Must hold an active Top Secret clearance, supported by a Tier 5 background investigation.

Education (Required)

Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field.

Experience (Required)

  • Minimum 6 years of experience in identity and access management, authentication engineering, or IAM operations.
  • Experience implementing or supporting SSO integrations, MFA configurations, or identity governance processes.
  • Experience managing IAM roles, policies, and permissions in cloud environments (AWS preferred).
  • Experience conducting access reviews, entitlement audits, or privilege management activities.
  • Experience supporting the implementation of identity-focused security controls.

Technical Knowledge (Required)

  • Strong understanding of IAM concepts, including authentication, authorization, federation, and identity governance.
  • Experience with SSO technologies, MFA systems, and identity providers.
  • Proficiency in AWS IAM roles, policies, access keys, and permission boundaries.
  • Knowledge of Zero Trust identity principles and identity-centric access control models.
  • Understanding of DoD cybersecurity requirements related to identity and access management.

Technical Knowledge (Preferred)

  • Experience with directory services (e.g., Active Directory, Azure AD).
  • Familiarity with identity risk scoring, behavioral analytics, or conditional access signals.
  • Experience integrating IAM with CI/CD pipelines or DevSecOps workflows.

Certifications

Required:

  • Security+

Preferred:

  • AWS IAM or AWS Security specialty certification
  • Additional DoD 8570/8140 IAM-related certifications

Skills

  • Strong problem-solving abilities for diagnosing authentication and access issues.
  • Excellent communication skills for collaborating with cybersecurity, engineering, and application teams.
  • High attention to detail for managing access controls, policies, and identity workflows.
  • Ability to manage multiple IAM initiatives in a fast-paced, mission-critical environment.
  • Strong documentation skills for maintaining identity policies, standards, and technical procedures.

The successful candidate will be a proactive new-business hunter who is comfortable conducting high-volume outbound prospecting, building relationships with senior decision-makers, and presenting tailored event solutions that deliver measurable value to customers.

Key Responsibilities

New Business Development

  • Identify and prospect manufacturers, wholesalers, distributors, suppliers, and emerging brands that align with ASD Market Week’s buyer community.
  • Generate new business through telephone outreach, email campaigns, LinkedIn, industry research, referrals, inbound leads, networking, and competitive-event prospecting.
  • Build and maintain a healthy pipeline of qualified exhibit and sponsorship opportunities.
  • Develop targeted prospecting strategies across relevant product categories, including general merchandise, fashion and accessories, beauty and wellness, gift and home, toys, convenience-store products, closeouts, liquidation, and private-label manufacturing.
  • Re-engage dormant, lapsed, and previously lost exhibitors with relevant and compelling commercial proposals.

Consultative Sales and Closing

  • Own the full sales cycle from initial outreach and qualification through proposal, negotiation, contracting, and close.
  • Conduct effective discovery conversations to understand each prospect’s products, target customers, business objectives, challenges, and growth strategy.
  • Clearly communicate ASD Market Week’s value proposition and demonstrate how participation can help customers generate leads, meet qualified buyers, enter new markets, increase brand visibility, and grow revenue.
  • Recommend appropriate booth packages, sponsorships, digital products, marketing opportunities, and other solutions based on customer needs and objectives.
  • Prepare proposals, negotiate commercial terms, overcome objections, create urgency, and consistently move opportunities toward close.
  • Meet or exceed individual revenue, new-business, renewal, activity, and productivity targets.

Account Growth and Retention

  • Develop strong relationships with new and existing exhibitors, serving as a knowledgeable and trusted commercial partner.
  • Manage a portfolio of assigned accounts and identify opportunities for renewal, expansion, upselling, cross-selling, and multi-show participation.
  • Conduct structured post-show follow-up to review exhibitor outcomes, gather feedback, address concerns, and secure future participation.
  • Work proactively to reduce cancellations and improve exhibitor retention.
  • Maintain regular communication with customers throughout the event cycle to ensure expectations are clearly understood and appropriately managed.

Pipeline Management and Forecasting

  • Maintain complete and accurate customer, activity, opportunity, and contract information within the CRM.
  • Manage opportunities through clearly defined pipeline stages with documented next steps and realistic close dates.
  • Produce accurate weekly and monthly sales forecasts.
  • Monitor personal pacing against revenue goals, activity expectations, and event deadlines.
  • Use CRM data, category insights, sales reports, and market intelligence to prioritize accounts and identify areas of opportunity.
  • Maintain strong pipeline discipline and immediately escalate material risks, blockers, or forecast changes.

Collaboration and Event Delivery

  • Partner closely with marketing, operations, customer success, finance, and event leadership to deliver a strong exhibitor experience.
  • Provide customer and marketplace feedback to support product development, pricing, marketing campaigns, and show-floor strategy.
  • Coordinate the successful handoff of contracted exhibitors to the appropriate operational and customer-success teams.
  • Attend ASD Market Week and other relevant industry events, supporting customers onsite and developing new sales opportunities.
  • Represent ASD and Emerald professionally in all customer and industry interactions.

Qualifications

  • Two or more years of successful B2B sales, business development, account management, media sales, event sales, or sponsorship sales experience.
  • Demonstrated ability to generate new business through proactive outbound prospecting.
  • Proven record of meeting or exceeding individual sales targets.
  • Experience managing the complete sales cycle from prospecting through negotiation and close.
  • Strong consultative-selling, presentation, negotiation, and objection-handling skills.
  • Ability to build credibility and relationships with business owners, founders, sales leaders, marketing executives, and other senior decision-makers.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage a high volume of accounts, opportunities, and deadlines.
  • Experience using CRM and sales-enablement platforms; Salesforce experience is preferred.
  • Strong forecasting discipline and attention to CRM accuracy.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, target-driven, and deadline-oriented sales environment.
  • Ability and willingness to travel to ASD Market Week in Las Vegas and other relevant industry events.
  • Trade-show, wholesale, retail, consumer-products, media, or events-industry experience is preferred but not required.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role means:

  • Consistently achieving or exceeding revenue targets.
  • Building a strong and sustainable pipeline of new exhibitor opportunities.
  • Expanding ASD’s presence across priority merchandise categories and markets.
  • Converting qualified prospects into contracted exhibitors and sponsors.
  • Retaining and growing existing accounts.
  • Maintaining accurate forecasting and disciplined CRM management.
  • Delivering a professional, consultative, and commercially valuable customer experience.

Ideal Candidate

You are competitive, resilient, curious, and motivated by winning new business. You are comfortable picking up the phone, creating opportunities from a cold start, and maintaining a consistent level of outbound sales activity. You do not wait for leads to arrive. You research the market, identify the right prospects, ask thoughtful questions, communicate value clearly, and take ownership of moving opportunities through the sales process. You balance urgency with relationship building and understand that strong sales performance requires both disciplined activity and meaningful customer conversations.

Our job postings don’t contain experience inflation, and most don’t require college degrees. Instead, they’re crafted to focus on outcomes and transferable experiences that are assessed in a structured interview process carried out by trained hiring teams.

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

About the Company & Mission

We are an early-stage (Seed), venture-backed cross-border neobank and retail brokerage built for global investors. Our mission is to bridge financial borders across the Pacific: building a single platform where US investors can directly access, trade, and hold high-growth Asian equities (such as Korean and Japanese markets) as seamlessly as trading domestic US stocks.

By combining an AI-native back end, real-time translated market research/filings, automated FX, multi-currency custody, and compliant clearing/settlement rails, we are removing the friction from international investing. Starting with a focus on cross-border retail brokerage, our long-term vision spans multi-currency banking, stablecoin-enabled instant cross-border settlement, and direct global market access on a single shelf.

We run on absolute trust: moving real capital across international borders requires rock-solid, auditable, and resilient infrastructure. We are actively expanding our founding engineering team to build out core systems on our path toward full brokerage self-clearing operations.

Why This Role Exists

As a modern retail brokerage, our backend is the core product. You will carry three of the company’s most critical technical deliverables:

  1. Build the financial foundation: Own the services driving order lifecycles, internal ledgers, multi-currency funding flows, and automated reconciliation from day one.

  2. Scale with precision: Build high-throughput, fault-tolerant infrastructure capable of expanding from early users to hundreds of thousands of active investors without compromising auditability or data integrity.

  3. Set engineering standards: Partner directly with the CTO to define company-wide standards for correctness, distributed system reliability, and production operational excellence.

This is a founding-stage seat offering deep technical ownership and high agency over architecture, product decisions, and system design.

What You Will Own

    • Core Financial Engine: Design, implement, and maintain end-to-end order routing, execution lifecycles, internal double-entry ledgers, and automated funding/reconciliation systems.

    • Resilient Architecture: Build production systems optimized for concurrency and partial network failures using idempotent handlers, durable event history, replayable state, and self-healing mechanisms.

    • Third-Party & Banking Integrations: Integrate directly with partner clearing broker-dealers, international brokers, banking rails (ACH, wires), FX mechanisms, and automated KYC/AML verification providers.

    • Production Excellence: Take end-to-end operational ownership—including sandbox testing environments, monitoring/alerting, incident response, on-call rotations, and postmortems.

    • Internal Operational Tooling: Build robust internal tools and dashboards for operations, compliance, and support teams to audit, investigate, and resolve issues proactively.

    • Data & AI Infrastructure Support: Support underlying data pipelines powering our real-time AI research and content-translation engines (no dedicated ML background required).

Who We Are Looking For

    Must-Have:

    • Experience: 6+ years of hands-on experience building, scaling, and maintaining high-availability production backend systems.

    • Financial Data Rigor: Proven track record of owning mission-critical systems handling sensitive transactions (e.g., money movement, balances, orders, ledgering, or high-integrity financial data).

    • Technical Proficiency: Deep expertise in a modern backend language (e.g., Go, Python, Node.js, Rust, or Java) and production data infrastructure (relational DBs, distributed event queues/streams, caching layers).

    • System Design & Correctness: Strong instincts for distributed systems trade-offs—data modeling, transaction isolation, idempotency, failure domain isolation, and state reconciliation.

    • Production Maturity: Hands-on experience with on-call rotations, incident management, performance tuning, and writing thorough postmortems.

    • Startup Mindset: High comfort navigating ambiguity, making pragmatic engineering trade-offs, and contributing to both product strategy and technical architecture.

      • Strong Nice-to-Have:

      • Experience scaling consumer fintech, crypto, or brokerage platforms to 100k+ active users.

      • Domain knowledge in capital markets (Order Management Systems/OMS, market data, tax-lot accounting, corporate actions, post-trade settlement).

      • Experience integrating with partner broker-dealers, clearing platforms, or Banking-as-a-Service (BaaS) APIs.

      • Hands-on experience with double-entry accounting ledgers, multi-currency FX rails, or stablecoin/on-chain settlement.

      • Cross-border regulatory awareness or language fluency relevant to East Asian markets (e.g., Korean or Japanese).

      • Familiarity with AI-assisted developer tools and workflows that accelerate shipping velocity without compromising correctness.

Who Is NOT the Right Fit

  • Engineers who prefer taking pre-written tickets rather than driving problem definition, system design, and execution from zero.

  • Engineers who view data correctness, logging, observability, and auditability as secondary considerations.

  • Engineers seeking a purely advisory role without willingness to carry operational and production on-call responsibilities.

Description

CapsLock is a global IT marketing company that pioneers unique, scalable customer acquisition solutions for B2C clients. We solve complex sales challenges across a wide range of industries, primarily for large North American partners. By integrating our expertise in Digital Marketing, IT, Design, AI-driven analytics, proprietary MarTech, and sales consulting, we deliver powerful, data-informed customer acquisition solutions.

At CapsLock, people, technology, and forward-thinking innovation lie at the heart of everything we do. Our diverse, global team, fluent in over 10 languages, thrives on open collaboration and the exchange of new ideas, pushing boundaries to ensure our clients' success.

Role overview

We are building CapsLock's AI Media Production platform, and we're hiring the tech lead who will architect it.

We generate visuals of real products, not concepts. Every asset must match the client's actual product 1:1 - down to hardware and geometry. No artifacts, no hallucinations, no "close enough". This is a control and reproducibility problem, not a prompting problem, and it needs an engineer.

This is a greenfield build. You'll be the first engineer in this direction, working directly with the Design Director as the technical interface between creative teams and software infrastructure.

What you will work on

  • Architect and run our AI Media Production platform: serving ComfyUI or similar engines, GPU environments, one-click UIs for non-technical teams;
  • Ship modular, versioned, reproducible generative pipelines, node-based and/or code-first (e.g. diffusers);
  • Develop one-click presets and use cases for image and video generation;
  • Train LoRAs end-to-end: from real product photography to evaluated, production-ready models;
  • Build control-first generation into every pipeline: ControlNet, IP-Adapter, inpainting, reference conditioning;
  • Engineer QC into the pipeline itself: automated checks against product references, before a human ever reviews;
  • Build our creative intelligence loop: encode what makes our best-performing assets work into reusable presets and styles;
  • Own the technical roadmap with the Design Director; qualify new models and tools; drive adoption through enablement, not mandates.

Requirements

Your must haves

You don't need to meet every single requirement. If you're excellent in most of these areas and can show shipped work, we'd love to hear from you.

  • Shipped generative pipelines adopted and used daily by other people;
  • Production-grade workflows in ComfyUI or similar technologies, or equivalent code-first experience (e.g. diffusers);
  • Strong Python: automation, API integrations, custom nodes;
  • LoRA training end-to-end, from dataset curation to evaluation;
  • Control techniques across modalities (t2i, i2i, i2v, v2v): ControlNet, IP-Adapter, inpainting, reference conditioning;
  • Deploying pipelines as internal tools;
  • Enough visual literacy to set the quality bar (no design portfolio required);
  • Confident English (B2+).

Nice to have

  • 3D/render-hybrid workflows: Blender or CAD renders as geometric ground truth with generated environments;
  • LLM orchestration and agentic workflows: automated prompt generation, VLM-based QC;
  • Experience producing visuals for performance marketing.

What we offer

  • Remote Work - we offer a truly and fully remote environment. You choose where you are the most productive and comfortable to have an impact.
  • Paid vacations - generous paid vacation policy to ensure you have time to recharge
  • Unlimited Sick Days - we understand that being only human means getting sick or feeling under the weather from time to time, so we guarantee you time off as long as you need to recover and get back on your feet.
  • Ongoing Learning - people at CapsLock are deeply inquisitive and eager to learn new knowledge and skills, that's why we support and create learning opportunities like the Free Books program, workshops, conferences, and more.
  • Home Office - we will cover the equipment and furniture expenses to make sure you have the best work-from-home experience.
  • Physical Well–Being - We will cover costs of your medical insurance. Additionally we offer an allowance for a flexible fitness program.
  • Fun Stuff - there is never a shortage of fun stuff

  • Atuar diretamente com Incident Response e Fraud Prevention em investigações ativas, fornecendo contexto de ameaça, hipóteses de atribuição, mapeamento de infraestrutura e inteligência preditiva.

Ingredientes Que Buscamos:

  • Domínio de técnicas de coleta OSINT, incluindo enumeração de infraestrutura, análise de domínios e certificados, monitoramento de redes sociais, scraping de fóruns e boas práticas de segurança operacional.
  • Experiência com fontes de dark web e inteligência de fontes fechadas.

  • Experiência com TIPs, APIs de enriquecimento, data lakes e ferramentas de visualização para fusão de dados de fontes distintas.
  • Conhecimento sólido de telemetria de rede, hosts e fraude em pagamentos, com capacidade de identificar padrões e separar ruído de atividade relevante.
  • Conhecimento avançado de perfilamento e atribuição de threat actors, incluindo análise de infraestrutura, classificação de famílias de malware, indicadores linguísticos e culturais, padrões de targeting e avaliação de confiança.

jobs.title: Principal Product Strategist
jobs.excerpt: LaunchPad Lab is a digital product and AI development firm that helps organizations turn complex business challenges into software that creates measurable impact.
jobs.description:
LaunchPad Lab is a digital product and AI development firm that helps organizations turn complex business challenges into software that creates measurable impact.

Since 2012, our teams have designed, built, and supported hundreds of digital products, including custom applications, AI-powered platforms, intelligent workflows, and internal business tools. We bring product strategy, design, and engineering together in one collaborative team and work closely with clients from the initial idea through launch and ongoing growth.

The Role

This is a senior role on our sales team that sits at the intersection of product strategy, technology, and sales. Our clients bring us complex problems that don't have obvious answers. You will help them define the right solution and create a plan our delivery team can successfully execute.

As a key member of our sales team, you will lead discovery, run our Blueprint Workshops, and translate what you learn into product direction, roadmaps, scope, timelines, and pricing. You'll also collaborate across our engineering, product, and design teams.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead discovery. Run structured sessions with client stakeholders to understand their business, identify the underlying problem, and define what a successful solution should accomplish.
  • Own the Blueprint. Lead our signature Blueprint Workshops and deliver a clear product roadmap, technical approach, scope, timeline, and budget. For many clients, this is the first step toward a larger build.
  • Shape the solution. Translate business goals into product requirements and phased delivery plans. Work with engineering to define the technical approach, evaluate build-versus-buy, custom-versus-off-the-shelf, and AI-versus-traditional options, and clearly explain the recommendation to the client.
  • Support the sales process. Help qualify opportunities, build the business case, shape pitches, present solutions, respond to client questions, and close new work. Maintain accurate opportunity details and forecasts in our CRM.
  • Scope and price the work. Collaborate with team members to develop realistic estimates that account for complexity, risk, and uncertainty while balancing the client’s goals with the economics of the project.
  • Stay accountable through handoff. Help transition sold work into delivery, making sure the team understands the proposed solution, key assumptions, and client commitments. Identify opportunities for additional work when they arise.
  • Improve how we sell. Help strengthen our discovery frameworks, proposal materials, estimation practices, and overall sales process so the entire firm benefits from what you learn.

Who You Are

You have experience leading complex client conversations and know how to get beyond the initial request to understand the underlying business problem. You listen carefully, ask direct questions, and are comfortable challenging assumptions when you believe there is a better path forward.

You enjoy the early stages of the work, when the problem is still ambiguous and the right solution has not yet been defined. You can move comfortably between business strategy, product decisions, technical tradeoffs, and commercial conversations.

Requirements

Must Have

  • At least 5 years of experience in consulting, professional services, or an agency in a client-facing solutions, product, or strategy role
  • Demonstrated experience leading discovery and translating client needs into scoped, priced, and buildable solutions
  • Strong product management fundamentals and working knowledge of modern software architecture, with the ability to shape a credible approach and collaborate effectively with engineers
  • A practical understanding of AI, including AI agents and automated workflows, along with good judgment about when they belong in a solution
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical tradeoffs to nontechnical audiences
  • Experience managing several client engagements or sales pursuits at once, along with comfort working toward commercial goals and maintaining accurate pipeline and forecast information
  • The ability and willingness to travel for onsite client workshops when needed

Nice to Have

  • Experience working closely with teams that design and build custom software
  • Experience building or scoping AI agents, RAG systems, or workflow automation
  • Familiarity with agile delivery and the ability to scope work in a way that reflects how delivery teams will execute it
  • Experience working at a growing consultancy where you helped develop a function or process rather than stepping into an established role
  • Experience selling or scoping solutions in regulated or data-sensitive environments

Why LaunchPad Lab

  • The opportunity to shape how we work. Your work will be visible and you will have meaningful input into how we define and scope solutions during the sales process.
  • A practical approach to AI. We use AI throughout discovery, planning, and delivery when it makes the work better or more efficient.
  • Complex, meaningful work. Our clients come to us to replace core systems, improve important business processes, and build new digital products. The work has real stakes and visible impact.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary with range of $150,000-$200,000
  • Health insurance, with LaunchPad Lab covering 100% of the employee PPO premium and 25% of dependent premiums
  • Dental and vision insurance with the same contribution structure
  • 401(k) with up to 4% company match
  • Education and learning stipend
  • Flexible vacation policy
  • Paid parental leave

LaunchPad Lab is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a team with diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives.

This position is for a Senior “LAMP” developer with Laravel expertise and experience in containerization. Please read this carefully. This is not an entry level position and there are specific requirements, just like any software development project.

You must be a PHP developer first, and a Laravel developer second. Front end experience is also a must.

Agency experience is preferred as you will be tasked with generating timelines and estimates for projects, then delivering them. At times, smaller projects may have little Project Management and delivery is handled by the developer. This is a typical example of Agency work. Larger projects have more Project Management. However, our developers are often communicating directly with the clients and internal teams regarding scope, costs, and timelines. In effect, you are soup-to-nuts freelancer, but as a full time position.

  • We are a small company with heavy hitting clients
  • Training is limited - you must be able to hit the ground running
  • We are often hired to solve problems that cannot be solved by our client’s internal teams
  • Interruptions and client management is part of Agency life
  • Accountability and improvement is key to our survival
  • Independence is key
  • Security is an absolute

Responsibilities & Qualifications

This is a full time, client facing role requiring excellent communication skills, both written and verbal. A background check and references are required.

Your primary role will be to collaborate with cross-functional teams building highly secure, complex back-end and front-end products with many moving parts. This role includes projects for a Fortune 500 investment company, as well as our Laravel based CMS for law firms called LawFirm CMS, and many others.

Clean sheet development and maintenance of legacy PHP based applications is in your wheelhouse.

You will also be involved with the co-creation of project plans and pre-sales activities (information architecture, estimates, scope, schedule, risks, etc.).

Your keen insight into data consumption, manipulation, and presentation will be tested. A passion for problem solving and self governance is a necessity.

With the rapid change in techniques and tools available, you will be tasked with creating maintainable, best-practice based system architectures. We maintain everything we produce and pride ourselves on long term, sustainable partnerships with our clients and related vendors. It is important to understand that maintenance is a large part of our business, which means building software but also maintaining it over time.

jobs.excerpt: SummaryYelp connects people with great local businesses.
jobs.description:
Summary

Yelp connects people with great local businesses. Our platform is powered by a vibrant community contributing reviews and engaging with local businesses daily. We monetize primarily through advertising, helping millions of businesses connect with high-intent consumers. The Ads Auction system sits at the heart of this exchange, determining which ads are shown for every opportunity.

The Ads Marketplace team is responsible for the core engine that drives Yelp's advertising business. We develop and optimize the sophisticated auction, bidding, and pacing systems that balance advertiser value (ROI), consumer experience, and Yelp's monetization goals. We work at the intersection of economics, machine learning, and large-scale systems engineering.

As the Principal Product Manager for Ads Auction and Measurement, you will own the product strategy and execution for Yelp's core ad auction, bidding, pricing, budget pacing mechanisms, and corresponding measurements. This is a highly technical leadership role where you will guide the evolution of algorithms and systems that make real-time decisions maximizing value across multiple stakeholders. You will define how we measure the performance and impact of these complex systems, focusing on both short-term efficiency and long-term impact. You will partner closely with world-class engineering and applied science teams to design, experiment, implement, and iterate on auction dynamics and the metrics that guide our progress.

This opportunity is fully remote and does not require you to be located in any particular area in Canada. We welcome applicants from throughout Canada. We’d love to have you apply, even if you don’t feel you meet every single requirement in this posting. At Yelp, we’re looking for great people, not just those who simply check off all the boxes.

What you'll do:

  • Auction Strategy & Roadmap: Define and drive the product roadmap for Yelp's ads auction, bidding algorithms, pricing mechanisms, and budget pacing systems, ensuring alignment with business objectives and competitive dynamics. Identify key levers for optimization and innovation.
  • Algorithm & System Optimization: Partner deeply with Engineering and Data Science to design, develop, and refine the auction-based ad selection system. Translate advertiser goals (ROI, leads, conversions), user experience, and monetization considerations into algorithmic requirements, and prioritize initiatives based on concrete data and expected impact.
  • Auction Measurement & Evaluation: Define and own the key metrics framework for evaluating auction health, efficiency, and the business impact. Drive the development of robust measurement for complex trade-offs (e.g., relevance vs. monetization, short-term vs. long-term effects). Design and interpret large-scale A/B tests.
  • Independent Data Analysis: Conduct hands-on analysis of large-scale auction and advertising datasets using tools like SQL and Python to uncover optimization opportunities, validate hypotheses, understand performance drivers, and inform product decisions.
  • Technical Product Development: Lead the end-to-end product lifecycle for auction-related features and improvements, from ideation and requirements definition through launch and iteration.
  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Serve as the product leader for the auction domain, collaborating effectively with Engineering, Data Science, Sales, Finance, and other Product teams. Communicate complex technical concepts and trade-offs clearly to diverse audiences.
  • Drive Business Impact: Directly influence Yelp's revenue and advertiser success by improving the efficiency and effectiveness of the core ad marketplace.

What it takes to succeed:

  • Experience: 8+ years of technical product management experience, preferably focused on auctions, bidding systems, search ranking, or monetization platforms within the online advertising (AdTech) industry.
  • Auction & Optimization Expertise: Strong theoretical understanding and practical experience with auction theory (e.g., VCG, GSP), optimization algorithms, statistical modeling, and machine learning concepts relevant to ad targeting and ranking.
  • Advanced Analytical & Data Skills: Proven ability to independently query, manipulate, and analyze large, complex datasets. Proficiency with SQL and data analysis tools/languages (e.g., Python, R) is required.
  • Statistical Rigor: Deep understanding of applied statistics, experimental design (A/B testing), causal inference, and methods for measuring statistical significance and inferring long-term impact.
  • Educational Background: Strong quantitative background; Master's or PhD in Computer Science, Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Mathematics, or a related field is highly preferred.
  • Technical Fluency: Ability to engage deeply with engineers and data scientists on technical details of algorithms, system design, and data infrastructure.
  • Communication & Collaboration: Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to influence technical and non-technical stakeholders across various functions.
  • Problem Solving: Strong structured thinking and problem-solving abilities, capable of breaking down complex problems into actionable components.

What you'll get:

Cardinal Health is seeking a visionary and strategic Solution Architect to join a high-growth business unit with visibility to Executive leadership. Overview

The Platform Systems Analyst is responsible for analyzing, optimizing, and supporting enterprise platforms to ensure alignment between business needs and technical delivery. This role serves as a critical liaison between business stakeholders, product teams, and technical leads to translate requirements into actionable specifications that enable efficient execution.

This position focuses on requirements clarity, integration coordination, platform enhancements, and operational excellence within established architectural standards.

Responsibilities

Business & Requirements Analysis

  • Partner with business stakeholders to gather, document, and refine functional and technical requirements.
  • Lead discovery sessions to clarify business processes and system needs.
  • Produce high-quality documentation including business requirements, functional specifications, workflows, and use cases.
  • Identify gaps, edge cases, and downstream system impacts before development begins.

Platform Optimization & Enhancements

  • Support ongoing platform improvements and feature enhancements.
  • Analyze system usage, performance trends, and user feedback to recommend optimizations.
  • Coordinate user acceptance testing (UAT) and validate implemented solutions.

Integration & Cross-System Coordination

  • Document and analyze data flows between platforms and third-party systems.
  • Collaborate with architects and tech leads to ensure integration requirements are clearly defined.
  • Troubleshoot data and interface issues in partnership with technical teams.

Delivery Support

  • Work closely with tech leads during sprint planning and backlog refinement.
  • Ensure user stories and acceptance criteria are complete and testable.

Governance & Documentation

  • Maintain system documentation, process maps, and knowledge articles.
  • Ensure adherence to established architectural, security, and compliance standards.
  • Support audit and reporting requirements as needed.

jobs.description:
CompassMSP delivers managed IT and managed security services to clients across regulated and enterprise markets. We are scaling our security division, and we are building the governance, risk, and compliance function that will carry it. This role leads that function and reports directly to the CISO.
The mandate is broad by design. You will lead a multi framework compliance program spanning SOC 2 Type II, HITRUST CSF, and PCI DSS, with ISO 27001 on the roadmap behind them. You will select the platform configuration, the auditors, and the operating rhythm, and you will hire the team that runs it.
You will also take that capability to market. Our clients need managed compliance programs, not one time assessments, and we intend to be the provider that delivers them. Compliance-as-a-Service is a defined offering in our growth plan, and this role owns it.

Responsibilities

  • The enterprise policy and ISMS framework. Control mapped, maintained in Vanta, and governed by a formal annual review and approval cycle.
  • The enterprise risk register, the scoring methodology behind it, and quarterly risk reporting to the executive team and the board.
  • The certification roadmap. SOC 2 Type II, then HITRUST CSF and PCI DSS, with ISO 27001 to follow. You select the auditors, run the programs, and deliver the opinions.
  • The third party risk program, and a centralized response capability for inbound client security questionnaires across SIG Lite, CAIQ, and custom formats.
  • Compliance-as-a-Service. A tiered, recurring compliance offering for our client base, from SOC 2 readiness at the SMB end through multi framework managed compliance at the enterprise end. You design it, launch it, and grow it.
  • Compliance program support to our CMMC practice, which serves defense industrial base clients and is pursuing C3PAO authorization.
  • A seat on the Security Steering Committee alongside the CEO, CFO, CTO, and VP of Operations.

Requirements

  • Eight or more years in security, risk, or compliance, with at least three leading a GRC function or multi framework program.
  • Compliance program experience inside an MSP, MSSP, or another multi tenant service provider. This one matters. Service provider compliance is a different discipline from single enterprise compliance, and we are looking for someone who already knows the difference.
  • At least one SOC 2 Type II taken from readiness to clean opinion with you owning it.
  • Real depth in two or more of: HITRUST CSF, PCI DSS, NIST CSF, NIST SP 800-171 and CMMC, ISO 27001.
  • Hands on with a compliance automation platform. Vanta preferred, and you should be the person who configures the integrations, not the person who watches someone else do it.
  • Fluency with formal risk methodology and a track record of running a risk register that executives actually use to make decisions.
  • The ability to sit in front of a CEO or a board and explain risk as a business decision rather than a compliance demand.
  • Leadership experience. You have hired and developed analysts and you want to build a team, not just a program.
Nice to have

  • CISA, CRISC, CISM, or CISSP. HITRUST CCSFP. PCI ISA or QSA. CMMC RP or CCP.
  • You have built a compliance service that clients paid for, not only a program that satisfied auditors.
  • Private equity backed growth environment experience, including diligence support.

Benefits

  • Competitive pay
  • Quarterly Bonuses
  • Progressive PTO
  • Medical/Dental/Vision/Life/Disability available
  • Tax deferred retirement plan with company match
  • Career Development and Coaching
  • Fun work environment!
Our Commitment to Inclusion: Step into a role that respects your individuality and supports your growth. CompassMSP is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer.

CompassMSP is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. Salary range will reflect experience, location and other factors. This position is eligible for an annual bonus.
