jobs.excerpt: Wir sind Start to Finish. Kein Startup kann wachsen ohne das richtige Team.
jobs.description:
Wir sind Start to Finish.

Kein Startup kann wachsen ohne das richtige Team. Aus diesem Grund unterstützen wir aufstrebende Startups und Growth Companies wie Snocks, SellerX, Formary, Schema M und viele weitere dabei, ihre Schlüsselpositionen mit den richtigen Talenten zu besetzen.

Mit über 100 zufriedenen Kunden sind wir die #1 Recruiting Boutique für E-Commerce Startups im deutschsprachigen Raum.

Unser Kunde sucht Dich!

Als Senior Business Analyst & Finance Manager wirst du zum analytischen Sparringspartner der Geschäftsführung. Du übersetzt Finanz- und KPI-Daten – bereitgestellt über ein modernes Data Warehouse und die Dashboards eines Data Scientists – in klare, datenbasierte Entscheidungsvorlagen für Wachstum, Pricing und Profitabilität.

Du agierst dabei als „CFO-light"-Business-Partner: Nicht primär in der Buchhaltung, sondern als die Person, die aus sichtbar gemachten Zahlen konkrete Entscheidungen ableitet. Der Fokus liegt auf SaaS-spezifischen Business Analytics – insbesondere Kohortenanalysen (Retention, LTV und Payback je Kundenkohorte) und Product-Led-Growth-Metriken – sowie auf der Pricing-Strategie und der engen Zusammenarbeit mit Sales, Marketing, Product und Customer Success.

Ergänzt wird das durch ein schlankes Maß an BWA-/Kostencontrolling, Banking und die Qualitätssicherung der Buchhaltung – nicht jedoch das operative Tagesgeschäft der Buchhaltung selbst. Klassische Liquiditätsplanung spielt kaum eine Rolle: Durch den hohen Anteil an Jahreszahler:innen zahlen die Kund:innen im Voraus, wodurch typische Cash-vor-Leistung-Risiken entfallen.

Aufgaben

  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit dem Data Scientist: Übersetzung der bereitgestellten Dashboards und Datenbasis (Data Warehouse, CRM als Single Source of Truth) in konkrete Handlungsempfehlungen für die Geschäftsführung.
  • Analyse & Reporting: Regelmäßiges KPI-Reporting an die Geschäftsführung sowie Aufbau und Pflege von Kohortenanalysen und Umsatz-Forecasts auf PLG-Basis (keine Liquiditätsplanung, da durch Jahreszahler weitgehend irrelevant).
  • SaaS-spezifische Finanzsteuerung: Entwicklung und Aktualisierung von Pricing-Modellen, Reporting zu Preisänderungen und Monitoring der Wettbewerbssituation.
  • Monatliches Kosten-Screening & BWA-Aufbereitung: Detaillierte Analyse der Kostenpositionen und proaktives Aufzeigen von Optimierungsmöglichkeiten.
  • Stakeholder-Management: Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Sales (Provisionsberechnungen im CRM), Marketing (Tracking & Budgetfreigaben), Product (Produktmetriken) und Customer Success (Churn-Analyse).
  • Accounting- & Controlling-Optimierung: Enger Austausch mit dem Buchhaltungsteam, Prozessoptimierung und Prüfung gebuchter Positionen.
  • Koordination von Banken & Versicherungen: Verwaltung mehrerer Bankkonten und regelmäßige Prüfung von Anlagen (Tagesgeld, Versicherungen etc.).

Qualifikation

  • 2–5 Jahre Berufserfahrung in Business Analytics, FP&A, Finance oder Controlling
  • Nachweisbare Erfahrung darin, aus Rohdaten und Dashboards konkrete Geschäftsempfehlungen abzuleiten (Business-Analyst- oder FP&A-Hintergrund von Vorteil)
  • Verständnis von SaaS-KPIs, Recurring-Revenue-Modellen und SaaS-Kostenstrukturen
  • Erfahrung mit Kosten-/BWA-Controlling und finanziellem Forecasting
  • Sicherer Umgang mit KPIs, Reporting und datenbasierten Empfehlungen
  • Sicheres Englisch für eine mögliche Internationalisierung

Von Vorteil:

  • Erfahrung mit Kohortenanalysen (Retention, LTV, Payback) im SaaS- oder Subscription-Umfeld
  • BI-/Reporting-Tools (z. B. Power BI, Tableau, Looker, Evidence)
  • Verständnis von Product-Led-Growth-Modellen und deren Metriken
  • Vertrautheit mit Buchhaltungssoftware (z. B. DATEV) und Buchhaltungsprozessen
  • Erfahrung in dynamischen, skalierenden SaaS-Umgebungen

Benefits

  • 100 % remote – arbeite von überall, ohne Pendeln.
  • Ein wachsendes Unternehmen mit kurzen Wegen und schnellen Entscheidungen.
  • Willkommensbonus: Einmalig 300 € brutto – als Dankeschön für den erfolgreichen Start.
  • Flexibles Benefit-Budget: Jeden Monat 25 € steuerfrei – frei einsetzbar nach deinen persönlichen Bedürfnissen.
  • Betriebliche Altersvorsorge: Beteiligung mit einem 20%-Arbeitgeberzuschuss – für deine sichere Zukunft.

🚀 Bereit für den nächsten Step?

Dann bewirb dich jetzt - Wir freuen uns auf dich! 💡

Die angegebene Gehaltsrange basiert auf aktuellen Marktdaten und gibt dir eine realistische Orientierung. Am Ende hängt es aber von zwei Dingen ab: deiner tatsächlichen Qualifikation – und vor allem von unserem Kunden, der die finale Entscheidung trifft. Wir sind eine Vermittlung, kein Arbeitgeber – das heißt, wir können das Angebot nicht selbst festlegen.
Was wir aber können: dich bestmöglich beraten, dein Profil stark positionieren und gemeinsam mit dir schauen, was drin ist.

jobs.excerpt: About CoLabAt CoLab, we help mechanical engineering teams bring life-changing products to market years sooner.
jobs.description:
About CoLab

At CoLab, we help mechanical engineering teams bring life-changing products to market years sooner.
CoLab is the AI platform for driving stronger engineering decisions. Every design review in CoLab builds a knowledge repository of design feedback, decisions, and lessons learned - which AI agents draw from to flag issues on future designs before they compound. The more your team works in CoLab, the smarter it gets and the faster you arrive at the ideal design. Companies like Ford, Komatsu, and Johnson Controls use CoLab to catch issues earlier, eliminate rework cycles, and bring products to market faster.

Founded in St. John's, Newfoundland, CoLab has grown quickly from our first customer in 2019 to a rapidly scaling company. We've recently been recognized on Deloitte's Fast 50™ and Fast 500™, and named a Canadian company to watch by The Globe and Mail and Financial Post.

About the Role

Modern engineering teams invest a significant amount of time and money on simulation. Before anything gets built, teams need confidence that a design is going to work: structurally, thermally, aerodynamically, etc. Simulation is one of the main ways they build that confidence.

But the way teams share and review simulation results to make decisions is still pretty broken. Engineers are exporting videos, taking screenshots, dropping them into PowerPoint, and then trying to make decisions through email threads, meetings, or disconnected slide decks. The actual decision-making ends up separated from the underlying simulation data, which means context gets lost, feedback is hard to trace, and important engineering knowledge disappears into the workflow.

CoLab already helps engineering teams review CAD, capture feedback, and make better design decisions in one connected workspace. Now we’re extending that same idea into simulation. The goal is simple: make simulation results collaborative, reviewable, and traceable in the same way CoLab does for CAD today.

We’re starting a new product team focused on bringing simulation review into CoLab. As one of the first engineers on that team, you’ll help define how simulation data gets ingested, visualized, discussed, and connected back to real engineering decisions. There are a lot of interesting technical problems here: large datasets, high-performance visualization, viewer interactions, data pipelines, and user experiences that need to work for mechanical engineers doing critical product development work.

The first phase is about learning the product, the customers, and the review workflows we already support today. You’ll spend time embedded with our Engineering Reviews team, learning how engineers collaborate in CoLab, where the current product is strong, and where simulation creates a new set of problems we need to solve. From there, you’ll help build the foundation for a new Simulation team - not just technically, but from a product perspective as well. We want to build something customers actually need and will use in their day-to-day work, and that requires a highly product oriented approach.

Our Ideal Candidate

You're the kind of developer who wants to understand why a feature matters before deciding how to build it.

You enjoy owning complex technical problems, but you also enjoy talking with product managers, designers, and customers to understand what success actually looks like. You make thoughtful technical decisions independently and know when to bring others into the conversation.

Experience working with simulation software is a significant advantage. Maybe you've worked with FEA, CFD, multiphysics simulations, scientific visualization, or engineering data platforms. You understand the kinds of problems engineers are trying to solve.

This is a good fit for someone who likes ambiguity, wants to work closely with our product and leadership teams, and cares about the connection between technical decisions and customer value. You’ll have a meaningful role in shaping both the architecture and the user experience for a new capability that we think can become a major part of engineering review in CoLab.

What You'll Do

  • Help design and build CoLab's next-generation simulation review capabilities.
  • Build services that ingest and process simulation data from industry-standard engineering software.
  • Develop high-performance visualization experiences capable of displaying large simulation datasets.
  • Partner closely with Product, Design, and customers to validate ideas before building them.
  • Spend time embedded with the Engineering Reviews team to develop deep product and customer understanding before transitioning onto the Simulation team.
  • Contribute to architectural decisions that will shape this product area for years to come.
  • Improve performance, scalability, and reliability as simulation capabilities grow.
  • Collaborate with engineers across the platform to ensure simulation becomes a seamless part of the broader CoLab experience.

Qualifications

We're looking for someone with:

  • 8+ years building production software in a modern engineering environment.
  • Strong experience designing scalable backend systems and customer-facing applications.
  • Experience building complex data visualization or graphics-intensive applications.
  • The ability to work independently while collaborating closely with teammates.
  • A product mindset - you think about customer outcomes as much as technical implementation.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to explain complex ideas clearly.
  • Experience with Finite Element Analysis (FEA), CFD, or other CAE workflows.
  • Experience with engineering simulation platforms
  • Experience with CAD, PLM, or engineering software development.
  • Large engineering datasets and high-performance rendering.

The Extra Details

  • Full-time, permanent position with a competitive compensation package, including stock options.
  • Extended health benefits, unlimited paid vacation, and RRSP/401K matching.
  • Remote-first across North America

Equity Note

Frequently cited statistics show that people who identify with historically marginalized groups are likely to apply to jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. We encourage you to help us break that statistic and apply even if you don't meet every single qualification - your potential is what matters most to us.

We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.

Do you have a passion for engaging with people and helping them on their journey to better health? Signify Health, part of CVS Health®, is seeking a Part Time Physician to provide In-Home Health Evaluations, engaging with people in the comfort of their own homes and helping bridge gaps in care.

You’ll play a critical role in building trusted relationships to make people healthier, helping bring flexible, comprehensive and personalized health evaluations right to people’s front doors.

Job highlights

The visit, which lasts about 45 minutes, allows for time to connect one-on-one and answer health questions. It includes a medication and medical history review, a physical evaluation, and, if ordered by the person’s health plan, additional diagnostic tests (i.e., diabetic eye exams, spirometry, etc.). You’ll use an iPad and an intuitive clinical workflow for each evaluation and are not required to prescribe medicine, order lab tests or alter people’s current treatment regimen.

In this role, you will:

  • Bring your heart into every visit, joining a national network of purpose-driven clinicians dedicated to improving health outcomes

  • Be part of our efforts to visit millions of people nationwide with the goal of providing connections to the right care for people’s unique needs

  • Work with Signify Health as a clinician colleague, fulfilling the requirements of the specified role

  • Be flexible to travel locally and within licensed states, as needed

  • Conduct virtual visits as needed

  • Provide all Signify Health services as indicated including Diagnostic & Preventive Services products (i.e., spirometry, DEE, bone density screening, etc.)

A Note on Our Work Environment:

As an in-home clinician, your primary workplace is the private residence of health plan members. We are dedicated to meeting health plan members where they are, wherever they call home. These environments are diverse and may present a variety of conditions. Candidates must be able to comfortably and safely perform their duties in homes that may contain household pets, secondhand smoke and other potential airborne allergens or irritants.

Why Clinicians Enjoy Working with Signify Health
“Many of the people I see are shocked that a physician is coming to their home to visit with them one-on-one. When you sit down and have an unhurried conversation about their health, they are impressed, happy, and understand that their health plan and care team cares about them.” - M.L., MD

“The primary care physician gets a snapshot of a person in an office setting, but with Signify Health, we see things like the number of steps to enter their home, the state of disrepair those steps may be in, and the person’s ability to function comfortably and with ease in their own home. We can make referrals to the individual’s health plan, encourage the participation of their loved ones, and ensure their PCPs are aware of their health and overall quality of life.” - C.H., MD

  • Supplies and other perks

  • Multi-state licenses (preferred)

Our people fuel our future. Our teams reflect the customers, patients, members and communities we serve and we are committed to fostering a workplace where every colleague feels valued and that they belong.

The Special Programs team delivers high-impact, fast-paced services that help organizations accelerate their compliance journey. Unlike our standard offerings, Special Programs are purpose-built engagements designed to solve specific customer challenges, from establishing a compliance foundation in 30 days to migrating organizations onto new GRC platforms, supporting audits, and delivering other specialized compliance services.

For many customers, Special Programs represent their first experience working with Workstreet. Because of that, we are laser-focused on speed, quality, and an exceptional customer experience that builds trust from day one. We support hundreds of organizations, from early-stage startups to global enterprises, across nearly every industry.

Workstreet is seeking a Senior Manager, GRC Engineering (Special Programs) to serve as the operational owner of a high-visibility, customer-facing delivery organization. Reporting directly to the Director of Special Programs, you will drive the day-to-day success of the program while guiding a team of 30 to 40 consultants managed through 4 to 5 direct-report managers. In this strategic capacity, you will ensure delivery remains on schedule, enforce rigorous quality standards across the management layer, and address operational risks before they affect client outcomes.

  • Deep compliance domain authority - hold 8+ years of cybersecurity compliance expertise across SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI DSS, HITRUST, and NIST 800-171 or CMMC frameworks.
  • Policy framework architect - demonstrate 8+ years of hands-on experience authoring, implementing, and enforcing enterprise cybersecurity policies.
  • Disciplined operational operator - prove sound judgment under pressure with a bias toward taking immediate ownership and solving issues independently rather than escalating upward.
  • High-velocity startup performer - thrive in fast-paced cybersecurity environments, possessing the organizational discipline to manage multiple concurrent compliance programs seamlessly.

What will help you succeed

  • Big 4 advisory tenure - background in management consulting, assurance, or advisory practice within Big 4 or top-tier consulting firms.
  • MSSP or GRC leadership experience - proven track record managing GRC delivery functions within a managed security service provider or specialized consulting organization.
  • Advanced security certifications - active professional certifications such as CISA, CISSP, CISM, ISO 27001 Lead Implementer, or CRISC.
  • GRC automation platform mastery - practical exposure to configuring and managing automated compliance platforms such as Vanta, Drata, or Secureframe.
  • Multi-framework audit expertise - deep familiarity with risk management frameworks and complex audit methodologies across diverse regulatory standards.

jobs.title: Director, Product Design (AI Builder)
jobs.excerpt: What the Role IsRegistry is the heart of Babylist – how we help growing families feel prepared during one of life's most consequential transitions, and the acquisition and commercial engine powering the rest of our business.
jobs.description:
What the Role Is

Registry is the heart of Babylist – how we help growing families feel prepared during one of life's most consequential transitions, and the acquisition and commercial engine powering the rest of our business.

We're hiring a design leader to own it.

This role is the durable design and experience owner for Registry, accountable for the UX, vision, KPIs, and quality bar that define how it feels. You translate company goals into clear priorities so your org always knows what to work on and why. You take bold bets, pushing past safe incrementalism to make the case for step-function improvements — advocating for customers' long-term needs while ensuring business impact. You epitomize being a builder: getting into the work, codebase, and data directly rather than delegating, standing up prototypes and contributing to production-quality interfaces when that's fastest. You partner with engineers, PMs, and analysts as peer-builders, setting the standard for what an AI-native designer creates. You shape the craft standards and operating model that define Design at Babylist, leading the team's transition to AI-native product development at scale.

Reports to the VP, Head of Product Design and Research; sits on the Consumer Tech Leadership team; leads 3–4 product designers.

Who You Are

  • Strategic visionary. You combine user needs, business priorities, and sharp product and design sense into an inspirational vision that articulates the future, allowing the org to work backward with clarity and strategic focus.
  • Craft and experience obsessed. You care deeply about how things feel, not just how they function. You polish the details like transitions, motion, and accessibility. You hold a high bar for delight and have a portfolio of shipped consumer product work across web and native mobile that demonstrates this.
  • Systems thinker. You see the full picture. You think about how a single interaction fits into a broader experience, how Registry flows connect across the Babylist ecosystem, and how the design system enables all of it.
  • AI-native practitioner-leader. You use AI tools to prototype, explore, and iterate at speed. You stay close to the craft, review work at depth, and can build when building is the fastest path to impact. You lead from a place of real craft knowledge and hands-on understanding of what it takes to ship.
  • Human-and-data-centered. You know how to leverage (and plan and run) generative and evaluative research to unlock actionable insights that guide product decisions. You bring concrete qualitative and quantitative evidence into design decisions and share clear, persuasive design rationale via concise and impactful communication.
  • Industry aware and pattern fluent. You stay current with modern product design to borrow what's proven and challenge what's stale. You know the interaction patterns, design system conventions, and digital product best practices that have become table stakes, and when to apply them or evolve them.
  • Clear and critical thinker. You cut through complexity with thoughtful synthesis of competing inputs, stress-testing assumptions, and communicate your point of view with extreme clarity. You don't mistake collaboration for consensus and encourage productive conflict, preferring to surface misalignment early to accelerate and de-risk decisions.
  • Outcome owner. You don't celebrate shipping, you own impact. You instrument your own work, track whether it's moving the right metrics, and hold yourself and your org accountable for meaningful results.
  • People leader. You hire, develop, retain, and inspire a team of designers. You give direct, honest feedback, manage performance with care and clarity, and create an environment where designers do their best work.
  • Operational leader. You build and maintain the systems, rituals, and processes that allow your team to execute with quality and consistency. You know the difference between process that enables and process that burdens, and you make deliberate choices about both.
  • Adaptable to change. You select for change, not against it. You jump in where needed, working across team boundaries without waiting for permission. You are humble, low-ego, and biased toward action. You bring curiosity to ambiguity, not anxiety.
  • Excited about the AI transformation. You believe this is the most interesting moment in modern design careers, and you want to help shape what an AI-first design organization looks like both at Babylist and as a category.

How You Will Make An Impact

  • Own the Registry experience end-to-end. Think holistically about user flows, brand expression, information architecture, and interaction patterns across the full Babylist cross-platform ecosystem. You are accountable for the quality and outcomes of everything your team ships.
  • Lead with equal parts vision, strategy, and execution. Connect design vision to company strategy and business goals. Articulate where the Registry experience should be in 12-18 months and, together with your PM and Engineering peers, set strategy by defining the sequence of bets that get us there while earning organizational alignment.
  • Define excellence. Set the bar for quality, delight, and product excellence by demonstrating and teaching the organization what great looks and feels like. Eschew perfection for learning that propels the product toward your high bar.
  • Stay deeply connected to users and the work. Plan and execute research to ground design decisions in how families actually behave. Lead from a place of real craft knowledge and hands-on understanding of what it takes to ship.
  • Operate with agency. Don't wait for permission. Create the conditions for your and your team's success. Bias toward action, starting before you have the full picture and bringing others along as you learn. Hold yourself and others accountable and avoid attributing setbacks to external conditions.
  • Serve as a model for AI-first Design at Babylist. Use AI-native workflows in your own work, ship things yourself, and help define the rituals and practices that the rest of the function will adopt.
  • Scale design democratization. Build AI-enabled workflows that bring others into design tools, creating the conditions for non-designers to contribute meaningfully to the experience layer. Act as a consultant and quality bar on that work, not a gatekeeper.
  • Build a high-performing design team. Hire, develop, retain, and organize designers that execute with speed and quality. Create a growth-mindset-fueled environment where designers do their best work. Manage performance directly and invest in the career growth of everyone on your team.
  • Multiply your team. Be an excellent partner to engineering, product management, analytics, marketing, and merchandising leaders as co-builders to move the highest-impact work forward. Bring tighter problem framing, sharper user insight, and prototypes that make decisions easier to make.
  • Contribute to the shape of the Consumer Tech organization. Work with the VP of Product Design, your peers, and other leaders across Tech to evolve our operating model, our hiring bar, and our craft standards as the team transitions.

About Compensation

We use a market-based approach to compensation. The starting salary range for this role is:

$244,600 to $305,700 + target 22.5% annual bonus + competitive equity

Your starting salary will be based on your location, experience, and qualifications, with increases over time tied to performance, role growth, and internal pay equity.

Who We Are

Babylist is the leading platform for expecting and new families. More than 10 million people shop with Babylist every year, making it the go-to destination for seamless purchasing, guidance, and expert recommendations. As a modern, AI-forward tech company, Babylist has expanded from a universal registry into a full ecosystem — the Babylist Shop, Babylist Health, Babylist Money, NYC and LA showrooms, branded content, and more — generating $750M in revenue in 2025. Building the generational brand in baby, Babylist is reshaping the $235B kids and baby market and helping parents feel confident, connected, and cared for at every step.

Our Ways of Working

Babylist is remote-first with team members across the U.S. and Canada who move fast, think smart, and use AI as part of how they work every day — not as an experiment, as an expectation. We come together twice a year to build the relationships behind the work, and we hire people who are genuinely excited about what's possible and prove it through how they show up.

Why You Will Love Working At Babylist

Our Culture

  • We work with focus and intention, then step away to recharge
  • We believe in exceptional management and invest in tools and opportunities to connect with colleagues
  • We build products that positively impact millions of people's lives
  • AI is intentionally embedded in how we work, create, and scale—supporting innovation and impact

Growth & Development

  • Competitive pay and meaningful opportunities for career advancement
  • We believe technology and data can solve hard problems
  • We're committed to career progression and performance-based advancement

Compensation & Benefits

  • Competitive salary with equity and bonus opportunities
  • Company-paid medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • Retirement savings plan with company matching and flexible spending accounts
  • Generous paid parental leave and PTO
  • Remote work stipend to set up your office
  • Perks for physical, mental, and emotional health, parenting, childcare, and financial planning

Important Notices

Recorded Interviews. Babylist uses an interview recording tool to record and transcribe interviews for evaluation purposes in accordance with applicable privacy laws. By participating in an interview, you consent to this recording and transcription.

Interview Integrity. AI is part of how we work at Babylist — we expect you to use it too. Your application and interviews should still reflect you and your own thinking. We'll tell you when AI is encouraged. Misrepresentation at any stage may result in removal from consideration for this and future roles.

Connections at Babylist. If you have a family member or close personal relationship with a current Babylist employee, please let your recruiter know. This helps us keep our process fair and transparent for everyone.

Protect Yourself from Scams. All official outreach comes from the Babylist Talent Team via @babylist.com email addresses only. We will never ask for payment or personal financial information. If you receive outreach via WhatsApp, Telegram, or a non-Babylist email — it's not us. Verify open roles at babylist.com/careers.

About Upwind

Upwind is a next-generation Cloud Security Platform that leverages runtime context to identify and prioritize critical risks, providing precise insights and efficient cloud security management. With industry-leading efficiency and eBPF-powered sensors, Upwind delivers comprehensive capabilities including agentless cloud posture discovery, real-time threat protection, and integrated API security. We are one of the fastest-growing companies in cloud and AI security, and we're building the GTM engine to match.

The opportunity

Upwind's sales org is scaling fast, and the operational layer that keeps it running needs to scale with it. This role is the embedded operational engine for our North America sales team: the daily partner to sales managers and reps, and the trusted operating proxy for the Head of Revenue Operations in the North America sales org.

You won't be supporting the sales org from a distance. You'll sit inside it: in the forecast calls, in the pipeline reviews, in the deal moments where process and speed decide outcomes. You'll own the operating rhythm, keep the forecast honest, and unblock sellers so they can spend their time selling. This is a high-ownership, high-visibility seat for someone who wants to run a function, not a queue.

You'll join the Revenue Operations team spanning business systems, GTM engineering, analytics, and embedded sales operations. Foundations exist: operating cadences, systems architecture, and reporting infrastructure are already in place and working. Your job is to take ownership of the field, strengthen what's there, and build the next layer with the team.

Responsibilities

  1. The North America sales partnership. Be the go-to operational partner for our VP of North America Sales, frontline managers, and reps. You are the first call on process, systems, deal mechanics, territory, and data questions, and you resolve them the same day wherever possible.
  2. The weekly operating rhythm. Run the cadence that keeps the business honest: pipeline hygiene reviews, forecast call preparation and follow-through, and the weekly leadership rollup. Own forecast accuracy tracking and drive the discipline behind it.
  3. Real-time problem solving and deal support. Debug and resolve process breakdowns as they happen (quoting, approvals, CRM, routing, commission questions triaged to the right owner), keeping sellers focused on revenue-generating activity. Support deal mechanics day to day: order forms, quoting workflows, and support on non-standard terms.
  4. Business rhythm and insight. Maintain a daily pulse on pipeline health, forecast accuracy, and key KPIs. Build new field-facing Salesforce dashboards and partner on existing reporting. Lead QBR preparation and synthesize data into insights that change decisions, not just decks.
  5. Process design at scale. Identify operational gaps and bring the field's usage perspective to workflow design, partnering with our Business Systems and GTM Engineering teams. Document as you go: playbooks, workflows, and CRM standards that survive beyond you. Reinforce forecasting discipline, pipeline hygiene, and data governance across the sales org.
  6. The cross-functional bridge. Push RevOps initiatives into the field and carry field feedback back. Partner closely with GTM Enablement on rollouts, onboarding support, and adoption of the GTM stack (Salesforce, Clari, Slack), so tools and programs actually land with reps.

Requirements

  • 5 to 7 years in Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, or Consulting; B2B SaaS at a high-growth company strongly preferred.
  • High ownership and bias to action. You don't wait to be asked, and you close loops without follow-up.
  • Seller empathy with operator discipline. You understand how reps and managers actually work, and you build process that helps rather than polices.
  • Builder's comfort with ambiguity. You've created structure where none existed and are eager to do it again.
  • Team-first humility. You come in curious, learn why things are built the way they are, and strengthen what works rather than rebuilding for its own sake. You'd rather make the team better than make your mark.
  • Excited to build with AI. Direct experience isn't required, but you should be genuinely eager to use AI in your daily work and to help design AI-powered workflows for the sales org.
  • Hands-on Salesforce fluency: building reports and dashboards, managing data, and driving CRM adoption. Clari or similar forecasting tools a plus.
  • Analytical rigor with strong Excel or Google Sheets skills; you find where the funnel leaks and quantify the fix.
  • Executive-ready communication. You can turn a messy operational picture into three bullets a VP acts on today.
  • Leader mindset. You've mentored teammates, raised the bar for people around you, or led initiatives across functions without formal authority. People naturally look to you when work needs organizing.

Mindrift is looking for highly skilled Web Scraping specialists to join the Tendem project () and drive specialized data scraping workflows for real-world use cases.

Mindrift is looking for highly skilled Python Data Scraping Engineers to join the Tendem project and drive specialized data scraping workflows for real-world applications.

In this role, you'll apply your expertise in web scraping, data extraction, and data processing to deliver accurate, reliable, and high-quality results. This part-time remote opportunity is ideal for technical professionals with hands-on experience in web scraping, data extraction, and processing.

What We Do

The Mindrift platform connects specialists with innovative technology projects. Our mission is to help develop high-quality AI technologies by combining real-world expertise from professionals across the globe with advanced AI development efforts.

About the Role

This is a freelance role for a Tendem project. As a Python Data Scraping Engineer, you'll handle data scraping tasks requiring technical precision for web extraction and processing, utilizing tools such as Apify, OpenRouter, and other technologies, alongside your own technical expertise and approaches.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own end-to-end data extraction workflows across complex websites, ensuring complete coverage, accuracy, and reliable delivery of structured datasets.
  • Leverage available tools and custom workflows to accelerate data collection, validation, and task execution while meeting defined requirements.
  • Ensure reliable extraction from dynamic and interactive web sources, adapting approaches as needed to handle JavaScript-rendered content and changing site behavior.
  • Enforce data quality standards through validation checks, cross-source consistency controls, adherence to formatting specifications, and systematic verification prior to delivery.
  • Scale scraping operations for large datasets using efficient batching or parallelization, monitor failures, and maintain stability against minor site structure changes.

Educational qualifications

  • At least 3+ years of relevant experience in data engineering, web scraping, automation, or software development (required).
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Computer Science, or related technical fields is a plus.

Academic and/or Professional Experience

Candidates should have a strong technical foundation and practical experience with scripting, automation, and data extraction workflows. We are looking for specialists who can solve non-trivial problems, work confidently with modern web technologies and data processing tools, and systematically collect, structure, and validate data from diverse sources. A methodical, detail-oriented approach and the ability to work independently are essential.

Technical Skills (Essential)

  • Strong experience in Python web scraping (BeautifulSoup, Selenium or similar), including dynamic content (JS, AJAX, infinite scroll) and APIs via proxies
  • Proven ability to extract data from complex structures (hierarchies, archived pages, inconsistent HTML)
  • Solid background in data cleaning, normalization, and validation, delivering structured datasets (CSV, JSON, Google Sheets)

Additional requirements

  • Hands-on experience with LLMs and AI frameworks to enhance automation and problem-solving
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy
  • Self-directed work ethic with ability to troubleshoot independently
  • A link to GitHub is a plus
  • English proficiency: Upper-intermediate (B2) or above (required)

Project time expectations

For this project, tasks are estimated to require around 10–20 hours per week during active phases, based on project requirements. This is an estimate, not a guaranteed workload, and applies only while the project is active.

Compensation

On this project, contributors can earn up to $20 per hour equivalent, depending on their level and pace of contribution.

Compensation varies across projects depending on scope, complexity, and required expertise. Please note that other projects on the platform may offer different earning levels based on their requirements.

jobs.description:
Data Scientist

Location: Remote -

Dublin, Ireland

Reporting to: Head of Product (US-based)

Team: Product

Supply Wisdom is the industry pioneer in real-time, continuous risk intelligence, helping global enterprises proactively manage third-party and location risk. Our AI-powered SaaS platform delivers always-on monitoring across critical domains including cyber, financial, operational, ESG, compliance, and geopolitical risk. By providing early risk signals and contextual insights, we empower clients to reduce risk exposure, avoid disruptions, lower costs, and drive faster decision-making.

Supply Wisdom serves some of the world's most risk-mature organizations: Fortune 100 and Global 2000 leaders in banking, insurance, healthcare, and technology. We are a values-driven team guided by integrity, transparency, vigilance, diversity, and competitiveness, with one mission: advance our platform into the mission-critical system for enterprise resilience.

The Role

Supply Wisdom is hiring a Data Scientist to join our Product team, working directly on the models, pipelines, and data infrastructure that power our risk intelligence platform. You'll join our existing data science function and report to the Head of Product, contributing across everything from predictive risk models to production data pipelines to customer-facing analytical questions.

This is a hands-on, individual-contributor role for someone who can take a problem, own it end to end, and drive it to a working outcome without needing to be managed step by step. You'll move fluidly between statistical modeling, ML engineering, and data pipeline work, exercising judgment about which approach best fits the problem rather than defaulting to one tool. We're looking for someone who treats delivery as iterative rather than a single big push to get it perfect.

You’ll be joining a growing local team in Ireland. You may occasionally be asked to join in-person work sessions at a local workspace.

What You'll Do

  • Take on ambiguous, open-ended problems (e.g. "improve target coverage in this risk domain" or "reduce false positive rate for this classifier") and independently structure an approach, build it, and iterate toward a working solution.
  • Design, build, and maintain data pipelines and ML models that identify, detect, and quantify risk intelligence across financial, cyber, operational, ESG, and compliance domains.
  • Prepare, clean, and structure large and often messy datasets for modeling, exercising judgment on where automation, direct data integration, or LLM-based approaches each make the most sense.
  • Build and continuously refine predictive and classification models (e.g. credibility scoring, urgency/severity classification, entity resolution), evaluating performance against real outcomes and iterating based on data-driven feedback.
  • Engage directly with product, engineering, and occasionally customer-facing stakeholders to translate business and methodology questions (e.g. model bias, data confidence, coverage limitations) into clear technical answers and solutions.
  • Use Python and standard data science/ML libraries alongside strong database and querying skills to move fluidly from data prep to modeling to production.
  • Proactively evaluate and adopt new tools and techniques, including AI-assisted workflows, to accelerate your own delivery rather than defaulting to manual or established methods.
  • Document your methodology, code, and data schemas clearly enough that teammates and stakeholders can build on your work.

What Sets You Apart

Beyond the technical skill set, this role calls for a specific working style:

  • Self-driven: given a goal, you figure out the path there. You don't need the problem broken into sub-tasks before you can start.
  • Outcome-oriented and iterative: you'd rather ship a working first version, get it in front of real data or feedback, and revise than spend extra time trying to perfect the approach before anything ships.

Required

  • Background supporting multi-location businesses or coordinating content across multiple teams

4–6 Monate: Du verantwortest die Monatsabschlüsse in DATEV, standardisierst zentrale Buchhaltungsprozesse und entwickelst diese kontinuierlich weiter.

jobs.title: Pessoa Especialista Arquiteta de Solução
jobs.excerpt: Você será responsável por compreender o negócio do banco e atuar em uma estrutura ágil (tribos e squads), contribuindo para a construção de visões de negócio e soluções que suportem os objetivos estratégicos da companhia.
jobs.description:
Você será responsável por compreender o negócio do banco e atuar em uma estrutura ágil (tribos e squads), contribuindo para a construção de visões de negócio e soluções que suportem os objetivos estratégicos da companhia.
  • Construir visões de negócio, conduzindo cerimônias de mapeamento de fluxo de valor, capacidades, funcionalidades e processos para entendimento do estado atual (AS IS);
  • Definir e propor soluções de alto nível com base em padrões, pilares e referências de arquitetura;
  • Projetar arquiteturas escaláveis e alinhadas às inovações tecnológicas;
  • Capturar a mentalidade tecnológica adotada para resolver problemas de negócio;
  • Definir padrões arquiteturais e orientar como as aplicações serão estruturadas, seus módulos e interações;
  • Disseminar conhecimento entre times de negócio e engenharia.

Dá uma olhada nos desafios que te esperam como Pessoa Especialista Arquiteta de Solução aqui no BV:

  • Criar, manter e evoluir o portfólio de soluções padrão, alinhado à arquitetura corporativa, políticas internas e melhores práticas de mercado;
  • Antecipar necessidades do negócio a partir do roadmap de produtos e serviços;
  • Simplificar conceitos complexos e comunicá-los de forma clara e lógica;
  • Identificar oportunidades de reuso de componentes, APIs e plataformas, engajando os times a reutilizar ou adaptar soluções existentes;
  • Definir e acompanhar KPIs de arquitetura e reuso;
  • Conduzir POCs para validação de novas tecnologias ou diferentes casos de uso;
  • Atuar de forma integrada com arquitetos de Negócio, Solução, Software, Integração, Segurança e Dados, participando ativamente do Chapter de Arquitetura;
  • Analisar e definir capacidades core junto às áreas de negócio;
  • Construir visões de negócio e de solução;
  • Identificar dependências entre iniciativas e oportunidades de sinergia técnica e funcional;
  • Atuar como interface entre Negócio e TI, identificando oportunidades de otimização em componentes, projetos e funcionalidades;
  • Definir padrões de desenvolvimento e orientar o time de engenharia por meio de componentes e artefatos arquiteturais;
  • Participar da definição de escopo dos projetos, padrões de arquitetura e propostas de integração entre sistemas;
  • Criar e documentar desenhos de arquitetura, considerando requisitos funcionais e não funcionais;
  • Mapear integrações com produtos, áreas de TI e fornecedores;
  • Avaliar novos componentes e revisar fluxos existentes para otimização contínua;
  • Contribuir para a evolução de conceitos, práticas e tecnologias adotadas pelo Banco.

E aí, se identificou? Agora gostaríamos de saber se você tem o perfil e os conhecimentos abaixo:

  • Frameworks de arquitetura: BIAN, IASA, TOGAF, Zachman, CBAP, BizBok;
  • Modelos e ferramentas de documentação de arquitetura: C4 Model, ArchiMate, Bizzdesign;
  • Modelos de gestão de negócios: BSC, Canvas, SWOT, Ishikawa, BABOK;
  • Metodologias ágeis;
  • Design Patterns, DDD, APIs REST, ESB e Cloud-Native Applications;
  • Arquitetura Reativa (Responsive, Resilient, Elastic e Message Driven);
  • Arquitetura de Microserviços (service discovery, configuration management, logging, circuit breaker, containers, auto-scaling e Service Mesh).

Pra gente conta como diferencial se você tiver:

    Conhecimento ou experiência anterior com temas relacionados a Seguradoras ou Bancos (Conta Corrente)

  • Entender profundamente como as queries funcionam para poder auxiliar o time de desenvolvimento a otimizar códigos, procedures e triggers;
  • Resolver problema rapidamente usando ferramentas como Extended Events, Query Store, DMVs (Dynamic Management Views) ou Profiler;
  • Analisar tendências de crescimento de dados, planejar o capacity planning e sugerir upgrades de infraestrutura ou arquivamento de dados históricos;
  • Usar PowerShell ou scripts T-SQL para automatizar tarefas repetitivas (como checagem de integridade com dbatools/DBCC CHECKDB e reindexação).
  • Gerenciar ambientes SQL Server
  • Planejar e executar:
  • Estratégias de backup e restore
  • Planos de manutenção de índices e estatísticas
  • Instalação e configuração do SQL Server
  • Administrar segurança:
  • Permissões por objeto
  • Princípio do menor privilégio
  • Criptografia básica (TDE, backups criptografados)
  • Atuar na análise e solução de problemas de performance
  • Utilizar Query Store para:
  • Identificação de regressões de plano
  • Forçar planos quando necessário
  • Utilizar Profiler e Extended Events para troubleshooting
  • Replicação:
  • Replicação transacional
  • Replicação snapshot
  • Bi-direcional
  • Apoiar melhorias de arquitetura de banco de dados
  • Trabalhar junto às equipes de desenvolvimento

Conhecimentos Técnicos Esperados

  • Arquitetura da engine (Buffer Pool, TempDB, logs)
  • Tipos de índices e estatísticas
  • Performance
  • Análise de waits e locks
  • Tuning de queries
  • Análise de planos de execução
  • Query Store e Extended Events
  • Análise de queries de alto custo
  • Replicação
  • Conceitos, monitoramento e troubleshooting
  • Segurança
  • TDE, certificados, permissões granulares
  • Sistema Operacional:
  • Windows Server (I/O, memória, CPU)
  • Linux
  • Storage
  • Conceitos de RAID
  • Latência, IOPS, throughput
  • Modelagem Física:
  • Chaves, índices e estruturas físicas adequadas ao workload
  • Rede
  • DNS, gateway

Perfil Desejado

  • Autonomia técnica;
  • Boa comunicação com áreas de negócio e desenvolvimento;
  • Visão analítica e foco em estabilidade.

Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Superior completo
  • Inglês intermediário
  • Espanhol básico
  • Conhecimento em Postgree e Oracle será um diferencial
  • Conhecimento em Power BI
  • Conhecimento em Pentaho
  • Conhecimento em Zabbix e Grafana
  • Certificações em SQL Server
  • 7 anos de experiência mínima em banco de dados SQL Server

Job Description:

Role Overview

This position applies developed subject matter expertise to solve unique and moderately complex health and safety, and environmental implementation and leading HSE issues within established site-specific Health and Safety, and Environmental (HSE) Plans and recommends appropriate solutions or alternative methods ensuring compliance. Acts as a Construction Management Team (CMT) member, providing HSE oversight on all construction activities, along with facilitating team HSE decision making. Does not require day-to-day supervision and has the ability to resolve most issues but may seek advice in order to make more complex decisions. Must be able to travel and work remotely as required for project support.

Key Responsibilities

  • Acts as a technical advisor to project’s CMT and contractors and Fluence Commissioning teams.

  • Independently determines approaches and develops solutions to resolve HSE Specific Site issues.

  • Performs continual monitoring of equipment, structures, and work in progress to ensure required health and safety, and environmental plans for the project and all applicable regulations, codes and standards are followed.

  • Stops work when unsafe and determines appropriate corrective and preventative action to be taken and completed prior to restarting.

  • Performs daily and weekly safety walk of the ongoing construction work and provides direct feedback to the working group.

  • Established a weekly inspection/assessment schedule with each contractor working at site. and ensure corrective and preventative actions are implemented.

  • Develops and conducts project H&S and environmental orientation sessions for all persons working or entering the project site and maintains training records.

  • Plans, conducts, or coordinates necessary training programs to promote knowledge of and conformity with health and safety, and environmental issues per phase of construction.

  • Ensures industrial hygiene and environmental monitoring is performed as necessary and instrumentation equipment is maintained.

  • Leads, coordinates, and participates in RCA investigations of near misses, injuries, unsafe conditions, and incidents that do or could involve actual or potential liability; maintain records of pertinent data and compile required analysis reports on such investigations.

  • Attends contractor tailboard meetings, pre job briefings and JSA review meetings.

  • Leads and develops content for project weekly safety meeting with CMT and contractor management participation.

  • Assists and/or maintains the Fluence online project HSE data base: (safety walks, stop work, incidents/events, training, etc.).

  • Assist and/or develop project related H&S and environmental programs as may be required for project compliance with local, state, or federal regulations.

  • Assist and/or develop training curriculum and conduct required training sessions to educate employees on the safe and compliant work practices associated with project activities.

  • Completes other task as assigned

Administration and Communications Requirements:

  • Plans and manages work activities for themselves to accomplish project goals and objectives.

  • Ensures H&S and environmental plans are comprehensive and effective in meeting established goals and objectives.

  • Handles multiple priorities requiring frequent interpretation of programs and procedures.

  • Interprets, explains, advises, and makes recommendations on moderately complex issues to CMT and contractor employees.

  • Strong team and leadership skills, with the ability to mentor, coach, and guide others.

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills for effectively communicating with internal and external customers.

  • Ability to build strong relationships both internally and externally is a key priority.

  • Must be proficient in Microsoft word, excel and power point programs.

Analytical and Technical Requirements:

  • Requires original and innovative thinking in developing results or recommending process improvement.

  • Ability to analyze technical and regulatory information, make sound judgments, and provide prudent recommendations.

  • Regularly make decisions that are covered by general methods and procedures requiring frequent interpretations of programs and processes.

  • Conducts predictive trend analysis to determine corrective and preventative actions on negative indicators.

  • Thorough knowledge in the field of health and safety, as well as general environmental regulations for the construction industry.

  • Develop, implement, and evaluate programs and procedures in areas i.e. high-risk activities: working at height, lifting & rigging, electrical safety, lockout/tagout, fire, deep excavation, confined space and hazardous materials, and other areas i.e. ergonomics, emergency preparedness, industrial hygiene and general safe work practices.

Required Qualifications & Experience

  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in EPC projects and/or the heavy construction industry.

  • Safety certification such as Construction Health and Safety Engineer, Construction Health and Safety Technician, Certified Safety Professional (CSP), Safety Management Specialist (SMS), Associate Safety Professional (ASP), or an equivalent industry-recognized certification.

  • Proven track record of implementing, managing, and continuously improving construction safety programs with demonstrated safety performance achievements.

  • Strong leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

  • Bachelor's degree in Occupational Safety, Industrial Safety, Safety Engineering, or a related field preferred.

  • Advanced degree in Safety Engineering, Occupational Safety, Industrial Safety, or a related discipline is highly desirable.

  • Experience leading safety programs within complex EPC projects and/or heavy construction environments, with 10–15+ years of industry experience considered advantageous.

Additional Skills

  • Strong knowledge of construction safety regulations, standards, and industry best practices.

  • Ability to drive a proactive safety culture and influence safe work behaviors across project teams and contractors.

  • Excellent problem-solving, risk assessment, and incident prevention capabilities.

  • Strong organizational and project management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities.

Infinite Impact

Who We Are
Our mission is simple but critical: to build pathways for adult learners to earn high-quality, workforce-aligned degrees and credentials from North Carolina’s public universities.
At Project Kitty Hawk, our work reflects our company values: 
Collaboration – We prioritize our partners’ success and reputation, aligning every initiative with their goals, reflecting their values, and enhancing their impact. 
Innovation – We innovate, not replicate. As creative problem solvers, we use data-driven insights to push boundaries, continuously improve our services, develop solutions, and redefine what it means to serve nontraditional learners. 
Empathy – We understand the unique challenges of nontraditional learners, and are committed to supporting them with empathy, respect, and solutions that fit their needs. 
Integrity – We operate with transparency and accountability in everything we do. We uphold honesty, take ownership of our work, and maintain the highest standards. 
Teamwork – We embody the collaboration we seek. We always strive to be dependable, supportive, and solutions-oriented teammates. 
Together, we partner with universities in the University of North Carolina (UNC) System to produce innovative, flexible degree and credential programs in high-demand fields. Each PKH team member plays a vital role in advancing this mission and shaping the future of education for adult learners. 
These values will enable us to realize PKH’s vision: to make North Carolina’s public universities the top choice for adult learners and to amplify the UNC System’s role as a national leader in higher education innovation, access, and student success. By joining our team, you have an opportunity to contribute to our achievement of that vision, in the process helping to create opportunities for thousands of learners to earn their success and move up the economic ladder.
At Project Kitty Hawk we hire talented people who are not only dedicated to our mission but share our belief that working together makes us stronger and more effective. In this organization you’ll find individuals with a range of interesting backgrounds and life stories; the true magic happens when those individuals come together to solve problems in service of a common goal.

The Role

PKH is growing fast, and our Admissions and Student Success teams are the front line of that growth. We're looking for a part-time Talent Acquisition Partner to own sourcing and early-stage screening for these roles across our university partner cohorts (App State, NC A&T, ECU, NCCU, Winston-Salem State, UNCW). You'll work closely with People Operations and hiring managers to keep pipelines full, move candidates quickly, and make sure every applicant has a good experience — whether they get the job or not.

This is a great fit for someone who likes the sourcing-and-screening side of recruiting more than the offer-negotiation side, and who wants a flexible, part-time role with real ownership over a defined slice of hiring.

What you'll do:

  • Manage full-cycle recruiting for Admissions and Student Services openings, from requisition to handoff for final-round interviews
  • Source candidates through Lever, LinkedIn, job boards, and university/community partnerships — especially candidates with backgrounds in higher ed, call-center/inside-sales, or student-facing coaching roles
  • Screen resumes and conduct phone/video interviews against role-specific criteria set by hiring managers
  • Keep Lever pipelines current — accurate stage tracking, notes, and candidate status so hiring managers and People Ops always know where things stand
  • Draft and send candidate communications (screen invites, rejections, status updates) using PKH's existing templates and tone
  • Partner with hiring managers (e.g., Admissions Services Manager, Student Success leadership) on role requirements and pipeline check-ins
  • Flag pipeline health issues early — slow-moving reqs, thin applicant pools, or diversity/representation gaps — to People Ops
  • Support light employer-branding work: keeping job descriptions current, posting to relevant boards, monitoring applicant experience

What you bring:

  • 2+ years of recruiting or sourcing experience; agency, in-house, or high-volume hiring experience all welcome
  • Comfort working in an ATS (Lever experience a plus, not required)
  • Experience recruiting for admissions, enrollment, call-center, sales, or coaching/advising roles is a strong plus — you understand what makes someone succeed in a high-touch, metrics-driven, relationship-based role
  • Strong written communication — able to write candidate emails that sound like a person, not a form letter
  • Comfortable managing multiple open reqs and shifting priorities without a lot of oversight
  • Familiarity with the nonprofit/higher-ed OPM space is a plus but not required

  • Experience applying UL, CSA, ETL, NSF, or other safety and certification standards.
  • Experience working directly with product certification or regulatory agencies.
  • Experience supporting product qualification testing, environmental compliance, regulatory submissions, or safety listing activities.
  • Familiarity with supplier qualification, factory audits, sourcing processes, or vendor technical coordination.
  • Experience working in a manufacturing, industrial distribution, electrical products, or engineered products environment.
  • Experience using enterprise resource planning systems to maintain product, material, or bill-of-material information.

Paige, a GCG company, has been delivering innovative wire and cable solutions for over 65 years. Role Purpose

Ensure the linguistic and phonetic quality of Omilia’s multilingual Text-to-Speech (TTS) systems by designing phoneme inventories, developing lexicons, and reviewing audio corpora to support enterprise-grade voice experiences.

Accountabilities

  • Autonomy: Independently conduct phonological and phonetic analysis, design phoneme inventories, and develop lexicons for multiple languages.
  • Scope & Complexity: Responsible for linguistic quality across all supported languages in TTS, including handling underrepresented phenomena and complex language-specific features.
  • Impact: Directly influences the naturalness, accuracy, and quality of Omilia’s TTS output, impacting customer experience in global contact center deployments.
  • Influence/Mentorship: Collaborates with TTS engineers, data scientists, and ML researchers; coordinates with native-speaker reviewers and external annotation pipelines.

Key Responsibilities

  • Conduct systematic phonological and phonetic analysis of the American Spanish language.
  • Document language-specific features (prosody, stress, tone, coarticulation, dialect variation).
  • Produce structured language profiles for TTS model training and evaluation.
  • Define and maintain phoneme inventories; map to IPA and TTS-specific conventions.
  • Corpus audits and optimal audio references selections for TTS target voice tuning
  • Build and maintain pronunciation lexicons, including G2P rules and exceptions.
  • Review and correct machine-generated G2P outputs; conduct pronunciation audits.
  • Annotate audio corpora, develop evaluation protocols, and produce error analyses.
  • Define linguistic criteria for TTS corpus selection and design prompts for data collection.
  • Collaborate with TTS engineers to integrate linguistic artefacts into synthesis pipelines.
  • Contribute to internal documentation and participate in research discussions.

Requirements

  • M.Sc. or Ph.D. in Linguistics, Phonetics, Computational Linguistics, or related field.
  • Proven experience building pronunciation lexicons or G2P systems for TTS or ASR.
  • Deep knowledge of phonological theory, articulatory and acoustic phonetics.
  • Proficiency with IPA and at least one machine-readable phoneme notation system (X-SAMPA, ARPAbet, etc.).
  • Experience with corpus annotation tools (Praat, ELAN, WebAnno, etc.).
  • Strong analytical and documentation skills.
  • Fluency in English; proficiency in at least one additional language relevant to Omilia’s markets.
  • Technical skills: Praat, ELAN, Audacity, PLS/CMUdict/SSML lexicon formats, Phonetisaurus/Sequitur/neural G2P, basic Python or shell scripting, TTS text normalization.

jobs.excerpt: OverviewThe Senior Auditor Contract Compliance (Construction) performs contract compliance and cost control audits on construction and capital projects, with a focus on distribution center, data center, corporate office, and retail construction, remodel, and build-out programs.
jobs.description:
Overview

The Senior Auditor Contract Compliance (Construction) performs contract compliance and cost control audits on construction and capital projects, with a focus on distribution center, data center, corporate office, and retail construction, remodel, and build-out programs. This role applies working knowledge of construction audit practices, including AIA billing formats, job-cost reconciliation, GMP and CMAR contract structures, subcontract reviews, insurance cost validation, and lease and developer cost audits.

The Senior Auditor executes audit testing independently, quality-checks and mentors other auditors on assigned engagements, and communicates findings clearly to clients and suppliers. This is a US-based remote role with periodic travel to construction project sites as needed (up to 20%).

Responsibilities

Contract Compliance and Cost Control

  • Perform detailed contract compliance audits to assess alignment with AIA billing standards, GMP/CMAR contract terms, unit-price schedules, cost-plus arrangements, and negotiated allowances.
  • Validate that billed costs —general conditions, general requirements, subcontractor, developer, and landlord — comply with contract requirements and industry norms.
  • Identify cost recoveries, billing errors, non-allowable charges, and process improvement opportunities

Construction Technical Proficiency

  • Apply working knowledge of AIA billing formats (G702, G703, continuation sheets) to identify anomalies or unsupported values.
  • Support insurance auditing on construction projects, including reviewing policy documents (GL, Builders Risk, OCIP/CCIP, Workers' Compensation) and validating contractually allowable insurance costs.
  • Perform subcontract audits, including T&M validations, change order support, negotiated buyouts, and back-charge review.
  • Conduct job cost reconciliations, matching committed costs, actuals, payments, and cost-to-complete details.
  • Support developer and landlord cost verification, including audits of land acquisition, soft costs, carrying costs (interest, equity), lease costs, tenant improvement allowances, and pass-through expenditures.
  • Conduct monthly pay application reviews, including verification of percent complete, stored materials, retainage, and subcontractor flow-down compliance.
  • Support construction procurement and bid analysis, including bid leveling, identifying scope gaps, and alternate pricing.
  • Claim settlement support experience — including work related to disputed amounts between owners, contractors, subcontractors, or developers — is a plus.
  • Legal preparation support experience is a plus, including working with counsel on arbitration, litigation, or expert-witness documentation.

Procurement and Supply Chain

  • Audit material purchases and subcontractor billings for compliance with procurement requirements and pricing terms.
  • Assess buyout savings, material escalations, equipment rentals, and service procurements; flag opportunities to strengthen procurement controls and reduce cost leakage.

Communication and Reporting

  • Communicate audit results clearly and concisely, in both written and verbal form, to internal, client, and supplier personnel.
  • Help draft and issue audit reports summarizing completed audit activities, findings, and recoveries.
  • Present and support audit claims in a manner that is clear, concise, and persuasive.
  • Manage conflict and maintain professionalism with clients, contractors, and suppliers at all times, including when other parties are not.

Project Management, QC, and Team Support

  • Work independently, balancing priorities across multiple audit engagements and ensuring each project moves toward timely completion.
  • Maintain production goals and strong project management skills, advancing a group of audits forward each day.
  • Delegate, train, and quality-check audit work performed by other auditors; participate in and lead team knowledge sharing on contract interpretation, audit techniques, and cost-control practices.
  • Exhibit personal initiative in learning new analytic tools and construction audit techniques; accept and provide constructive feedback in a collaborative team environment.

Quality Assurance

  • Implement self-check and peer review practices to eliminate calculation errors and maintain high-quality, consistent work product.
  • Ensure detailed documentation and proper use of Cotiviti tools and construction audit software.

Governance and Compliance

  • Ensure compliance with Cotiviti policies, confidentiality requirements, data security standards, and relevant industry standards, including those promoted by the National Association of Construction Auditors (NACA).

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, Engineering, Construction Management and/or Business Administration or related field required
  • Certified Construction Auditor (CCA) preferred. CFE, PE, CCM, or PMP are pluses
  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in construction auditing, construction project management or project engineering
  • Experience auditing AIA-format billings, GMP and CMAR contracts, job-cost structures, tenant improvement projects, data centers, distribution centers, or large capital portfolios preferred.
  • Experience reviewing insurance costs, subcontracts, cost-plus agreements, change orders, or developer/landlord cost submissions preferred.
  • Experience conducting completed project audits and monthly pay application reviews
  • Exposure to bidding processes and bid leveling, and how bids translate into contract risk and audit focus areas, is a plus.
  • Experience supporting claim negotiation or legal counsel in disputes or arbitration preparation is a plus.
  • Strong project management skills required
  • May require travel up to 20%

Mental Requirements:

  • Communicating with others to exchange information.
  • Assessing the accuracy, neatness, and thoroughness of the work assigned.

Physical Requirements and Working Conditions:

  • Ability to sit or stand for extended periods and repeat hand motions in computer-based work.
  • No adverse environmental conditions expected in the primary work location.
  • Ability to visit active job sites safely, including adherence to site-specific safety and PPE requirements.
  • Must be able to provide a dedicated, secure work area.
  • Must be able to provide high-speed internet access/connectivity and office setup and maintenance.

Base compensation ranges from $85,000 to $100,000. Specific offers are determined by various factors, such as experience, education, skills, certifications, and other business needs. This role is eligible for discretionary bonus consideration.

Cotiviti offers team members a competitive benefits package to address a wide range of personal and family needs, including medical, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance coverage, 401(k) savings plans, paid family leave, 9 paid holidays per year, and 17-27 days of Paid Time Off (PTO) per year, depending on specific level and length of service with Cotiviti.

For information about our benefits package, please refer to our Careers page.

Date of posting: 7/30/2026

Applications are assessed on a rolling basis. We anticipate that the application window will close on 9/30/2026, but the application window may change depending on the volume of applications received or close immediately if a qualified candidate is selected.

About TodayTix Group:

TodayTix Group (TTG) is the global e-commerce leader for cultural experiences, designing frictionless discovery and purchase journeys through innovative product design and industry-leading technology. Our portfolio of brands––including TodayTix, New York Theatre Guide, London Theatre, Show-Score, Arthouse, Arthouse London, and Secret Cinema––connects millions of customers with the best in live entertainment.
Powered by vast data and insights, TTG helps theatres, producers, and cultural institutions reach highly engaged audiences and unlock meaningful revenue, transforming how tickets are sold across the world.
In 2025, TTG entered a new chapter as part of MARI, the global events and experiences company powering world-defining live experiences. Together, we’re expanding our reach, deepening our impact, and accelerating a shared vision to redefine the event lifecycle through seamless discovery, purchase, and engagement.

Life at TodayTix Group

We thrive in a nimble, growth-oriented environment where adaptability, curiosity, and a bias toward action help us stay ahead of the curve. We move quickly, iterate often, and expect everyone to take ownership of their impact - because we're building the future of live events, and there’s no script for what comes next.
New joiners are set up for success with a 90-day onboarding journey, complete with clear goals and measurable milestones. We believe feedback fuels growth, so we hold twice-yearly performance reviews focused on impact and development.
Above all, you’ll be working alongside a team of collaborative, passionate, and kind humans - people who love theatre and live experiences, and who support each other just as much as they challenge each other to do great work.
We are seeking outstanding applicants of all backgrounds to join our team to bring new voices, talent, and perspectives to the table. We encourage all to apply.

About the Role:

TodayTix Australia is seeking a Partnerships Manager to enhance and grow our current offering to partners across the Australian portfolio of partners. TodayTix, TTG’s consumer-facing business, continues to grow in strength across 5 Australian markets, offering members access to the best theater and live events across the country. At the same time, TodayTix is also giving producers and event organisers a powerful way to connect with an emerging and engaged audience who are looking for exciting cultural experiences

We are seeking someone who is motivated by the live event industry with a sales and partner focused approach. The abilities to keep multiple plates spinning at once and know when to zoom in on a problem or zoom out to take the big picture into consideration are a must. Prior experience in live theatre in the Australian market at the commercial level would be highly desirable.

This new position will play a key role in maintaining existing client relationships as well as exploring new opportunities and strategies to grow the offerings to members and partners alike. Reporting to the Senior Director, Sales + Ticketing, the Partnership Manager will be the primary conduit between external stakeholders and the wider local and global TTG team, managing the productions wants and needs with internal capacities to ensure that campaigns are delivered to the desired schedule and opportunities to support various productions are leveraged to return the maximum results for the business and the partnering production or event.

The role will work alongside the Marketing, Setup and Programing teams with the primary responsibility of ensuring that everyone has the required information, in a timely manner from start to finish.

Please note: this is a full-time, remote role. Qualified candidates must be based in the greater Melbourne area.

What Success Looks Like:

  • Relationships mapped and initiated → within 90 days you understand the partner portfolio across all five markets and have a clear view of priorities and opportunities.

  • Pipeline building → new partnership opportunities identified and progressed across the TodayTix marketplace and Powered by TodayTix.

  • Campaigns delivered on time → productions onboarded and campaigns launched to schedule, with Marketing, Setup and Programming aligned and briefed.

  • Commercial contribution → measurable growth in partner revenue, GMV or conversion across the AUS portfolio.

  • Data-informed management → regular reporting using our AI and insights tools that demonstrably lifts partner conversion.

What You'll Do:

  • Maintain and establish relationships with thoughtful and regular contact with a focus on cementing TodayTix as a premium partner for live performance events across all markets TodayTix operates in Australia.

  • Manage inbound communication from productions to list content on the TodayTix platform, working with the Senior Director, Sales + Ticketingto determine the suitability and opportunity across a varied portfolio of partners.

  • Pursuing new partnerships and opportunities to grow the Australian business across the TodayTix marketplace and emerging distribution channels such as Powered by TodayTix.

  • Working closely with the marketing and partnerships team to develop sales strategies to achieve business goals.

  • Translate the goals of a production into actionable items for various team members across the organisation.

  • Ensuring that the deadlines are met and timelines are established internally and externally.

  • Understand consumer trends to advise and guide productions on how to get the best outcome for their show.

  • Manage agreements and contracting across a variety of different commercial structures.

  • In consultation with the global B2B team, utilising TTG technology, lead the development of the growth strategy for B2B distribution partners in the AUS market.

  • Work closely with the Ticketing Operations team to ensure sufficient inventory to facilitate all offers and promotional activity.

  • Utilise our AI data and insights tools, to regularly measure and report on partners to continually improve conversion.

  • Participate in industry events to help drive positive brand and market awareness to highlight TTG’s reputation as industry leaders.

We’re Looking for Someone With:

  • 5+ years in a partnerships, account management or sales role - ideally in live events, entertainment or ticketing.

  • Experience in live theatre in the Australian market at a commercial level (highly desirable).

  • A proven ability to manage multiple stakeholders and competing priorities without compromising on quality of work.

  • Commercial acumen — experience negotiating agreements across varied commercial structures.

  • Strong relationship-building and communication skills, internally and externally.

  • Data-literacy and comfort using insights tools to guide decisions and report on performance.

  • Familiarity with AI tools as part of your daily workflow to assist with streamlining efficiencies.

  • Willingness to attend industry events, with some travel across markets.

  • The ability to maintain focus with a bias towards action while working independently.
