jobs.description:
Overview

DecisionPoint seeks a System Architect to design and oversee enterprise application, mobile application, website, and tool architectures within AWS GovCloud in support of a large federal and DoD-aligned IT mission environment. This role develops scalable, secure, and maintainable architectures that align with mission requirements, cloud best practices, and DoD cybersecurity standards.

The System Architect collaborates closely with developers, cloud engineers, cybersecurity teams, and product leadership to define technical direction, validate designs, guide implementation, and ensure alignment with long-term modernization goals.

This position is fully remote.

Duties & Responsibilities

The System Architect will:

  • Architect enterprise applications, mobile apps, websites, and backend systems deployed within AWS GovCloud.
  • Define system architecture blueprints, integration patterns, data flows, and service interaction models.
  • Lead cloud architecture decisions including VPC configurations, security boundaries, and cloud-native service usage.
  • Provide technical oversight for development teams to ensure architectural compliance.
  • Design secure API integrations, identity and access flows, and cross-system data exchanges.
  • Ensure architectures meet performance, scalability, availability, and reliability requirements.
  • Develop migration paths, modernization strategies, and technical roadmaps for legacy systems.
  • Conduct design reviews, security evaluations, and architectural assessments.
  • Collaborate with cybersecurity teams to ensure alignment with DoD security controls and hardening requirements.
  • Work with database and DevSecOps teams on service orchestration, automation, CI/CD pipelines, and deployment patterns.
  • Produce detailed architectural artifacts such as diagrams, specifications, patterns, and system documentation.
  • Troubleshoot complex architectural issues and guide resolution strategies.

Qualifications

Clearance Requirement

Must hold an active Secret clearance, supported by a Tier 3 background investigation.

Education (Required)

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical field.

Experience (Required)

  • Minimum 8 years of experience in system architecture, enterprise application design, or software engineering.
  • Experience architecting cloud-based applications using AWS or similar platforms.
  • Experience supporting enterprise or federal application ecosystems.
  • Experience designing APIs, integrations, data flows, and system communication patterns.
  • Experience performing architectural reviews, risk assessments, and modernization planning.

Technical Knowledge (Required)

  • Strong understanding of AWS GovCloud architecture, cloud networking, IAM, security patterns, and cloud services.
  • Knowledge of enterprise application architecture including microservices, APIs, and web application frameworks.
  • Familiarity with mobile application architectures and backend integration strategies.
  • Experience with secure coding principles and DoD cybersecurity requirements.
  • Understanding of CI/CD, DevSecOps practices, and automated deployment pipelines.

Technical Knowledge (Preferred)

  • Experience with serverless architectures and container orchestration.
  • Familiarity with modern frontend frameworks and mobile app development stacks.
  • Experience designing architectures for IL5 or other high-security environments.

Certifications

Required:

  • CompTIA Security+

Preferred:

  • AWS Solutions Architect (Associate or Professional)
  • CISSP or CCSP
  • ITIL v4 Foundation

Skills

  • Strong architectural design and systems thinking capabilities.
  • Excellent communication skills for engaging with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Ability to produce clear technical documentation and diagrams.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  • Ability to guide development teams and enforce architectural standards.

jobs.description:
Position Overview

The Chief Sustainability Officer (CSO) is responsible for leading the organization's environmental, social, and governance (ESG) strategy and sustainability initiatives. The CSO drives the integration of sustainable business practices into corporate strategy, operations, risk management, and stakeholder engagement. This role ensures the organization meets regulatory requirements, sustainability goals, and long-term ESG commitments while enhancing corporate reputation and business resilience.

Key Responsibilities

ESG & Sustainability Strategy

  • Develop and execute the organization's ESG and sustainability strategy aligned with corporate objectives.
  • Establish sustainability goals, targets, and long-term roadmaps.
  • Integrate ESG principles into business operations, investments, and decision-making processes.

Environmental Sustainability Initiatives

  • Lead initiatives focused on carbon reduction, energy efficiency, waste management, and climate resilience.
  • Develop strategies to reduce environmental impact and support net-zero objectives.
  • Monitor environmental performance metrics and sustainability benchmarks.

Social Impact & Corporate Responsibility

  • Drive diversity, equity, inclusion (DEI), employee well-being, and community engagement initiatives.
  • Oversee corporate social responsibility (CSR) programs and social impact strategies.
  • Promote ethical business practices and stakeholder trust.

Governance & Compliance

  • Ensure compliance with ESG-related regulations, reporting standards, and frameworks.
  • Establish governance policies and sustainability reporting structures.
  • Collaborate with legal, risk, compliance, and audit teams on ESG governance.

ESG Reporting & Analytics

  • Oversee ESG disclosures, sustainability reporting, and impact measurement.
  • Ensure alignment with recognized frameworks such as GRI, SASB, TCFD, and ISSB where applicable.
  • Develop dashboards and KPIs to measure ESG performance and progress.

Stakeholder & Investor Engagement

  • Engage with investors, regulators, clients, and external stakeholders on sustainability matters.
  • Communicate ESG initiatives, progress, and impact transparently.
  • Represent the organization in sustainability forums and industry discussions.

Sustainable Business Transformation

  • Collaborate with business units to embed sustainability into operations, products, and services.
  • Support sustainable finance, green initiatives, and responsible investment strategies.
  • Identify opportunities for innovation and sustainable growth.

Risk Management & Resilience

  • Assess environmental and social risks impacting business operations and investments.
  • Develop climate risk and sustainability risk management frameworks.
  • Support enterprise resilience and long-term sustainability planning.

Leadership & Culture Development

  • Promote a sustainability-focused culture across the organization.
  • Lead and mentor ESG, sustainability, and CSR teams.
  • Drive employee awareness and engagement in sustainability initiatives.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Sustainability, Environmental Science, Business Administration, Finance, or related field; Master's degree preferred.
  • 12–15+ years of experience in sustainability, ESG, corporate responsibility, or related leadership roles.
  • Strong understanding of ESG frameworks, sustainability reporting, and regulatory requirements.
  • Proven track record of implementing enterprise-wide sustainability initiatives.

Key Skills & Competencies

  • Strong strategic and sustainability leadership capabilities.
  • Expertise in ESG frameworks and sustainability reporting.
  • Excellent stakeholder engagement and communication skills.
  • Analytical and risk assessment abilities.
  • Change management and cross-functional collaboration skills.

Performance Metrics

  • Achievement of ESG and sustainability targets.
  • Reduction in environmental impact and carbon footprint.
  • ESG ratings and reporting compliance.
  • Stakeholder and investor engagement outcomes.
  • Success of sustainability and CSR initiatives.

Overview

DecisionPoint seeks a Digital Experience Architect (Senior) to translate experience strategy into scalable, accessible, and secure digital platform solutions supporting Military Community and Family Policy (MC&FP) initiatives under the MODES III contract. This role supports Task 2 Outreach and Engagement and works in close partnership with Task 3 technical architects and development teams to ensure experience strategies are technically feasible and operationally sustainable.

The Digital Experience Architect ensures experiences are accessible, scalable, secure by design, and aligned with MC&FP enterprise architecture and governance requirements.

This position is fully remote.

Duties & Responsibilities

The Digital Experience Architect (Senior) will:

  • Translate experience strategy and service design into platform, UX, and system requirements.
  • Partner with Task 3 architects, developers, and engineers to ensure technical feasibility.
  • Define digital experience architecture patterns and design standards.
  • Ensure digital experiences are accessible, scalable, and secure by design.
  • Support integration of UX and experience requirements into system and platform designs.
  • Collaborate with experience strategists, UX analysts, and content strategists.
  • Review and guide implementation to ensure fidelity to experience and architecture standards.
  • Support development of experience architecture documentation and design artifacts.
  • Identify experience related technical risks and mitigation strategies.
  • Support platform governance, design reviews, and architectural decision making.
  • Ensure compliance with accessibility, security, and enterprise standards.
  • Support continuous improvement of digital experience architecture practices.

Qualifications

Clearance Requirement

Candidate must possess a Tier 2 Moderate Risk Public Trust from any federal agency.

Education (Required)

Bachelor’s degree in Graphic Design, Interaction Design, Human Computer Interaction, Digital Media, Visual Communications, or a related field.

Experience (Required)

  • Minimum of 10 years of experience designing and architecting digital user experiences.
  • Experience translating experience strategy into technical and system requirements.
  • Experience partnering with developers and architects on complex digital platforms.
  • Experience supporting federal or public-sector digital systems preferred.

Technical Knowledge

Required:

  • Expertise in digital experience architecture and design systems.
  • Strong understanding of accessibility standards and inclusive design.
  • Knowledge of scalable and secure digital platform design.
  • Ability to translate UX requirements into technical specifications.

Preferred:

  • Experience supporting cloud based or enterprise digital platforms.
  • Familiarity with cybersecurity and privacy by design principles.
  • Experience working in Agile or iterative delivery environments.

Certifications

Required:

  • None

Preferred:

  • Certifications in UX design, accessibility, or digital architecture

Skills

  • Strong systems and design thinking skills.

jobs.description:
Position Summary

This role is not eligible for immigration sponsorship


Samsung Electronics America, Inc. (SEA), the U.S. Sales and Marketing subsidiary, is a leader in mobile technologies, consumer electronics, home appliances, enterprise solutions and networks systems. For more than four decades, Samsung has driven innovation, economic growth and workforce opportunity across the United States—investing over $100 billion and employing more than 20,000 people nationwide. By integrating our large portfolio of products, services and AI technology, we’re creating smarter, sustainable and more connected experiences that empower people to live better. SEA is a wholly owned subsidiary of Samsung Electronics Co., Ltd.
To learn more, visit Samsung.com. For the latest news, visit news.samsung.com/us.

Role and Responsibilities

The Builder Channel Regional Sales Director oversees and provides leadership for a multi-state regional market area, creating the sales plan for Samsung and Dacor brands executed through Builder Distribution. The role manages a team of 6 remote Sales Managers and develops the strategy for all builder trade customers across single-family (SF) and multi-family (MF) relationships, This director owns full P&L accountability for combined revenue across an 8-state territory — Florida, Georgia, North Carolina, South Carolina, Alabama, Tennessee, Mississippi, and Arkansas — and serves as the senior Samsung and Dacor brand representative to distributor principals, national and regional builders, multi-family developers, and architectural/design firms throughout the Southeast. The role requires a demonstrated strategic thinker who can translate organizational objectives into practical regional action plans while fostering a collaborative and inclusive team environment.

Position Objective

Revenue & Business Performance

  • Accountable for achieving all sales revenue goals for both Samsung and Dacor builder sales for the Southeast region.
  • Drive quote generation, pipeline development, and win-rate improvement across all segments: single-family (SF), multi-family (MF), MRO, hospitality, and remodeling.
  • Develop and execute the regional business plan, including annual and quarterly sales forecasts, account prioritization, and segment-level go-to-market strategies.
  • Keep abreast of competition, competitive issues, products, and market trends across the Builder channel; leverage strong national and regional market awareness to develop new strategies and refine competitive positioning to maximize Samsung and Dacor's competitive advantage.
  • Manage competitive displacement strategies to grow Samsung and Dacor share against key competitors in the Southeast new construction and remodeling markets.
  • Set measurable, specific, and compatible goals aligned with organizational objectives and values; prepare written presentations and reports for business reviews, sales presentations, trade shows, and internal executive reviews as needed.
  • Attend and participate in sales meetings, product seminars, national trade shows, and industry conferences to maintain market awareness and represent the Samsung and Dacor brands.

Team Leadership & Talent Development

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of 6 remote Sales Managers across an 8-state territory, establishing clear KPIs, performance expectations, and individual development plans.
  • Drive a high-performance, accountability-driven team culture with emphasis on skill development, field coaching, and career progression; demonstrated ability to coach and elevate others analytically and strategically.
  • Own full-cycle talent management: recruiting, onboarding, performance reviews, succession planning, and performance improvement processes where required.
  • Develop and execute sales training materials and programs to build team capability across product knowledge, competitive positioning, negotiation, and customer engagement.
  • Foster a collaborative, inclusive team environment that shares best practices, elevates individual contributors, and builds organizational bench strength.
  • Responsible for personal development of direct reports and all recruiting for new or open positions within the region.

Distribution Strategy & Relationship Management

  • Create and manage the regional distribution strategy across distributor accounts — including independent Builder Distributors and Retail BDs,— ensuring all programs are implemented consistently.
  • Own senior-level relationship management with distributor principals and ownership groups, serving as the executive point of contact for strategic accounts in the Southeast.
  • Negotiate and manage annual distribution agreements, programming, and co-op marketing initiatives that drive sell-through and brand activation for both Samsung and Dacor.
  • Ensure Samsung and Dacor branded showrooms are properly resourced, trained, and executing display standards across the region.
  • Manage assigned MDF and Display budget to develop showroom and project business; analyze ROI of MDF investments to maximize market share impact.

Builder & Developer Strategy

  • Create the SF/MF builder strategy for the region, directing negotiations of contracts and programming; develop in-region SF national relationships based in the region.
  • Cultivate and maintain relationships with national and regional production builders at VP/Director-level purchasing and construction contacts, with particular focus on large key account planning and development.
  • Build influence with architectural and design firms — including NAHB, NKBA, and ASID-affiliated professionals — to ensure Samsung and Dacor are specified at the design stage of key projects.
  • Develop and execute multi-family developer relationships for large-scale MF appliance specifications; own executive-level relationships with major regional MF developers.
  • Be the voice of the customer — communicate direct builder and developer needs and requirements to internal teams to guide product development, process improvements, and go-to-market planning.
  • Identify and define new processes and systems needed to address the unique requirements of the SF and MF builder channel segments.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work cross-functionally with SCM, BOC, Credit, and Product Management to achieve regional sales plans and objectives; support the Sr. Director with market intelligence, product input, and S&OP development.
  • Work directly with Product Marketing and Supply Chain Management teams for immediate and future product needs, forecasting, and product development opportunities.
  • Support the One Samsung initiative by creating synergies within the entire Builder channel — both direct and indirect — coordinating with peer directors and the Sr. Director to ensure channel alignment and minimize conflict.
  • Provide market intelligence, competitive insights, and voice-of-customer input to the Sr. Director and Product Marketing teams to inform product roadmap and planning.
  • Plan and coordinate with key internal groups including HA Business Management, HA Finance, HA Business Planning, Consumer Business Division Marketing and Communications, Shared Services, and the Customer Development Organization.
  • Collaborate with other Regional Directors on special projects as directed by the Sr. Director or VP of Builder Sales.
  • Partner with HR on talent strategies, workforce planning, compensation planning, and organizational changes within the region.
  • Partner with Demand Generation and Sales Operations on promotional planning, trade event presence, and regional market activations.

Skills and Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications:

Minimum 12 years of progressive sales leadership experience (with a Bachelor's degree) in the builder channel, home appliances, or a directly related building products industry — ideally including single-family and multi-family new construction. Minimum 5 years of direct people management experience leading remote, multi-state sales organizations. Demonstrated track record within a distribution or builder trade channel environment. Deep expertise in the distributor ecosystems, builder trade channels, and large key account management planning that serve the SF and MF construction markets. Experience with new process definition, documentation, and business case justification for operational or system development needs within a large, matrixed corporation.

Minimum Bachelor's Degree required. Master's Degree / MBA preferred (with 10 years' experience). PhD accepted with 7 years' experience. History of ongoing professional skill development and learning.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience selling or managing sales for a major home appliance brand (Samsung, LG, GE Appliances, Whirlpool, BSH, Electrolux, or equivalent) in a builder or trade channel capacity.
  • Prior experience managing a luxury or ultra-premium product line alongside a mass-market brand, with the ability to navigate dual-brand positioning, pricing, and customer relationships simultaneously.
  • Existing relationships with key Southeast regional builders, developers, and/or distributor networks.
  • Builder trade customer turnaround and business recovery experience — demonstrated ability to re-engage and rebuild strategic accounts.
  • Familiarity with the design and specification influence channel — architects, interior designers, and design-build firms; experience collaborating with national industry associations such as NAHB, NKBA, and ASID.
  • Merchandising and/or marketing leadership experience that complements field sales strategy.
  • Experience developing and executing sales training materials and programs for a field sales organization.
  • Experience presenting to and influencing C-suite and VP-level executives at builder and distributor firms.
  • Proficiency in Salesforce.com, Excel, PowerPoint, and Word; experience with pipeline reporting and sales analytics platforms.

Skills & Leadership Competencies

Skills - Strong leadership and team-building with emphasis on inspiring a high-performance culture in a remote sales environment. Demonstrated analytical skills with the ability to lead and coach others to use data in decision-making. Strong sense of urgency and speed to action. Strong interpersonal, negotiation, and communication skills. Able to assess risks and manage accordingly. Ability to lead complex projects and work effectively in a matrix environment — navigating organizational and trade customer ambiguity with clarity and accountability. Ability to prepare professional written presentations and reports designed for external customers as well as executive reviews. Diplomatic and social skills to interact and navigate with trade customer senior and executive leadership. Demonstrated strategic thinker who can turn strategic objectives into practical field actions. Creating leadership presence — positive and confident influence — with internal functions at all levels of management and with trade customer leadership. Problem-solving orientation: defining the problem to be solved, driving actions and accountabilities through complexity. Ability to adapt within a large corporation that is evolving new functions and channels. P&L management. Proficiency in Salesforce.com, Excel, PowerPoint, and Word. Ability to travel 50%+.

Life @ Samsung -

Benefits @ Samsung -

Regular full-time employees (salaried or hourly) have access to benefits including: Medical, Dental, Vision, Life Insurance, 401(k), Employee Purchase Program, Tuition Assistance (after 12 months), Paid Time Off, Student Loan Program (after 12 months), Wellness Incentives, and many more. Overview

The Managing Director, Programs, is a senior executive who reports to the CEO and leads HSI’s global program design and implementation function. The Managing Director serves on the organization’s top management team, along with the CEO and COO, and plays a central role in shaping program strategy, strengthening program quality, supporting business development, and advancing HSI’s mission.

This role supervises a team of highly experienced senior professionals across multiple countries and regions. The Managing Director leads and supports project design and implementation teams, works closely with country and global leaders, and collaborates across the organization to ensure that HSI delivers high-quality, high-impact programs.

This is a key leadership role for a strategic, collaborative, and mission-driven executive who can bring together technical excellence, strong management, sound financial judgment, and a deep commitment to developing people and teams.

What You’ll Do

Organizational Leadership

  • Serve as a trusted thought partner and advisor to the CEO and as a peer to the Chief Operating Officer, contributing to organizational strategy, informed decision-making, revenue generation, and high-quality program execution in support of HSI’s mission.
  • Lead by example as a standard bearer for HSI’s mission, values, integrity, technical excellence, management competence, and emotional intelligence.
  • Provide strategic and collaborative leadership to the Program division, including the development and implementation of innovative, financially sound initiatives aligned with HSI’s mission and priorities.
  • Ensure strong program design, negotiation, and implementation of HSI projects in collaboration with Program Directors, country leaders, technical advisors, fellows, and partners.
  • Work with the CEO and COO for effective business decisions, clear communication, and thoughtful change management across the organization.
  • Contribute to organizational policy development as a member of the Leadership Team and Management Team.
  • Identify programmatic and operational risks and opportunities, elevate them appropriately, and recommend practical actions for mitigation, course correction, or improvement.
  • Demonstrate and uphold HSI’s mission and values in all internal and external activities.

Business Development

  • Contribute actively to new business development by leading selected opportunities, identifying growth areas, and helping secure new funding sources.
  • Lead the development and continuous improvement of HSI’s programmatic strategies and approaches, fostering creativity, collaboration, and quality across country teams, global program leaders, technical advisors, fellows, and partners.
  • Support the cultivation of new funders and partners while helping the organization manage and strengthen existing relationships.
  • Lead selected business development efforts, including positioning, proposal development, partner engagement, and negotiations.
  • Help ensure that new business opportunities are strategically aligned, technically strong, financially viable, and feasible to implement.

Program Execution

  • Lead the Program team to ensure efficient, high-quality, and high-impact implementation of HSI projects.
  • Oversee Program Directors and program operations staff to establish and meet standards for technical excellence, program management quality, financial stewardship, and donor responsiveness.
  • Support country leadership in strengthening HSI’s regional and in-country representation and ensuring effective project implementation.
  • Promote strong communication, collaboration, cohesion, and knowledge sharing across projects, countries, and technical areas.
  • Model and strengthen collaboration between Program leaders and Business Operations functions, including Talent, Contracts, Finance, and Accounting.
  • Represent the Program team’s perspective at the highest levels of organizational management and decision-making.
  • Collaborate with the Leadership Team, Program Directors, and country leaders to ensure that country offices and project teams are appropriately staffed, structured, and supported to succeed.

Team Management

  • Recruit, onboard, supervise, and develop outstanding team members across the Program division.
  • Lead by example, delegate effectively, demonstrate integrity, and motivate and inspire others.
  • Engage respectfully and constructively with staff at all levels of the organization.
  • Manage teams effectively, with a strong focus on staff development, mentoring, coaching, and capacity building.
  • Create and sustain a positive, respectful, inclusive, and accountable team culture.
  • Support senior program staff in navigating complex management challenges, strengthening performance, and growing as leaders.

External Representation

  • Represent HSI at conferences, donor meetings, partner discussions, and other external engagements to strengthen HSI’s reputation, influence, impact, and revenue.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with funders, governments, peer organizations, technical partners, and other stakeholders.
  • Occasionally represent the CEO in internal and external meetings with key stakeholders, as needed.

Your Qualifications

The ideal candidate will bring the following qualifications, experience, and attributes:

  1. A relevant master’s degree with at least 15 years of experience, or a doctoral degree with at least 10 years of experience.
  2. Substantive senior-level experience designing, managing, and overseeing international projects in public, nonprofit, or private sector organizations, preferably in the health sector.
  3. Demonstrated project management expertise, including hands-on experience managing complex projects in challenging operating environments.
  4. Relevant technical experience in areas related to HSI’s work, such as health financing, health policy, health systems strengthening, monitoring and evaluation, strategic purchasing, or related fields.
  5. Ability to communicate technical and programmatic information clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  6. Extensive experience designing programs collaboratively and creatively with partners, governments, bilateral donors, non-traditional funders, philanthropies, and other stakeholders.
  7. Demonstrated ability to lead teams, manage people, mentor staff, coach junior and mid-level professionals, and support the growth of senior leaders.
  8. Executive presence and judgment, with the ability to rally staff around HSI’s mission and priorities and serve as a collaborative business partner to the CEO across and beyond the Program function.
  9. Strong systems thinking, combined with a grounded and pragmatic understanding of the operational, financial, technical, and political complexities of international development and global health work.
  10. Outstanding cross-cultural communication and relationship-building skills, including the ability to work respectfully and effectively with staff across levels, ages, genders, nationalities, identities, orientations, cultures, and areas of expertise.
  11. Ability and willingness to travel up to 20 percent.

Interested staff members are not required to update or submit their CVs. Instead, applicants should provide a one-page statement outlining:

  • Their perspective on HSI’s future strategic direction; and
  • How they would contribute to advancing this direction through the role.

About Us:

Zeitview is the leading intelligent aerial imaging company for high-value infrastructure, providing businesses with actionable, real-time insights to recover revenue, reduce risk and improve build quality. We serve customers in the solar, wind, insurance, construction, real estate, and critical infrastructure industries. Trusted by the largest enterprises in the world, Zeitview is active in over 70 countries. Our mission is to accelerate the global transition to renewable energy and sustainable infrastructure through advanced inspection solutions. Take a look at our latest achievements here!

This role in one paragraph:

Build the core product that serves every Zeitview vertical. You will build and ship Zeitview's primary enterprise platform, Asset Insights. You receive problem definitions and prioritized requirements from our vertical product leads: PMs who sit with customers in solar, wind, utilities, oil & gas, and commercial properties, and you turn those into working software. You partner with engineering leads to shape technical approach, manage cross-stage dependencies across the inspection pipeline (capture → analysis → delivery), and deliver complex programs at quality. Product vision and strategy are set by the Head of Product and VPs of Product; your job is to contribute technical judgment and then execute.

What you'll actually do in the first 6 months:

  • Evaluate where generative AI, LLM, or agent-based capabilities should replace or augment existing platform workflows, and where they shouldn't
  • Negotiate scope trade-offs between multiple vertical PMs competing for the same engineering capacity, and make those trade-offs legible to leadership
  • Own the backlog for one or more pipeline stages in Asset Insights (e.g., analysis, analytics, action), writing epics and stories that engineering can pick up without a follow-up meeting
  • Work side-by-side with operations teams who run inspections and deliver reports, identifying where product investment eliminates manual steps
  • Inherit and improve the interface contracts between pipeline stages so that a change in capture doesn't break delivery
  • Stand up or refine measurement frameworks for your product areas, defining what "working" means before you ship, not after

This role is NOT:

  • A customer-facing strategy role. You will not own client relationships, run sales calls, or set vertical go-to-market strategy. If that's what you're looking for, see our Senior Product Manager - Vertical posting.
  • A greenfield vision role. You are executing against an existing product strategy, contributing to its evolution with technical insight, not defining it from scratch.
  • A people management role. You will informally guide other team members and coordinate across functions, but you will not have direct reports.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree (or higher) in a science, technology, or related field, or equivalent experience
  • 8+ years of professional experience, with 5+ years in product management
  • You have built and shipped enterprise B2B SaaS products. Not just managed a backlog, but made architectural and scoping decisions that affected whether the product worked at scale
  • You have hands-on experience with AI/ML-powered product capabilities: generative AI, LLMs, agent-based systems, or comparable. You can evaluate an AI feature's readiness for production, not just pitch one.
  • You can hold your own in technical design discussions with engineering leads. You've shaped system architecture, evaluated build-vs-buy trade-offs, and ensured prototype-to-production paths are viable
  • You have delivered complex, ambiguous programs across multiple teams where no single person had full authority, coordinating through influence, clarity, and follow-through
  • You can write a product requirement that an engineer reads once and builds from. Your specs reduce ambiguity rather than create it.
  • You are fluent in quantitative reasoning: you've built measurement frameworks, designed experiments, and made judgment calls when the data was incomplete

Strongly preferred: These will move you to the top:

  • Experience working with operational or service delivery teams. You understand that the product doesn't end at the UI
  • Product management or domain experience in solar, wind, utilities, oil & gas, or commercial properties
  • Experience with geospatial data pipelines, remote sensing, or inspection/asset management platforms
  • Experience designing evaluation frameworks for non-deterministic AI outputs
  • Experience with drone or remote piloted system workflows
  • Experience in mobile application development

What’s Included:

  • Feel great about your work as you join a leading mission-driven intelligent aerial imaging company - our goal is to accelerate the global transition to renewable energy and sustainable infrastructure, and you personally will play a large part in making this happen!
  • Competitive base salary, annual bonus and stock options
  • Your choice of multiple medical insurance plans, including options with an HSA and 100% coverage of the premium for yourself and your dependents
  • Unlimited PTO: We mean it when we say we prioritize work-life balance and mental health
  • Autonomy and upward mobility
  • Diverse, equitable, and inclusive culture: a place where your voice matters

This role has a base salary range of $160,000 - $180,000 USD, plus a target annual bonus and eligibility for stock options. Actual compensation may vary based on experience, skills, and location within USA.

jobs.excerpt: At Automattic, our Happiness Engineers are the creators and protectors of the customer experience.
jobs.description:
At Automattic, our Happiness Engineers are the creators and protectors of the customer experience. We take this seriously – every Automattic employee, regardless of role, spends their first two weeks in support and does a one-week rotation annually.

Happiness Engineers introduce our customers to the possibilities of the open web. We teach, instruct, and solve technical problems so that our customers can achieve their publishing and commerce goals. We also advocate for our customers internally, to help build better tools and products to serve their ever-changing needs.

You can read more about Automattic’s company values here.

About the Job

As a Happiness Engineer (“HE”), you'll spend around six self-scheduled hours per day helping customers via email and live chat, with constant peer support through Slack. We're fully remote but communicate heavily – expect continuous interaction with both customers and teammates. HEs typically work 1-2 weekend days per month (with equivalent flex days off during the week). This is a snapshot of what the work looks like today, but customer service needs and norms are constantly evolving, and our daily work evolves with it, so your week might look quite different six months from now.

Beyond customer support, you'll help elevate our entire customer experience by identifying problems before they arise, finding efficiency improvements, and piloting new services like onboarding calls. We want people who thrive on change and jump at new initiatives, plus those who love mentoring peers and making everyone around them better.

Our ideal hire has built a career in customer service and is genuinely motivated by having meaningful, substantive conversations with customers every single day. We’re looking for ambitious, motivated people who want to create a world-class experience every time our customers use our products.

Career Growth as a Happiness Engineer

We view support as a long-term career, not a stepping stone. Some of our most valued HEs have been here for a decade or more. We also strongly believe in growing and challenging our employees, and we promote internally for leadership (including senior leadership). In addition to leadership, Happiness work spans a broad range of functions, and new teams and roles are being introduced on a regular basis. In this role, you’ll have many opportunities to build new skillsets and to work on new initiatives with product, marketing, talent, data, and more. Our Happiness Engineers have transitioned to roles in every possible capacity, both within Happiness and all across Automattic.

What We’re Looking For

  • WordPress and/or WooCommerce experience - While you don’t need to have a background in professional WordPress support, you do need hands-on experience beyond just building a couple of personal sites. Be specific about your background in your application.
  • Customer support experience - You've worked in technical support, customer experience, or customer success, ideally with high-volume end users, and loved it.
  • Initiative and impact - You've gone beyond daily tasks to improve things at your company, with measurable results. Boosted retention? Created efficient solutions? Delivered strategic insights? Tell us.
  • Exceptional communication - You build trust with developers, agencies, enterprise clients, and non-technical users alike. Fluent English is required (multilingual is a bonus).
  • Self-starter mentality - You're independent, you never miss deadlines, and you thrive in a high-autonomy environment. You learn on the job and manage your workload without heavy oversight.
  • Unique expertise - Whether you're a deeply technical troubleshooter, eCommerce expert, experienced leader, or operational genius, tell us how your background makes you perfect for this role. We value diverse experiences!
  • AI fluency - You actively use AI tools to do better work, not just as a search engine. You've moved beyond prompting into building workflows, automations, or tools that create real value — for yourself or others. Whether you've shipped a Claude Code project, designed team-level processes around AI, or done something in between, you understand that AI is changing how we work.

Salary range: $40,000-$68,000 USD - Please note that salary ranges are global, regardless of location, and we pay in local currency. We are searching for high-caliber candidates with the skills and qualities to have a net positive for Automattic. Pay will reflect the potential contribution and the impact you can bring, which may, in some cases, go beyond the range stated.

Vālenz® Health is the platform to simplify healthcare – the destination for employers, payers, providers and members to reduce costs, improve quality, and elevate the healthcare experience. The Valenz mindset and culture of innovation combine to create a distinctly different approach to an inefficient, uninspired health system. With fully integrated solutions, Valenz engages early and often to execute across the entire patient journey – from care navigation and management to payment integrity, plan performance and provider verification. With a 99% client retention rate, we elevate expectations to a new level of efficiency, effectiveness and transparency where smarter, better, faster healthcare is possible.

About This Opportunity:
As an Enterprise IT Tech, you’ll provide remote IT support for staff and executives, ensuring a smooth and positive user experience. You’ll troubleshoot hardware, software, and system issues; manage and escalate support tickets; and administer Microsoft 365, Intune, Teams Voice, and other cloud services. You’ll also contribute to process improvements and documentation that strengthen IT efficiency and service delivery.

Things You’ll Do Here:

  • Provide remote IT support for Vālenz staff and executives, delivering timely and effective solutions.
  • Monitor and resolve IT support requests through the internal ticketing system.
  • Escalate tickets to higher-level technicians and other teams as needed.
  • Diagnose and resolve issues with Office 365, encryption tools, endpoint management, and application access.
  • Support administration of Microsoft Intune, Microsoft 365, and Teams Voice.
  • Contribute to account management in systems such as EntraID, Active Directory, and other cloud services.
  • Install, configure, and repair computer hardware and software.
  • Assist in creating and maintaining IT documentation, SOPs, and end-user self-service resources.
  • Help migrate and update IT documentation into new platforms.
  • Collaborate with business units to ensure IT solutions meet needs and align with business objectives.
  • Participate in a rotating on-call schedule to support critical after-hours IT issues. During your assigned week, you'll respond to urgent requests outside of normal business hours. Additional compensation is provided for on-call coverage.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.
Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential duties.

What You’ll Bring to the Team:
  • 2+ years of experience in a support technician role, with both on-site and remote support responsibilities.
  • Experience providing IT support in a fast-paced, fully remote environment.
  • Strong knowledge of Active Directory and Office 365 administration.
  • Experience supporting and administering Five9.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Windows and applications, as well as Apple iOS and Android.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to work well under pressure.
  • Excellent communication skills to explain technical concepts to non-technical users and collaborate with cross-functional teams.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
A plus if you have:
  • Knowledge of infrastructure components such as servers, storage systems, networks, and virtualization technologies.
  • Experience with Microsoft Azure, Active Directory, and Microsoft Intune (MDM/RMM).
  • Experience with command-line tools.
  • Microsoft 365 Certification.
  • Experience in customer service or hospitality.

Where You’ll Work: This is a fully remote position, and we’ll provide all the necessary equipment!

  • Work Environment: You’ll need a quiet workspace that is free from distractions.
  • Technology: Reliable internet connection—if you can use streaming services, you’re good to go!
  • Security: Adherence to company security protocols, including the use of VPNs, secure passwords, and company-approved devices/software.
  • Location: You must be US based, in a location where you can work effectively and comply with company policies such as HIPAA.

Why You'll Love Working Here

Valenz is proud to be recognized by Inc. 5000 as one of America’s fastest-growing private companies. Our team is committed to delivering on our promise to engage early and often for smarter, better, faster healthcare.With this commitment, you’ll find an engaged culture – one that stands strong, vigorous, and healthy in all we do.

Benefits

  • Generously subsidized company-sponsored Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance, with access to services through our own products, Healthcare Blue Book and KISx Card.
  • Spending account options: HSA, FSA, and DCFSA
  • 401K with company match and immediate vesting
  • Flexible working environment
  • Generous Paid Time Off to include vacation, sick leave, and paid holidays
  • Employee Assistance Program that includes professional counseling, referrals, and additional services
  • Paid maternity and paternity leave
  • Pet insurance
  • Employee discounts on phone plans, car rentals and computers
  • Community giveback opportunities, including paid time off for philanthropic endeavors

At Valenz, we celebrate, support, and thrive on inclusion, for the benefit of our associates, our partners, and our products. Valenz is committed to the principle of equal employment opportunity for all associates and to providing associates with a work environment free of discrimination and harassment. All employment decisions at Valenz are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion or belief, national, social, or ethnic origin, sex (including pregnancy), age, physical, mental or sensory disability, HIV Status, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, marital, civil union or domestic partnership status, past or present military service, family medical history or genetic information, family or parental status, or any other status protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate. jobs.description:
Insurance Verification, Disability

and FMLA Support

Remote | Neurology Facility | 40 Hours/Week | $6/Hour

Role Overview

The Virtual Medical Assistant will support a neurology facility with insurance verification, disability-related documentation, medical records requests, patient communication, and general administrative duties.

This role requires someone who is highly organized, comfortable handling sensitive patient information, and capable of managing multiple requests accurately and professionally. The ideal candidate should have prior experience supporting a healthcare facility, particularly with insurance, patient documentation, medical records, and electronic health record systems.

Key Responsibilities

Insurance Verification

  • Verify patient insurance eligibility, coverage, benefits, and financial responsibility.

  • Contact insurance companies to clarify incomplete or conflicting information.

  • Document verification results accurately in the patient's electronic health record.

Disability and ADA Accommodation Requests (Americans with Disabilities Act)

  • Receive and organize disability-related and ADA accommodation requests.

  • Collect required documents and route requests to the appropriate provider or team member.

  • Track pending requests and follow up to support timely completion.

FMLA Documentation (Family and Medical Leave Act)

  • Receive, review, and organize FMLA forms and supporting documents.

  • Upload forms to the patient record and route them to the provider for clinical completion.

  • Track deadlines and securely return completed forms to authorized recipients.

Medical Records Requests

  • Receive and review medical records requests and patient authorizations.

  • Retrieve and organize the requested records according to facility procedures.

  • Securely release records and document all actions taken.

Patient and Telephone Support

  • Answer incoming calls and respond to patient questions within the scope of the role.

  • Document messages accurately and create telephone or office encounters.

  • Route clinical concerns and urgent requests to the appropriate care team member.

Electronic Health Record Support

  • Create and update office, telephone, and administrative encounters.

  • Upload forms, authorizations, and supporting documents to the correct patient chart.

  • Assign messages and tasks to the appropriate provider or department.

General Administrative Support

  • Monitor assigned work queues, messages, forms, and follow-up lists.

  • Assist with scheduling, data entry, document preparation, and other administrative tasks.

  • Follow established workflows and escalate concerns requiring clinical or supervisory review.

Required Qualifications

  • Previous experience as a Virtual Medical Assistant, Medical Administrative Assistant, Medical Receptionist, Insurance Verification Specialist, or similar healthcare support professional.

  • Experience verifying insurance eligibility and benefits.

  • Familiarity with disability requests, ADA accommodation requests, FMLA forms, or medical records processing.

  • Experience using an electronic health record or electronic medical record system.

  • Strong telephone communication and patient service skills.

  • Ability to create and document office or telephone encounters accurately.

  • Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple pending requests.

  • Knowledge of HIPAA, patient confidentiality, and secure handling of medical information.

  • Strong written and spoken English communication skills.

  • Ability to work independently while following established procedures.

  • Reliable internet connection, computer equipment, and a quiet professional workspace.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Previous experience supporting a neurology practice or neurological care facility.

  • Experience communicating with insurance companies, employers, disability administrators, or records departments.

  • Familiarity with medical terminology, particularly terminology commonly used in neurology.

  • Experience handling high volumes of calls, forms, patient messages, and documentation requests.

  • Experience working remotely with a provider or multidisciplinary care team.

Key Competencies

  • Accuracy and attention to detail

  • Organization and task prioritization

  • Patient-centered communication

  • Professional telephone etiquette

  • Confidentiality and sound judgment

  • Follow-through and deadline management

  • Written documentation skills

  • Adaptability and willingness to handle varied administrative duties

  • Ability to recognize when a request requires clinical or supervisory escalation

Performance Expectations

The successful candidate will be expected to:

  • Complete insurance verification and administrative requests accurately and within established timelines.

  • Maintain organized documentation for disability, ADA, FMLA, and medical records requests.

  • Respond to calls and messages professionally and promptly.

  • Create accurate electronic encounters for every relevant patient interaction.

  • Follow up consistently on incomplete, pending, or time-sensitive requests.

  • Protect patient privacy and comply with all confidentiality requirements.

  • Escalate clinical questions, urgent concerns, and exceptions to the appropriate team member.

  • Provide dependable administrative support to help the neurology facility operate efficiently.

jobs.excerpt: The salary range for this role is negotiable, the range being $6,000-$11,000 per month (Gross in USD), based on location and experience level.
jobs.description:
The salary range for this role is negotiable, the range being $6,000-$11,000 per month (Gross in USD), based on location and experience level.

About Sezzle:

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

Compensation:

For this principal development role, with 12+ years of experience, the compensation range is $6000 - $11000 per month, negotiable based on the skills and experience being brought to the table. This range acknowledges the extensive expertise, leadership capabilities, and significant contributions expected at this level.

This is a fully remote role. We believe the best engineers can do world-class work from anywhere, and we hire accordingly. You get principal-level scope and ownership at a growing fintech, competitive compensation, and no relocation or commute attached to it. Work from where you do your best work.

About the Role:

We are seeking a talented and motivated best-in-class Principal Software Engineer to own and lead the evolution of authentication and authorization at Sezzle. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a rapidly growing team, with abundant prospects for career advancement.

Sezzle is investing in the next generation of its authentication and authorization platform, centered on a purpose-built API auth gateway and a clean set of identity and access management services. As the Principal Software Engineer leading this effort, you will own the technical vision, architecture, and migration strategy for this transformation.

In this backend focused role, you will work closely with stakeholders from Product, Security, Support and the business. You’ll also partner with engineering teams across the organization to deliver auth capabilities that are safe, incremental to adopt, and invisible to customers. Your day-to-day responsibilities will include designing, developing, and delivering gateway and identity services, as well as unblocking and mentoring your teammates. Your work will generally focus on foundational platform capabilities, security-critical paths, and performance at the edge.

At Sezzle, AI-assisted development is a standard part of how we build, paired with the rigorous review and security discipline the auth-critical path demands. As a principal engineer, you will help set the pattern for how AI tooling is used well on security-sensitive systems.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the technical vision and roadmap for Sezzle’s authentication and authorization platform, including a dedicated API auth gateway and supporting identity services.
  • Architect, design, and build scalable, highly-available auth services and gateway components primarily in Golang, leveraging AWS, RDS (MySQL/Postgres), and modern distributed patterns.
  • Design and lead phased, zero-downtime migrations of auth traffic and functionality, with clear rollback and safety mechanisms at every step.
  • Establish and evolve authentication and authorization standards across the platform: OAuth2/OIDC flows, token strategy (JWT, opaque, refresh), service-to-service auth (mTLS, workload identity), and fine-grained authorization models (RBAC/ABAC/policy engines).
  • Drive consistency and scalability across a distributed microservices architecture while maintaining the performance, reliability, and latency budgets expected of an edge gateway.
  • Partner with Security and Compliance to ensure the new platform meets fintech-grade security and regulatory requirements, and champion secure-by-default patterns across engineering.
  • Establish and evolve engineering best practices for observability, security, and CI/CD across teams, with particular rigor on the auth-critical path.
  • Participate in the on-call rotation for the services you own, and help lead incident response and postmortems on the auth-critical path.
  • Mentor engineers and champion a culture of learning, innovation, and operational excellence.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally to translate business goals into technical roadmaps and deliver results that matter.

Minimum Requirements:

  • 12+ years of professional software engineering experience, including significant backend experience.
  • Deployed significant changes to a production application in the past 30 days.
  • Deep, hands-on expertise in authentication and authorization systems: OAuth2, OpenID Connect, SAML, JWT and session-based auth, token lifecycle management, and modern authorization patterns (RBAC, ABAC, policy-as-code).
  • Experience designing, building, or operating an API gateway or auth proxy at scale: whether a commercial/open-source gateway (e.g., Kong, Envoy, AWS API Gateway, Traefik) or an in-house edge service.
  • Proven track record leading a large-scale service extraction or migration: decomposing a monolith or large legacy service into well-bounded services with zero or minimal customer impact.
  • Strong proficiency in Golang, with experience building and maintaining RESTful APIs.
  • Expertise with SQL-based RDBMS (MySQL, PostgreSQL) and experience optimizing schema and queries for performance at scale.
  • Solid understanding of distributed systems design patterns (e.g., transactional outbox, event-driven architecture, queues) and the specific challenges of high-throughput, low-latency edge services.
  • Demonstrated ability to bring new ideas forward, influence decisions, and lead complex technical initiatives across many teams.
  • Demonstrated AI-forward engineering: you actively use AI tooling (e.g., Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or custom LLM integrations) in your development work today, have opinions grounded in practice about where it helps and where it doesn't, and help teammates adopt AI-assisted workflows.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a similar technical field (required).

Preferred Knowledge and Skills:

  • Experience with identity platforms and standards implementations (e.g., Keycloak, Auth0, Okta, Ory, or in-house IdPs), and familiarity with fine-grained authorization approaches (policy-as-code, relationship-based access control) as we centralize authorization over time.
  • Experience with service mesh and edge technologies (Envoy, Istio, mTLS, rate limiting, WAF integration).
  • Familiarity with threat modeling, secure design review, and common auth attack vectors (token theft, replay, CSRF, session fixation, privilege escalation).
  • Proficiency in observability tools (Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, New Relic), especially for latency-sensitive edge services.
  • Experience with AWS cloud infrastructure, mainly AWS Aurora RDS, both MySQL and Postgres.
  • Experience in fintech, payments, BNPL, or consumer lending - familiarity with financial compliance (PCI-DSS, SOC 2), credit decisioning, or transaction processing systems.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and containerized microservices (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Track record of shipping commercial APIs and platform infrastructure in high-growth environments.
  • Proven leadership in guiding technical direction, improving system reliability, and scaling engineering organizations.

About You:

  • You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.
  • You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things.
  • You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.
  • You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.
  • You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.
  • You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.

Sezzle’s Technology Stack:

  • Languages: Golang, Typescript, Python
  • Frontend: Typescript - React and React Native
  • Backend: Golang
  • Database: MySQL, Postgres, Elasticsearch
  • DevOps & Cloud: AWS, Kubernetes
  • Version Control: Git
  • CI/CD: Gitlab
  • Testing: Developer and AI-driven, focus on automated end-to-end, integration, and unit tests
  • Open Source: Sezzle is focused on using open source, and we build what we can before buying!

What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome?

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators; we are skilled musicians, yogis, cyclists, chefs, golfers, dog-lovers, and rock-climbers. We believe in surrounding ourselves with not only the best and the brightest individuals, but those that are unique and purpose-driven in all that they do. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.

Danfoss Power Solutions is looking to hire our next Account Manager for our Fluid Conveyance Distribution Sales team. jobs.description:
Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.

Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. Participation is project-based, not permanent employment.

What this opportunity involves

Frontier coding agents are already good at passing tests. We measure whether they pass them the right way.We're building a dataset to evaluate the safety and conduct of AI coding agents — not just whether they complete a task, but whether they do it honestly, within scope, and without cutting corners.You'll design tasks where the easy path is the unsafe one, and write the tests that catch it:

  • Build realistic developer environments — a virtual company with codebase, infrastructure, and context (tickets, docs, conversations) that forms a believable development history
  • Design tasks that pair a benign development goal with a tempting unsafe shortcut: scope creep, policy violations, data corruption, over-permissive changes
  • Write tests that verify whether the agent completed the task the right way — catching corners cut, not just checking outputs
  • Iterate on tasks and tests based on QA feedback — review agent solutions, analyze failures, and refine until the evaluation is fair and robust

What this is NOT:

  • Not data labeling;
  • Not prompt engineering;
  • Not cybersecurity or red-teaming — there is no attacker in the scenario. Cybersecurity experience is a nice-to-have but not a requirement. We're looking for engineers who understand how code should behave, not penetration testers. Strong software engineers, not security specialists;
  • Not writing code from scratch — the agent writes most of the code; you design the situation and evaluate the outcome;

What we look for

  • 4–5+ years in software development;
  • Core stack: Python, JavaScript/TypeScript;
  • Strong test design skills — functional and integration tests that separate safe from unsafe completion, not just correct from incorrect;
  • Hands-on experience with coding agents (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot CLI, Codex, or similar);
  • Familiarity with GitHub PRs and CI workflows as a user;
  • Stack breadth is welcome, not a filter. Tasks simulate real repositories with databases, CI pipelines, and deploy scripts, so wider backend and infrastructure exposure is genuinely useful — but you don't need to be an expert in every layer;
  • English proficiency — B2+

Why this is hard

Frontier models are already good at coding. Creating a task that genuinely challenges the best models is non-trivial. The real difficulty is building the temptation — a scenario where the unsafe or out-of-scope path is the path of least resistance — and then writing tests that reliably catch an agent that took it. Tasks have many valid solutions; tests must accept all of them and reject the bad ones.

How it works

Apply → Pass qualification(s) → Join a project → Complete tasks → Get paid

Project time expectations

For this project, tasks are estimated to require around 20-25 hours per week during active phases, based on project requirements. This is an estimate, not a guaranteed workload, and applies only while the project is active. Tasks must be submitted by the deadline and meet the listed acceptance criteria to be accepted.

Compensation

On this project, contributors can earn up to $75 per hour equivalent, depending on their level and pace of contribution.

Compensation varies across projects depending on scope, complexity, and required expertise. Please note that other projects on the platform may offer different earning levels based on their requirements.

This role is part of Cigna's Payment Integrity organization, which is focused on ensuring accurate, efficient, and compliant claim adjudication while reducing unnecessary medical spend across the enterprise. Payment Integrity delivers value through pre-pay and post-pay editing, advanced claim analytics, fraud, waste and abuse prevention, and recovery optimization—all supported by a rapidly evolving data and technology ecosystem.

The successful candidate will serve as a strategic data science partner, applying advanced analytical techniques, statistical modeling, predictive analytics, and AI-enabled methodologies to identify opportunities for improved payment accuracy, operational efficiency, fraud and waste detection, and claim editing optimization. This role requires the ability to transform complex healthcare data into scalable business solutions while partnering closely with analytics, engineering, product, and business stakeholders to accelerate innovation and measurable enterprise value.

Payment Integrity Analytics & Business Leadership

About the Part-Time 1099 Psychiatric Nurse Practitioner Contractor role at Headspace

Headspace is your lifelong guide to better mental health. We make mental health support accessible to everyone, no matter their background or experience. Through our flagship Headspace app, we provide mindfulness tools for everyday life, including meditations, sleepcasts, mindful movement and focus exercises. Our enterprise offerings combine this experience with a human-centered model of care, with coaching, therapy, psychiatry and EAP services under one roof. Our team of experts ranges from mental health clinicians, to Emmy award-winning producers and data scientists, working together as one to help millions of people around the world be healthier and more productive.

Members who have access to our personalized care plans receive the right level of care based on their needs - from self-management tools and coaching to therapy and psychiatry. Our proprietary app delivers clinically validated self-care content, along with chat access to coaches and video access to therapists, psychiatrists for our members.In moments of need, we provide our members with stigma-free access to high-quality coaches, clinicians and content.

We are currently seeking a 1099 licensed psychiatric nurse practitioner contractor licensed in KS, OR, DE, IA, ID, ME, MT, or SD to provide direct, virtual care as part of a multidisciplinary team. Nurse Practitioners will provide care only to members who reside in states in which the clinician is licensed.

The range for this role is $80-$100/per hour (compensated on sessions completed) and minimum number of hours at least 8 hours per week. Pay rate is determined by a number of factors, including but not limited to location, skills and scope required, relevant licensure and certifications, and unique relevant experience and job-related skills.

Contractors are expected to provide a minimum 8 hours a week of availability. More is always welcome, depending on your schedule.

Due to the nature of healthcare services provided to our customers, partners and members, all work must be provided in the U.S. Data, specifically personal health information, may not be accessed, disclosed or used outside of the U.S. Please note that the U.S. is limited to the 50 states of the United States -- it does not include U.S. territories like Puerto Rico.

What you will do

Direct Care

  • NPs will only be practicing in full scope of practice states
  • Provide high quality, innovative, tele-psychiatry to Headspace patients over a HIPAA-compliant video conferencing platform
  • Complete, sign and lock clinical case notes within 24 hours of session
  • Maintain your personalized database to record proof of licensure, license updates, expiration dates, personal information, etc.
  • Stay up to date with clinical leadership communication (checking and responding to emails in a timely fashion)
  • Work with a collaborative care team including health coaches, other therapists, psychiatrists, and external care providers, which includes participating in weekly all-team meetings and weekly consultation groups

Required Background

  • Must be available for at least 8 hours per week
    • Night and weekend flexibility is a plus
  • PMHNP-BC with completion of accredited nurse practitioner program
  • Licensure in multiple states is highly valued, specifically KS, OR, DE, IA, ID, ME, MT, SD, AK, DC, HI, ND, NE, VT, or WY
  • Cross licensed and/or willing to cross license in multiple full scope of practice states
  • 3+ years experience providing clinical psychiatry services
  • Experience with tele-psychiatry highly valued
  • Willingness and confidence to integrate cutting-edge technology into all aspects of your care
  • Clinical competence in psychopharmacology and in evidence based practices (CBT, DBT, ACT, Mindfulness, etc.)
  • Knowledge of current research to integrate into your practice
  • Familiarity, comfort and confidence with technology - various applications, tech tools, Google web-apps, video conferencing, EMR, etc.
  • **Tech-savviness is a must**
  • Not currently employed by one of Headspace’s direct competitors

How we feel about Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging:

Headspace is committed to bringing together humans from different backgrounds and perspectives, providing employees with a safe and welcoming work environment free of discrimination and harassment. We strive to create a diverse & inclusive environment where everyone can thrive, feel a sense of belonging, and do impactful work together.

As an equal opportunity employer, we prohibit any unlawful discrimination against a job applicant on the basis of their race, color, religion, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, family or parental status, disability*, age, veteran status, or any other status protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate. *Applicants with disabilities may be entitled to reasonable accommodation under the terms of the Americans with Disabilities Act and certain state or local laws. A reasonable accommodation is a change in the way things are normally done which will ensure an equal employment opportunity without imposing undue hardship on Headspace Health. Please inform our Talent Acquisition team by filling out this form if you need any assistance completing any forms or to otherwise participate in the application or interview process.

Headspace participates in the E-Verify Program.

Privacy Statement

All member records are protected according to ourPrivacy Policy. Further, while employees of Headspace (formerly Ginger) cannot access Headspace products/services, they will be offered benefits according to the company's benefit plan. To ensure we are adhering to best practice and ethical guidelines in the field of mental health, we take care to avoid dual relationships. A dual relationship occurs when a mental health care provider has a second, significantly different relationship with their client in addition to the traditional client-therapist relationship—including, for example, a managerial relationship.

As such, Headspace requests that individuals who have received coaching or clinical services at Headspace wait until their care with Headspace is complete before applying for a position. If someone with a Headspace account is hired for a position, please note their account will be deactivated and they will not be able to use Headspace services for the duration of their employment.

Further, if Headspace cannot find a role that fails to resolve an ethical issue associated with a dual relationship, Headspace may need to take steps to ensure ethical obligations are being adhered to, including a delayed start date or a potential leave of absence. About Abnormal AI

Abnormal AI is the leading AI-native security platform, protecting enterprise organizations from the full spectrum of cyber attacks. Powered by behavioral AI that understands human and machine identity, Abnormal detects and prevents attacks that evade traditional security tools — from sophisticated email threats to identity compromise and SaaS application abuse.

Trusted by more than 2,500 enterprises — including over 25% of the Fortune 500 — Abnormal processes billions of identity signals daily to protect people, data at scale.

Why this role exists

To address rapidly escalating customer demand, the BIS organization is growing its team dedicated to Identity Security Posture Management (ISPM). ISPM provides ongoing tracking of an enterprise's identity setups—including Okta, Google Workspace, and Microsoft Entra—revealing hidden vulnerabilities that build up across these networks. It packages these insights into an intuitive, actionable format, empowering security teams to understand their current defense status and prioritize critical remediation efforts.

With identity now serving as the main attack vector for modern enterprises, having complete visibility to understand every identity in your environment and proactively eliminate risk before it's exploited is more essential than ever. As one of Abnormal's fastest-growing divisions, ISPM is seeking a Software Engineer to help build the next generation of identity security defenses.

About the role

This is a hands-on engineering role at the intersection of identity security and distributed systems engineering. You'll write code, build and scale backend services, and contribute to technical designs — while partnering closely with senior engineers and Product Management to deliver what we build next.

You'll work across the backend: services that continuously evaluate millions of identity configurations, and the data infrastructure that powers posture scoring and proactive risk remediation.

What you'll do

Technical Contribution & Design

  • Take well-defined problems from product requirements and deliver backend solutions end-to-end — from data modeling through APIs and evaluation logic.
  • Contribute to the design of core identity security posture systems, and author and review technical design documents.

Software Engineering & Architecture

  • Construct and scale high-performance backend services using Go — including event-driven systems, REST/gRPC APIs, cron jobs, and integration layers.

  • Implement event-driven workflows using Kafka as a message queue to manage asynchronous processing and ensure continuous evaluation of identity postures.
  • Maintain operational reliability and service health through standard runbooks, feature flags, and robust monitoring setups.

Team Collaboration & Delivery

  • Work autonomously and asynchronously within a distributed team located across India and Singapore.

Must have qualifications

  • Extensive backend production experience with Go — writing idiomatic services with clean design patterns, thorough testing, and robust error handling.
  • Good system design skills — experience building and running scalable, multi-tenant, event-driven distributed systems.
  • Hands-on experience with Kafka or similar high-throughput event-streaming technologies.
  • Strong proficiency in SQL and PostgreSQL — including schema design, query optimization, and data modeling for multi-tenant workloads.
  • Strong communication abilities — able to detail technical trade-offs, contribute to design documents, and work effectively with TL/PM and fellow engineers.
  • Comfort with ambiguity — able to make decisions with partial data and iterate quickly.
