jobs.description:
At Memorial Hermann, we pursue a common goal of delivering high quality, efficient care while creating exceptional experiences for every member of our community. When we say every member of our community, that includes our employees. We know that when our employees feel cared for, heard and valued, they are inspired to create moments that exceed expectations, while prioritizing safety, compassion, personalization and efficiency. If you want to advance your career and contribute to our vision of creating healthier communities, now and for generations to come, we want you to be a part of our team.

Job Summary

As an integral member of the Analytics Team, the Senior Specialized Business Intelligence (BI) Analyst is responsible for creating advanced, information-based, business intelligence deliverables that will be relied upon by organizational leaders to support critical business decisions. The Senior Specialized BI Analyst will provide domain expertise in one or more specific areas, as required for the position, such as: clinical, consumer experience, finance, human resources, marketing, medical insurance, operational effectiveness and/or supply chain. This position will primarily work, but not exclusively, with customers across the organization in clinical, administrative and/or operational areas to provide analytical insights from reports and/or dashboard visualizations to facilitate discovery of new opportunities, support data-informed decision-making for identified challenges as well as develop new and enhance existing metrics to analyze ongoing performance metrics.

The Senior Specialized BI Analyst will be tasked with domain-specific requests to support transformation of data and information into actionable insights that answer complex business questions. This position will communicate insights and opportunities to leadership, analytical needs to technical teams, as well as serve as a domain expert and mentor to other team members supporting projects that are outside their specialized domain. This position will work with customers to understand and define the problems being solved, procure and integrate the data sources necessary to analyze the needs appropriately, deliver relevant analytics tools to meet customer’s objectives, implement and support the solutions for ongoing utilization.

The Senior Business Analyst partners with clinical, operational, and technical teams to deliver data-driven solutions that improve business processes and support strategic decision-making across the health system. This role serves as a key liaison between stakeholders and technical teams, facilitating meetings, gathering business needs, supporting users, and translating complex information into actionable solutions. The ideal candidate is a collaborative relationship builder with strong communication, problem-solving, and critical thinking skills who thrives in a fast-paced environment and is eager to learn emerging technologies, including predictive analytics and AI.

Job Description

MEMORIAL HERMANN CANNOT HIRE REMOTE WORKERS IN THE FOLLOWING STATES:

Arizona, California, Connecticut, Maryland, Massachusetts, Missouri, New Jersey, New York, Utah, Ohio, Pennsylvania, Washington, Alabama, Mississippi, Illinois, Oregon, Arkansas or Iowa

Desired Skill Set

  • Strong interpersonal, communication, and relationship-building skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across technical and non-technical teams.

  • Proven ability to facilitate meetings, gather business requirements, and translate complex concepts into practical solutions.

  • Customer-focused, proactive problem solver with strong critical thinking skills and a willingness to take initiative.

  • Experience supporting clinical or healthcare operations and an understanding of clinical workflows is preferred.

  • Interest in emerging technologies, including predictive analytics and AI, with a continuous learning mindset.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

Education: Bachelor’s degree, preferably in computer science, management information systems, data science, business administration, statistics, or related field or equivalent experience required. Master’s degree preferred.

Licenses/Certifications: Associate Certified Analytics Professional (aCAP) or another vendor-neutral analytics certification preferred. Applicable certification or accreditation for domain expertise strongly preferred.

Experience / Knowledge / Skills:

  • Minimum of 5 years professional experience providing similar analytics services for this role to one or more domain areas, as needed.

  • Minimum of 5 years professional experience collaborating with customers on the design, creation and execution of analytics deliverables.

  • Minimum of 5 years professional experience in building self-service analytic reports, dashboards and/or tools supporting decision-making and actionable metric monitoring by customers.

  • Demonstrated experience and successful results from working in a dynamic, matrixed organization with executive exposure.

  • Advanced proficiency with the following tools, as necessary for position:

    • MS Office Suite: Excel (Pivot tables, VBA, Macros), Word, PowerPoint, Visio, Access (Required)

    • Database querying: SQL

    • Visualization tools – Tableau (preferred), Sisense, Qlik or Microsoft PowerBI

    • Statistical tools - R, Python, SAS, SPSS or other statistical tools for data analysis. (Preferred)

  • Demonstrated critical thinking and advanced creative problem-solving skills and aptitude to exert influence without authority through interpreting requirements and guiding customers to the desired analytics outcomes.

  • Analytic mindset able to draw conclusions from raw data and summarize and present results efficiently using logic and reasoning to identify approaches to problems.

  • Ability to visualize data in a meaningful way to communicate effectively the meaning and the necessary action to be taken.

  • Act with an intellectual curiosity to obtain insights from data and search for solutions to the problems being explored as well as new ones to be discovered.

  • Understand math and statistical concepts to provide analysis to formulate meaningful decisions.

  • Exceptional time management skills and attention to detail.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, specifically with an ability to communicate effectively across multiple management levels.

  • Proven ability to work independently and as part of a team under established deadlines to drive critical outcomes.

  • Create a positive work environment that fosters successful team performance.

  • Strong customer service, interpersonal and relationship-building skills.

PRINCIPAL ACCOUNTABILITIES

  • Serve as the analytics domain expert for assigned area(s) and advise/support others in support of efforts for the domain.

  • Act as advisor and mentor to others offering high level support, mentorship, education and training.

  • Ongoing interactions with customers, leadership and teams across the organization to enhance knowledge of business, clinical and administrative processes and applications utilized by the various clients.

  • Partner with respective customers to identify analytics insights, communicate insights and opportunities across system organizational matrix, in support of system strategic goals.

  • Partner with customers and technical teams to design, develop and implement the analytics insights and tools in support of actionable, operational, strategic and tactical metrics for optimization.

  • Partner with the greater Analytics team to evolve Memorial Hermann’s Analytics Maturity Level to incorporate the full analytics spectrum of descriptive, diagnostic, predictive and prescriptive analytics.

  • Collaborate with the greater Analytics Team to develop the data architecture strategy, implementation plan and customer-delivered toolset.

  • Active participation in and support of the Memorial Hermann Data Governance Program.

  • Perform regular and ad-hoc analysis to produce user-friendly data analysis, insights, reports and/or visualizations for executive and client review.

  • Continuous improvement of existing processes to identify data inconsistencies that may impact insights.

  • Summarize analytical insights, communicate and distribute insights to leadership as well as across technical teams by incorporating new techniques, initiatives and technologies.

  • Provide support from problem analysis through resolution to correct deficiencies within analytic, reporting and visualization applications.

  • Continually further analytics knowledge and skill set through various channels to ensure MHHS remains on the cutting edge of the Healthcare industry.

  • Key member of the project team responsible for training, coaching and mentoring new analytic professionals to meet the established standard.

  • Ensures safe care to patients, staff and visitors; adheres to all Memorial Hermann policies, procedures, and standards within budgetary specifications including time management, supply management, productivity and quality of service

  • Promotes individual professional growth and development by meeting requirements for mandatory/continuing education and skills competency; supports department-based goals which contribute to the success of the organization; serves as preceptor, mentor and resource to less experienced staff

  • Demonstrates commitment to caring for every member of our community by creating compassionate and personalized experiences. Models Memorial Hermann’s service standards by providing safe, caring, personalized and efficient experiences to patients and colleagues.

  • Other duties as assigned

jobs.excerpt: Job Description Votre lieu de travail: N’importe où au Québec Chez GoTo, l’innovation portée par l’application concrète de l’IA touche toutes les sphères de notre entreprise, pas seulement nos équipes techniques.
jobs.description:
Job Description

Votre lieu de travail: N’importe où au Québec

Chez GoTo, l’innovation portée par l’application concrète de l’IA touche toutes les sphères de notre entreprise, pas seulement nos équipes techniques. Nous adoptons des outils alimentés par l’IA intuitifs et conviviaux ainsi qu’une approche créative de la résolution de problèmes, afin d’améliorer notre façon de collaborer et de servir nos clients. Ici, vous ferez partie d’une communauté collaborative qui apprend, s’adapte et inspire le changement en tout temps. Si vous aspirez à établir des relations solides et à faire une différence significative au quotidien, GoTo est le bon endroit pour vous.

À propos du poste

GoTo recherche un(e) vice-président(e) de produit pour diriger LogMeIn Resolve, notre plateforme de gestion des TI et de soutien à distance reconnue et utilisée par les équipes des TI et les prestataires de services gérés (PSG) à l’échelle mondiale. Il s’agit d’un poste à forte influence qui allie la stratégie produit à un leadership transversal pour générer des résultats commerciaux pour l’entreprise.

Resolve se trouve à un moment charnière, évoluant d’un outil d’accès à distance de premier ordre à une plateforme de gestion unifiée des appareils (UEM), caractérisée par des capacités d’IA agentique et une architecture à vérification systématique. Vous dirigerez cette transformation avec détermination en favorisant une croissance efficiente, en exerçant une grande autonomie et en représentant Resolve au niveau de la haute direction auprès de l’ensemble de GoTo.

Votre quotidien

En tant qu’un(e) Vice-président(e) de produit pur diriger LogMeIn Resolveun(e) vice-président(e) de produit pour diriger LogMeIn Resolve un(e) vice-président(e) de produit pour diriger LogMeIn Resolve un(e) vice-président(e) de produit pour diriger LogMeIn Resolve un(e) vice-président(e) de produit pour diriger LogMeIn Resolve, votre travail inclura les tâches suivantes :

  • Définir et piloter la vision du produit, la stratégie et la feuille de route pluriannuelle pour Resolve, en couvrant la gestion et la surveillance à distance (RMM), la gestion des appareils mobiles et la gestion unifiée des appareils (MDM/UEM), l’accès et le soutien à distance, le centre de services, la gestion des actifs TI (ITAM), les intégrations et le canal PSG.
  • Diriger la stratégie en matière d’IA agentique, de sorte de positionner Resolve comme une plateforme de référence dans l’automatisation des TI alimentée par l’IA.
  • Cerner les tendances émergentes et les besoins des clients afin d’orienter l’innovation et la différenciation du produit.
  • Prendre des décisions de priorisation dans un contexte de ressources limitées, en conciliant le rythme d’exécution, la dette technique et les paris stratégiques.
  • Diriger et développer une organisation de gestion des produits de plus de 15 personnes réparties dans plusieurs régions, en bâtissant une capacité d’IA agentique et en investissant dans le développement de l’équipe.
  • Collaborer avec les équipes des ventes, du marketing, de la réussite client et du développement afin de réaliser la feuille de route et de faire croître le pipeline, le taux de conversion et l’expansion dans les segments PME et PSG intermédiaires/supérieurs.
  • Assumer la responsabilité des objectifs et surveiller le rendement par rapport au plan (y compris la croissance du revenu annuel récurrent, la rétention nette du revenu et les commandes) en mettant en évidence les risques et les occasions auprès de la direction.
  • Interagir directement avec les clients et représenter Resolve lors de forums exécutifs, d’événements du secteur et auprès de partenaires importants.

Ce que nous recherchons

En tant qu’un(e) Vice-président(e) de produit pur diriger LogMeIn Resolve, vous devriez avoir un profil similaire au suivant :

  • Au minimum 10 ans d’expérience en gestion de produits, dont au moins 3 à 5 ans dans un poste de haute direction ou de vice-présidence, idéalement avec imputabilité en matière de profits et de pertes.
  • Expérience dans l’expansion d’un produit de logiciel-service B2B connaissant croissance et changement, et non simplement dans la gestion d’un produit mature.
  • Expérience en gestion des TI, en gestion des points terminaux ou dans un secteur adjacent de l’infrastructure d’entreprise (gestion et surveillance à distance, gestion unifiée des appareils, gestion des appareils mobiles, gestion des services TI).
  • Capacité démontrée à diriger des équipes interfonctionnelles vers des résultats mesurables tels que la croissance du revenu annuel récurrent, la fidélisation et le développement du pipeline.
  • Expérience en développement de produits d’IA ou agentiques, y compris en conception de systèmes agentiques.
  • Expérience dans le canal PSG, avec une compréhension des dynamiques commerciales et de produits du marché des services gérés.
  • Facilité à faire des présentations auprès de cadres et de publics internationaux; capacité de travailler efficacement entre les fuseaux horaires du Royaume-Uni/de l’Europe et de l’Amérique du Nord.

Ce que nous offrons

Chez GoTo, nous tenons à aider nos employés à réussir au travail et à se sentir soutenus dans leur vie personnelle. Nos avantages sociaux et nos programmes pour les employés sont conçus pour soutenir votre bien-être, votre croissance et votre sentiment d’appartenance. Voici ce à quoi vous pouvez vous attendre en tant que membre de notre équipe :

  • Des avantages médicaux complets;
  • Des congés et vacances payés généreux, des congés pour bénévolat, des journées de bien-être personnel trimestrielles et des journées sans réunions garanties;
  • Le remboursement des frais de scolarité et l’accès à des programmes de formation et de perfectionnement dirigés par un formateur ou accessibles à la demande;
  • Le programme de bien-être Thrive Global, un programme confidentiel d’aide aux employés (PAE), une application de bien-être et l’encadrement individuel en matière de bien-être;
  • Des communautés et programmes dirigés par les employés, y compris les groupes de ressources pour les employés (GRE), le programme « GoTo s’implique » ainsi que le jumelage des dons à des organismes de bienfaisance.

Nous fournissons de nombreux efforts à créer un milieu dans lequel chacun se sent accueilli, respecté et en mesure de contribuer. Bâtir une culture d’appartenance ne se limite pas à de belles paroles : c’est au cœur de notre façon de travailler jour après jour.

Les avantages et offres exacts peuvent varier d’un pays à l’autre, conformément à la réglementation nationale et aux pratiques du marché.

*** Langue de travail pour les postes situés au Québec

La connaissance du français est requise pour les postes situés en permanence au Québec afin que le titulaire puisse communiquer au besoin avec ses collègues, les partenaires et les fournisseurs au Québec. Une formation en français est offerte à tout titulaire d’un poste permanent au Québec qui ne possède pas une bonne connaissance du français.

*** Autres exigences linguistiques

La maîtrise de l’anglais est requise pour ce poste afin de communiquer avec les collègues, les clients et les partenaires (ou les fournisseurs) qui sont majoritairement situés à l’extérieur du Québec. Pour les postes en recherche et développement, il est également nécessaire de comprendre la documentation technique et scientifique de notre industrie disponible majoritairement en anglais.

Chez GoTo, vous trouverez la flexibilité, les ressources et le soutien dont vous avez besoin pour vous épanouir au travail, à la maison et partout ailleurs. Vous travaillerez à la réalisation d’un objectif commun avec une équipe ouverte d’esprit et unie dont l’impact est plus grand que la somme de ses parties. Nous nous engageons à créer un espace inclusif pour tous, parce que nous savons que ces perspectives uniques font de nous une entreprise et une communauté plus forte. Joignez-vous à nous pour faire partie d’une entreprise qui investit dans votre avenir. Ensemble, nous serons authentiques, nous verrons grand, nous avancerons rapidement, nous grandirons continuellement et nous maintiendrons notre priorité client. En savoir plus.

Job Description

About the Role

GoTo is looking for a VP of Product to lead LogMeIn Resolve, our IT management and remote support platform trusted by IT teams and MSPs worldwide. This is a high-impact role that combines product strategy with cross-functional leadership to drive commercial outcomes for the business.

Resolve is at a pivotal moment, evolving from a best-in-class remote access tool into a unified endpoint management (UEM) platform, distinguished by agentic AI capabilities and a zero-trust architecture. You'll lead this transformation with conviction — scaling growth efficiently, operating with significant autonomy, and representing Resolve at the executive level across GoTo.

Your Day to Day

Define and drive the multi-year product vision, strategy, and roadmap for Resolve across RMM, MDM/UEM, remote access & support, helpdesk, ITAM, integrations, and the MSP channel.
Lead the agentic AI strategy, positioning Resolve as a category-defining platform for AI-powered IT automation.
Identify emerging trends and customer needs to guide product innovation and differentiation.
Make prioritization decisions in a resource-constrained environment, balancing execution pace, technical debt, and strategic bets.
Lead and grow a 15+ person product management organization across multiple geographies, building agentic AI capability and investing in team development.
Partner with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Engineering to deliver the roadmap and grow pipeline, win rates, and expansion in the mid-upper SMB and MSP segments.
Own targets and track performance against plan — including ARR growth, net revenue retention, and bookings — surfacing risks and opportunities to leadership.
Engage directly with customers and represent Resolve in executive forums, at industry events, and with key partners.

What We're Looking For

10+ years of product management experience, including 3–5+ years in a senior director- or VP-level role, ideally with P&L accountability.
Experience scaling a B2B SaaS product through growth and change — not just managing a mature product.
Background in IT management, endpoint management, or an adjacent enterprise infrastructure category (RMM, UEM, MDM, ITSM).
Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams toward measurable outcomes such as ARR growth, retention, and pipeline.
Experience with AI/agentic product development, including agentic system design.
MSP channel experience, with an understanding of the commercial and product dynamics of the managed services market.
Comfortable presenting to executive and international audiences; able to work effectively across UK/European and North American time zones.

jobs.excerpt: Sobre a área:No Grupo RBS, conectamos marcas, pessoas e comunidades por meio de um ecossistema de comunicação que integra mídia, conteúdo, eventos e soluções digitais.
jobs.description:
Sobre a área:

No Grupo RBS, conectamos marcas, pessoas e comunidades por meio de um ecossistema de comunicação que integra mídia, conteúdo, eventos e soluções digitais. A Squad B2C é responsável por desenvolver e evoluir a plataforma de assinatura que sustenta a jornada de aquisição, autenticação e gestão de assinaturas digitais, garantindo soluções escaláveis, seguras e de alta performance.

Esta é uma oportunidade para profissionais que se identificam com o desenvolvimento backend, gostam de construir soluções escaláveis e de alta disponibilidade e buscam atuar em um ambiente colaborativo, participando da evolução de produtos digitais que impactam milhares de usuários.

Aqui, valorizamos pessoas protagonistas, colaborativas, curiosas e orientadas para resultados, que queiram crescer em um ambiente dinâmico, inovador e com forte conexão com o mercado.

Como será seu dia a dia:

  • Desenvolver e manter APIs e serviços backend em Java e Python, garantindo performance e escalabilidade para os fluxos de aquisição e checkout de assinaturas digitais;
  • Desenvolver integrações de sistemas internos e externos, incluindo gateways de pagamento e provedores de autenticação, garantindo a comunicação e o funcionamento correto entre serviços e aplicações;
  • Implementar testes automatizados e revisão de código para garantir qualidade;
  • Colaborar com frontend, QA e produto em entregas consistentes e escaláveis;
  • Aplicar boas práticas de versionamento, documentação e pipelines de CI/CD;
  • Apoiar desenvolvedores Júnior no dia a dia, compartilhando boas práticas de desenvolvimento;
  • Contribuir com sugestões de melhoria na arquitetura de microsserviços e nas soluções de backend, com foco em performance e conversão no funil de checkout.

O que o Grupo RBS espera de você:

  • Graduação completa em Ciência da Computação, Análise e Desenvolvimento de Sistemas ou cursos afins;
  • Experiência sólida em programação com Java (Spring Boot) e/ou Python (Flask);
  • Experiência com APIs REST e integração com serviços externos (ex: gateways de pagamento, provedores de autenticação);
  • Experiência prática no uso de microsserviços, incluindo deploy e integração de eventos;
  • Experiência prática no uso de ferramentas de build (Maven, Gradle) e/ou empacotamento Python (pip, Poetry, virtualenv);
  • Experiência sólida no uso de Git e versionamento de código;
  • Experiência no uso de bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais, incluindo modelagem e otimização de queries;
  • Conhecimento em computação em nuvem (preferencialmente GCP);
  • Conhecimento sobre o uso de Docker;
  • Experiência com cache e mensageria: Redis (cache e Streams/PubSub), RabbitMQ, Kafka ou Google Cloud Pub/Sub, incluindo padrões publish/subscribe e processamento assíncrono.

Será um diferencial se tiver:

  • Experiência com containers e orquestração (Docker, Kubernetes);
  • Vivência com CDN, balanceamento de carga e caching;
  • Experiência com integração com sistemas financeiros/gateways de pagamento e/ou APIs bancárias.

Informações adicionais

O prazo de inscrições para os candidatos internos é até 10/08/2026.

Job Title: In-Home Nurse Practitioner or Physician Assistant Full Time - Mason City

Job Location: Work at Home, Iowa, United States

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full time

Job Seniority Level:

We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.

Do you have a passion for engaging with people and helping them on their journey to better health? Signify Health, part of CVS Health®, is seeking a Full Time Clinician (Nurse Practitioner or Physician Assistant) to provide In-Home Health Evaluations, engaging with people in the comfort of their own homes and helping bridge gaps in care.

You’ll play a critical role in building trusted relationships to make people healthier, helping bring flexible, comprehensive and personalized health evaluations right to people’s front doors.

Job highlights

The visit, which lasts about 45 minutes, allows for time to connect one-on-one and answer health questions. It includes a medication and medical history review, a physical evaluation, and, if ordered by the person’s health plan, additional diagnostic tests (i.e., diabetic eye exams, spirometry, etc.). You’ll use an iPad and an intuitive clinical workflow for each evaluation and are not required to prescribe medicine, order lab tests or alter people’s current treatment regimen.

In this role, you will:

  • Bring your heart into every visit, joining a national network of purpose-driven clinicians dedicated to improving health outcomes

  • Be part of our efforts to visit millions of people nationwide with the goal of providing connections to the right care for people’s unique needs

  • Work with Signify Health as a clinician colleague, fulfilling the requirements of the specified role

  • Be flexible to travel locally and within licensed states, as needed

  • Conduct virtual visits as needed

  • Provide all Signify Health services as indicated including Diagnostic & Preventive Services products (i.e., spirometry, DEE, bone density screening, etc.)

​

A Note on Our Work Environment:

As an in-home clinician, your primary workplace is the private residence of health plan members. We are dedicated to meeting health plan members where they are, wherever they call home. These environments are diverse and may present a variety of conditions. Candidates must be able to comfortably and safely perform their duties in homes that may contain household pets, secondhand smoke and other potential airborne allergens or irritants.

Why Clinicians Enjoy Working with Signify Health

“I love seeing health plan members at home. You get a better picture of their health when you see where they live.” - Erica R., PA

“At Signify Health, we have the time to help people and to truly listen to their questions and concerns. We can help guide them so they can take better care of themselves. We really can make a change in communities.” - Ali B., NP

“I like how Signify Health manages my experience. I’m just doing the clinician part of my job without all the administrative responsibilities. I have the time to provide education so people have a better understanding of their health. I can answer their questions without rushing out the door.” - Andrew K., PA

Full-time employees qualify for our comprehensive benefits package, including:

  • Health, dental and vision insurance

  • Paid time off

  • Annual CEU allowance

  • 401K

  • Supplies and other perks

  • Malpractice coverage

Required & Preferred Qualifications (NPs and PAs)

  • Active, unrestricted license(s) in coverage area(s)

  • Board certification (required)

  • Multi-state licenses (preferred)

40

This pay range represents the base hourly rate or base annual full-time salary for all positions in the job grade within which this position falls. The actual base salary offer will depend on a variety of factors including experience, education, geography and other relevant factors.

Our people fuel our future. Our teams reflect the customers, patients, members and communities we serve and we are committed to fostering a workplace where every colleague feels valued and that they belong.

Great benefits for great people

Description

About Cardo Systems:

Cardo Systems is a provider of cutting-edge communication and connectivity devices and applications for powersports and outdoor enthusiasts. In 2026, Cardo is proudly unveiling its Beyond Helmet line, the first of its kind in the motorcycle industry, fostering a new age in safety, sound, and communications. After pioneering the world’s first Bluetooth-based wireless intercom headset in 2004, Cardo has been responsible for many of the industry’s innovations, revolutionizing communication, pushing technological boundaries, and enhancing user safety. Now sold in over 100 countries, Cardo is proud to be the world’s leading communication device for groups in motion.

Role Summary:

As the Country Manager ANZ, you will lead Cardo’s commercial efforts in the region. Your mission will be to drive both online and offline sales, build and execute regional sales strategies, manage local distribution networks, and ensure strong field presence. You’ll collaborate closely with marketing to ensure alignment on brand messaging, campaigns, and market engagement while representing Cardo’s premium brand in one of its key strategic markets.

Additional Key Interfaces: APAC Marketing Manager, Australia Brand Manager (in recruitment), Headquarters (Global Sales, Marketing, Product, and Operations teams)

  • Full-time remote position with travel of approx. 50%
  • Reports to: Sales Director, APAC
  • Location: Australia (Sydney/Melbourne/Brisbane)

Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop and implement comprehensive sales strategies tailored to the ANZ market.
  • Lead, manage, and expand relationships with distributors, resellers, and key retail partners.
  • Drive revenue across all sales channels – both online (e-commerce, marketplaces) and offline (dealers, retail).
  • Hire and mentor local team members
  • Monitor market trends and competitor activities; provide actionable insights to headquarters.
  • Ensure effective field presence through dealer visits, POS engagement, and events.
  • Collaborate with the APAC Marketing Manager to align on campaigns, product launches, and local activations.
  • Support and leverage the ANZ Brand Manager to build brand awareness and credibility.
  • Forecast sales, track KPIs, and report regularly to the APAC Director.
  • Coordinate closely with headquarters on pricing, inventory planning, and promotional strategies.
  • Represent Cardo Systems at local and regional trade shows and events.

Requirements

Requirements:

  • Minimum 8-10 years of sales and distribution management experience, preferably in consumer electronics, powersports, outdoor gear, or automotive sectors.
  • Proven track record in managing multi-channel sales across ANZ.
  • Experience working with marketing teams to support sell-out.
  • Strong proficiency in the regional retail and e-commerce landscape.
  • Excellent interpersonal, negotiation, and communication skills.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Willingness to travel frequently within the region.
  • Entrepreneurial mindset with a hands-on approach.
  • Experience working with multinational organizations

jobs.excerpt: About Zscaler Zscaler accelerates digital transformation to ensure our customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure.
jobs.description:
About Zscaler

Zscaler accelerates digital transformation to ensure our customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. As an AI-forward enterprise, we are constantly pushing the envelope, leveraging the world’s largest security data lake to power our cloud-native Zero Trust Exchange platform. This innovation protects our customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location.

Here, impact in your role matters more than title and trust is built on results. We say, impact over activity. We seek innovators who actively use AI to amplify their impact and who thrive in an environment where we leverage intelligent systems to stay ahead of evolving threats. We believe in transparency and value constructive, honest debate—we’re focused on getting to the best ideas, faster. We build high-performing teams that can make an impact quickly and with high quality. To do this, we are building a culture of execution centered on customer obsession, collaboration, ownership, and accountability.

We value high-impact, high-accountability with a sense of urgency where you’re enabled to do your best work and embrace your potential. If you’re driven by purpose, thrive on solving complex challenges, and want to be part of the team that’s helping to secure the AI age, we invite you to bring your talents to Zscaler and help shape the future of cybersecurity.

We are looking for a Senior Specialist Sales Engineer to join our team. This is a remote based in the UK role, reporting to the Specialist Solution Director in the Zero Trust Cloud team department. The Senior Specialist Sales Engineer serves as the primary technical lead and strategic advisor, guiding customers across the UK to secure workloads and traffic across diverse hybrid and multi-cloud environments by leveraging Zscaler’s Zero Trust Architecture to achieve key business outcomes. The role will also collaborate with field teams at the highest levels, driving internal and customer-facing enablement for Zero Trust Cloud use cases to accelerate Zscaler’s regional GTM strategy while acting as a critical link between the field and Product Management to influence the Product Roadmap.

What you’ll do (Role Expectations)

  • Serve as the technical expert for Zero Trust Architecture in Cloud environments, focusing on AWS, Azure, and GCP
  • Collaborate with sales and engineering teams to provide technical insights that influence the Product roadmap
  • Lead conversations about Zero Trust Security trends, strategies, and deployment with customers at all organizational levels
  • Run customer Proof-of-Value engagements in collaboration with Sales Engineers, demonstrating Zscaler’s unique value proposition
  • Provide competitive insights and position Zscaler solutions as the best alternative

Who You Are (Success Profile)

  • You thrive in ambiguity. You're comfortable building the path as you walk it. You thrive in a dynamic environment, seeing ambiguity not as a hindrance, but as the raw material to build something meaningful.
  • You act like an owner. Your passion for the mission fuels your bias for action. You operate with integrity because you genuinely care about the outcome. True ownership involves leveraging dynamic range: the ability to navigate seamlessly between high-level strategy and hands-on execution.
  • You are a problem-solver. You love running towards the challenges because you are laser-focused on finding the solution, knowing that solving the hard problems delivers the biggest impact.
  • You are a high-trust collaborator. You are ambitious for the team, not just yourself. You embrace our challenge culture by giving and receiving ongoing feedback—knowing that candor delivered with clarity and respect is the truest form of teamwork and the fastest way to earn trust.
  • You are a learner. You have a true growth mindset and are obsessed with your own development, actively seeking feedback to become a better partner and a stronger teammate. You love what you do and you do it with purpose.

What We’re Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)

  • Foundational understanding of AI/ML technologies and experience leveraging, securing, or positioning AI-driven solutions to optimize outcomes within your functional domain
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related technical field, or equivalent certifications/experience
  • 5+ years of experience in technical sales, systems engineering, or enterprise security architecture
  • Hands-on expertise in security, networking, and applications, with practical experience on at least one of AWS, Azure, or GCP
  • Strong presentation and communication skills to engage with diverse audiences, from practitioners to executives

What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Experience architecting security frameworks or defining access controls for AI/ML workloads and LLM data pipelines within public cloud environments
  • Familiarity with Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA) and Private Access (ZPA) or similar enterprise-grade SSE/SASE/Cloud Security solutions
  • Experience delivering cloud-based solutions within Zero Trust frameworks

At Zscaler, we are committed to building a team that reflects the communities we serve and the customers we work with. We foster an inclusive environment that values all backgrounds and perspectives, emphasizing collaboration and belonging. Join us in our mission to make doing business seamless and secure.

Our Benefits program is one of the most important ways we support our employees. Zscaler proudly offers comprehensive and inclusive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees and their families throughout their life stages, including:

  • Various health plans
  • Time off plans for vacation and sick time
  • Parental leave options
  • Retirement options
  • Education reimbursement
  • In-office perks, and more!

Learn more about Zscaler's hybrid working model and benefits here.

Responsibilities

Peraton is currently seeking skilled and qualified candidates for our Cloud Operations & Engineering Team Lead role to provide technical leadership for a team of five cloud engineers responsible for provisioning, operating, and maintaining the full breadth of infrastructure services across that estate. Peraton staff support a Cloud Business Office operating a large enterprise AWS environment — 500+ AWS accounts, along with a smaller Azure footprint — supporting a broad portfolio of enterprise workloads.

This is a team lead position, and it is a hands-on one. The person in this role sets team priorities, provides technical direction, and represents the team to stakeholders — while remaining personally in the environment doing the work. Expect roughly 50–60% hands-on engineering and operations, and 40–50% team leadership and coordination. This is not a role that directs from a distance.The lead does not carry formal supervisory authority, but does have input into hiring, interviews, and performance feedback.

This position is 100% remote, working East Coast hours. This is an operations role; support needs may arise outside standard business hours.

Day to Day Responsibilities:

  • Lead the day-to-day technical direction of the cloud engineering and operations team, including workload balancing across the account estate
  • Scope and prioritize ServiceNow requests and changes, and Jira tasks, for provisioning, modifying, troubleshooting, and decommissioning cloud services
  • Plan operational support activities — managed service patching, maintenance windows, cost optimization support — with stakeholder engagement
  • Manage the team's on-call and escalation model, including severity definitions and escalation paths
  • Identify recurring operational pain points and toil, and drive improvements to monitoring, automation, and operational process
  • Advise on and improve team processes using cloud best practices and established team standards
  • Coordinate with counterparts across the Cloud Business Office and other technical teams
  • Communicate status, issues, risks, and concerns effectively to leadership
  • Contribute to hiring, interviews, and performance feedback for the team
  • Performs incident management and troubleshooting in an operations environment including stakeholder engagement for issue resolution
  • Manages operations in cloud environments and ensure the high availability and performance of those environment
  • Serves in the on-call and escalation rotation alongside the team, and personally leads technical bridges for incidents
  • Performs root cause analysis and writes post-incident reports
  • Executes deployments using the provided Terraform modules and pipelines — running plans, applying changes, and troubleshooting failed runs and state issues across the account estate
  • Reads, troubleshoots, and maintains existing CloudFormation stacks in legacy environments
  • Provisions, configures, and operates infrastructure across a broad AWS service catalog, and grants and governs the permissions that allow application developers to work within their environments
  • Manages full EC2 instance lifecycle: provisioning, resizing, AMI selection and refresh, snapshots, and replacement
  • Provisions RDS instances and performs managed service patching and maintenance window planning
  • Owns backup and recovery for provisioned resources using enterprise AWS Backup policies, including restore requests
  • Administers AWS access management: authors IAM Identity Center permission sets and creates the group, account, and permission set assignments; manages the Entra ID groups that SCIM into AWS; maintains roles, policies, and permission boundaries at scale
  • Builds operational automation using Python/boto3 and Lambda to eliminate recurring manual toil — for example, resource inventory and reporting, and monitoring automation
  • Evaluates and operationalizes new cloud services, tools, and technologies

  • Bachelor's degree with 12+ years’ experience
  • Candidate must hold or be able to obtain Public Trust
  • Candidate must be a US Citizen
  • Five (5) years of experience in cloud technologies including Amazon Web Services (AWS) and Microsoft Azure, with an emphasis on AWS
  • Demonstrated experience operating AWS at multi-account enterprise scale (hundreds of accounts), including working knowledge of AWS Organizations structure, organizational units, and service control policies, and how landing zone constraints affect deployments and permissions
  • Demonstrated technical leadership of five (5) or more engineers — setting priorities, providing technical direction, and coordinating with stakeholders — with or without formal supervisory authority
  • Hands-on experience operating AWS infrastructure at enterprise scale — delivering consistent, repeatable configurations across a large account estate, managing resource lifecycle (patching, refresh, backup and recovery, decommissioning), and troubleshooting deployment and access failures within an established landing zone and guardrail structure
  • Experience deploying and operating infrastructure as code through CI/CD pipelines (Terraform), with working knowledge of CloudFormation sufficient to read, troubleshoot, and maintain existing stacks
  • Demonstrated experience in incident response and operational support in production enterprise environments

Preferred Qualifications

  • AWS certification at the associate or professional level
  • Experience in large enterprise AWS environments
  • Experience with Python or a similar scripting language to build and maintain operational automation
  • Experience with AWS IAM Identity Center and Entra ID integration via SCIM
  • Experience with Azure PaaS services — App Service, Azure SQL and managed data services, Storage, Key Vault, Entra ID, and Azure Monitor — in an environment without IaaS compute or self-managed databases
  • Familiarity with AWS networking at scale — Transit Gateway, VPC design, Route 53, PrivateLink, Direct Connect — sufficient to operate and troubleshoot within an established architecture
  • Experience with Splunk, CloudWatch, SolarWinds, or similar logging and monitoring toolsets
  • Experience with ServiceNow, Jira, or similar workflow management toolsets
  • Experience supporting a migration from CloudFormation to Terraform

jobs.description:
Role Description

As a Senior Fullstack Product Software Engineer on Dropbox’s Browse & Navigate Web Experience team, you will own and evolve the customer-facing web experiences and supporting systems behind Browse, Navigate, Preview, and related workflows. You will lead ambiguous, multi-phase work from technical discovery and design through rollout and operational ownership, partnering with Product, Design, Data, Infrastructure, and platform teams. You will combine full-stack execution with sound architecture, production judgment, and approved AI-assisted workflows while remaining accountable for final technical quality.

Our Engineering Career Framework is viewable by anyone outside the company and describes what’s expected for our engineers at each of our career levels. Check out our blog post on this topic and more here.

Responsibilities

  • Own multi-phase full-stack product capabilities from requirements and technical design through staged rollout, measurement, and ongoing operation.
  • Design and evolve scalable web experiences, services, APIs, and data models for Browse, Navigate, Preview, App Shell, window chrome, and shared web capabilities.
  • Make architecture and scope tradeoffs that balance customer needs, delivery constraints, reliability, performance, security, privacy, and maintainability.
  • Improve observability, testing, incident readiness, and on-call health, and lead debugging and production-risk decisions when systems fail.
  • Use approved AI and automation tools for implementation, testing, debugging, documentation, and operational workflows; validate outputs and standardize practices that preserve engineering quality.
  • Align cross-team dependencies and create leverage through reusable components and services, design and code reviews, runbooks, technical documentation, and mentoring.

Many teams at Dropbox run Services with on-call rotations, which entails being available for calls during both core and non-core business hours. If a team has an on-call rotation, all engineers on the team are expected to participate in the rotation as part of their employment. Applicants are encouraged to ask for more details of the rotations to which the applicant is applying.

Requirements

  • 9+ years of professional software engineering experience, including experience building full-stack product systems, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Experience designing, shipping, and operating large-scale, customer-facing web applications and multi-component systems.
  • Strong frontend engineering skills with TypeScript or JavaScript and modern web frameworks such as React, plus experience with at least one backend language such as Python, Go, Java, or C++.
  • Demonstrated end-to-end ownership of ambiguous, multi-phase initiatives, including adjusting scope based on customer, business, and technical constraints.
  • Experience making architecture tradeoffs across frontend systems, APIs, data models, reliability, performance, observability, and production operations.
  • Ability to learn unfamiliar systems, codebases, and approved AI or automation workflows while validating generated output for correctness, security, privacy, and maintainability.
  • Ability to communicate technical decisions clearly and align dependencies across Engineering, Product, Design, Data, Infrastructure, and platform partners.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with large-scale content, file, collaboration, or productivity systems.
  • Deep experience with React and TypeScript together with backend APIs, services, and data modeling.
  • Experience with AI-assisted product experiences, recommendation systems, or operational automation.
  • Experience leading cross-team migrations, staged rollouts, or platform integrations and improving SLOs, observability, or test strategy.

Durable Skills

AI fluency means using these tools to amplify human judgment, not replace it. We believe people with these skills will thrive as work and technologycontinue to evolve:

  • Awareness:Understand yourself and others.
  • Judgment:Evaluate information and make decisions in complex situations.
  • Adaptability:Learn, adjust, and stay effective through change.
  • Connection:Communicate, collaborate, and build trust.

To learn more about why these skills matter and what the data shows about thriving through change, read this blog postfrom our Chief People Officer, Melanie Rosenwasser.

Job Description

The Business Strategy & Execution Lead is a promotional opportunity for Senior Business Analysts who demonstrate strong consultative, analytical, and cross-functional leadership skills. This role is focused on helping business stakeholders define operational needs, assess opportunities, shape strategic initiatives, and engage effectively with Digital Services. The Business Strategy & Execution Lead serves as a day-to-day liaison between the business and Digital, evaluates business performance and operational effectiveness, and helps coordinate cross-functional efforts through completion in alignment with business priorities.

The Business Strategy & Execution Lead role requires an advanced understanding of insurance workflows, systems, and operational processes, along with strong business analysis, stakeholder coordination, problem-solving, and delivery support skills. The successful candidate will be proactive, service-oriented, and comfortable operating in ambiguous, fast-moving environments where they must earn stakeholder trust, recognize emerging business needs, and guide effective engagement between business teams and Digital Services.

The Business Strategy & Execution Lead is a member of the Surplus & Specialty Lines (SSL) Digital Services team, supporting Underwriting, Claims, and Billing & Collections business units, as well as strategic business initiatives across the organization. This role works closely with business leaders, business analysts, and key cross-functional partners including actuarial, data science, digital/IT, operations, and claims to advance divisional priorities. SSL underwrites both admitted and non-admitted business for General Liability, Automobile Liability, Workers Compensation, Property, Inland Marine, and Excess/Umbrella lines of business across multiple industry verticals, including but not limited to Contracting, Energy, Security, and Environmental.

What you will do:

Business Consulting

  • Partner with business stakeholders to understand business goals, operational priorities, financial objectives, service expectations, dependencies, and emerging needs.
  • Assess operational, financial, workflow, service, user experience, market, and performance-related challenges to identify trends, issues, imbalances, friction points, risks, opportunities for improvement, and broader business opportunities.
  • Conduct qualitative and quantitative analysis of business performance, portfolio results, workflow effectiveness, service levels, workload distribution, and stakeholder/user feedback.
  • Analyze producer, broker, segment, platform, process, book-of-business, distribution relationship, operational model, and digital capability performance to evaluate effectiveness, profitability, adoption, and overall business impact.
  • Evaluate broker, underwriter, stakeholder, and user experience to identify opportunities to improve ease of doing business, service experience, adoption, and overall satisfaction.
  • Develop clear, actionable, data-informed recommendations to improve operational efficiency, business effectiveness, user experience, service outcomes, and profitability.
  • Partner with stakeholders to define success measures, KPIs, reporting approaches, and expected business outcomes for strategic initiatives and operational improvement efforts.
  • Present findings, market insights, tradeoffs, business impacts, solution hypotheses, and recommendations in a clear and business-friendly manner to support decision-making and prioritization.
  • Monitor the impact of implemented changes and recommend additional actions or refinements based on results, feedback, and observed business outcomes.

Strategy & Planning

At Flosum, we are building the world's best software for the modern enterprise. Our team is passionate about crafting elegant, high-performance products that delight our customers and set a new bar for engineering excellence. We combine deep expertise in cloud-native development with a relentless focus on quality, speed, and innovation. Every line of code we ship is built to scale, built to last, and built to make a real difference for the businesses that rely on us.

We are a company where technologists lead, ideas win on merit, and shipping great software fast is a core value—not a slogan. If you believe world-class engineering teams are the ones that move quickly and build things right, you'll feel at home here.

About the Role

We are hiring a Director of Software Development to lead a team of 10 engineers building and scaling our Node.js and Salesforce-integrated products. This is a hands-on leadership role for a technical architect at heart who can compress delivery schedules, drive developer velocity, and own the performance of the overall solution. You will be the single point of accountability for turning our roadmap into shipped software—on time, at quality, and at scale.

What You'll Own

  • Lead, coach, and grow a team of 10 full-stack developers across Node.js services and Salesforce customizations.
  • Drive measurable improvements in developer velocity using DORA metrics: lead time, deployment frequency, change failure rate, and MTTR.
  • Compress delivery schedules by breaking epics into small, independently shippable slices and challenging inflated estimates with data.
  • Architect end-to-end solutions spanning Node.js microservices, APIs, event-driven patterns, and Salesforce (Apex, Lightning, integrations).
  • Own solution performance: latency, throughput, scalability, and cost—set SLOs and hold the team accountable to them.
  • Establish estimation, sprint, and release discipline; remove blockers; enforce accountability without burning the team out.
  • Partner with Product, QA, and Infrastructure to align roadmap, capacity, and dependencies.
  • Recruit, onboard, and performance-manage engineers; build a culture of ownership and speed.

Requirements

  • 10+ years in software engineering with 5+ years leading development teams of 8–20 engineers.
  • Deep, current hands-on experience with Node.js (Express/Nest, async patterns, performance tuning, microservices).
  • Working knowledge of the Salesforce platform—Apex, Lightning Web Components, Flows, REST/Platform Events, and Node.js↔Salesforce integration patterns.
  • Proven technical architect background: designed distributed systems, API contracts, data models, and performance-critical solutions in production.
  • Track record of schedule compression—case studies where you measurably reduced cycle time or pulled in release dates without sacrificing quality.
  • Strong estimation and planning discipline in Agile/Scrum or Kanban environments.
  • Experience driving solution performance: profiling, caching, query optimization, horizontal scaling, and observability (APM, logs, traces).

  • Excellent stakeholder communication—can negotiate scope vs. time vs. quality with executives.

Success Metrics (First 6–12 Months)

  • Improve estimate accuracy (commit vs. deliver) to within an agreed tolerance.
  • Meet or exceed performance SLOs for the Node.js + Salesforce solution stack.
  • Retain and level-up the existing team while filling any skill gaps.

Why Flosum

At Flosum, we believe great software is built by great teams—and great teams are built by leaders who care deeply about both the craft and the people. You will have the autonomy, the talent, and the mandate to build something exceptional. If you want to lead a team that is setting the standard for what world-class software looks like, we want to talk to you.

About the role

Muon seeks a Senior Optical Engineer to join our team developing infrared remote sensing instruments. You will own stray light control and analysis by defining precise requirements for optical components and surface treatments, and optimizing optical transmission via custom coatings and filter components. Because this role spans a unique intersection of specialties—rigorous stray light analysis, custom coating specification, and spectral filter development—we welcome candidates who bring deep expertise in a subset of these areas and possess the strong foundational engineering skills and appetite to grow into the others. In this role, you will drive both the analytical modeling of stray light and the hands-on R&D efforts to specify, procure, and validate complex thin-film coatings and optical filters. Previous experience in non-sequential ray tracing, thin-film design, or vendor technical management in a fast-paced environment is required.

Responsibilities

  • Perform comprehensive stray light analysis using FRED to quantify and mitigate out-of-field stray light, scatter, ghosting, and thermal self-emission across complex infrared optical assemblies.
  • Specify and analyze custom optical coatings and surface treatments to maximize transmission/reflectance and manage environmental durability for our multispectral IR instruments.
  • Serve as the primary technical liaison with specialized optical component vendors.
  • Drive R&D initiatives to advance internal capabilities in novel coating technologies, filter survivability in harsh environments (e.g., TVAC, radiation), and advanced optical materials.
  • Define test plans using metrology setups (e.g., spectrophotometry, scatterometry/BRDF measurements) to verify vendor deliverables and characterize component-level spectral and scatter performance.
  • Partner with optical and mechanical designers to iterate and optimize baffle designs, surface finishes, and optomechanical layouts based on rigorous stray light analysis.

Qualifications

  • B.S., M.S., or Ph.D. in an engineering or physics field, or equivalent experience.
  • 5+ years of experience developing optical systems, specifically focused on stray light analysis, optical coatings, and component procurement.
  • Expertise in non-sequential ray tracing and stray light analysis software (e.g., FRED, LightTools).
  • Experience with thin-film coating design and analysis software (e.g., TFCalc, Essential Macleod, OptiLayer).
  • Proven track record of defining rigorous technical specifications for optical components and actively managing external vendors from concept through hardware delivery.
  • Hands-on experience with metrology equipment used to characterize optical coatings, filters, and scatter (e.g., spectrophotometers, scatterometers, ellipsometers, interferometers).
  • Software proficiency in one or more languages (e.g., Python, MATLAB) for data analysis, automation, and processing vendor test data.
  • Ability to obtain security clearance strongly preferred.

Nice-to-have Skills

  • Experience working in cleanroom environments and handling sensitive optical components.
  • Deep understanding of infrared materials and the impacts of cryogenic temperatures on optical coatings and filter center-wavelength shifts.
  • Exposure to systems engineering, specifically requirements development and radiometric error budgeting.

Salary

The salary range for this role is $166,000 - $223,000, plus a competitive equity grant and comprehensive benefits package. Final compensation will be determined based on skills, qualifications, experience, and geographic location as assessed during the interview process.

Our revolutionary, integrated technology stack enables customers to optimize every dimension of their missions for faster time-to-orbit and superior constellation remote sensing performance. jobs.title: Senior Engineer, Offensive Security
jobs.excerpt: Become a part of our caring community We're building a new AI & Offensive Tooling capability inside our Offensive Security organization, and we're looking for a senior engineer who can both build it and use it.
jobs.description:
Become a part of our caring community

We're building a new AI & Offensive Tooling capability inside our Offensive Security organization, and we're looking for a senior engineer who can both build it and use it. As Senior Offensive Security Engineer, AI-Driven Red Team & Tooling, you'll build the AI and agentic tooling that makes our offensive operations faster and broader, then prove it where it counts, on real penetration tests, purple-team exercises, and red-team operations.
You'll also bring that same offensive lens to the enterprise's own AI systems.
It's one loop: build the tooling, prove it on live engagements, feed what you learn back into the tooling. And it's a rare chance to do that hands-on inside a program that helps protect the health data of millions of people.

What you'll do

One integrated mission, four ways it shows up:

Build agentic offensive tooling. Write production-quality software and AI agents. These agents include LLM-driven planning loops and multi-agent orchestration. Additionally, create tool and function-calling capabilities that drive real offensive tooling. Furthermore, contribute to the in-house agent platform, which powers our pentest and red-team operations. You'll operate this as a production, event-driven cloud platform at real scale (dozens of serverless functions, change-stream data pipelines, hundreds of operational alarms, integrated LLM inference), real software engineering, not proof-of-concept scripting.

Run penetration tests. Network, web-application, cloud, and infrastructure testing, recon through exploitation, privilege escalation, and lateral movement, accelerated by the tooling you build, with your own judgment owning scope and exploitability.

Run purple-team exercises. Validate security countermeasures (EDR/XDR, NDR, DLP, firewalls) with our defensive partners, then pair with detection engineering to close the gaps your attacks reveal.

Run red-team operations and test the enterprise's own AI. Objective-driven adversary emulation; and adversarial assessment of internal LLM-powered products, agents, RAG pipelines, and ML applications, prompt injection, jailbreaks, model extraction and inversion, membership inference, data and supply-chain poisoning, evasion, and agent tool/sandbox abuse, validating that guardrails and classifiers actually hold.

Your first 6–12 months

  • First 90 days: ramp on the agent platform and the offensive service lines; deliver your first engagements (a penetration test and a purple-team exercise) and ship one improvement to the agentic tooling that you used during them.
  • By 6 months: ship at least one AI-driven tool that a service line adopts into its live workflow, with metrics showing coverage or turnaround gains; run a red-team operation end to end.
  • By 12 months: stand up repeatable adversarial testing for at least one of the enterprise's own AI systems; establish an evaluation approach that tracks your tooling's autonomous success against representative targets; become a go-to for both building and operating across the team.

Why this role, and why here

  • Build and operate (both, for real). Most offensive roles let you build or operate. This one is explicitly both: you ship the software and you run the engagements, so your tooling is shaped by someone who actually uses it.
  • A program that's already serious about AI. Fridays are dedicated to R&D. You'll have Hack The Box Pro Labs, all HTB role-based paths and certifications, discretionary certification funding, and conference/training budgets. You'll work alongside the Lead of our new AI & Offensive Tooling capability—contributing to the platform they own while running your own engagements.
  • Mission that matters. Offensive Security identifies weaknesses so the business can fix them before adversaries exploit them, protecting the data and care of millions of people. AI is entering both our adversaries' tradecraft and our own operations faster than traditional tooling keeps up; you help keep us ahead.


Use your skills to make an impact

What we're looking for

We're hiring for a genuinely hybrid skill set, real offensive operations and real AI engineering. You do not need to check every box below. We expect depth in one half and real credibility plus a desire to grow in the other, not day-one mastery of both. If you're a strong offensive operator who has built real AI tooling, or a strong AI/agent builder with serious hands-on offensive experience, we want to hear from you.

Required Qualifications:

  • Offensive operations experience: 4+ years in roles such as Red Team, Penetration Testing, Purple Team / control validation, or Bug Bounty, with a track record of delivering engagements end to end: scoping, execution, and clear written findings.
  • Production Python engineering: you build and operate real tooling, not only one-off scripts.
  • You've built with agentic AI: hands-on designing, building, or operating AI agents or LLM applications: agentic workflows, tool/function-calling, and orchestration. (We care about what you've shipped and operated, not years on a particular framework—these frameworks are only a few years old.)
  • You've attacked AI: hands-on testing of AI/ML systems: prompt injection, jailbreaking, and adversarial techniques.
  • Cloud fluency: production experience with at least one major Cloud Service Provider (AWS, GCP, or Azure).

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Built autonomous or semi-autonomous offensive agents, LLM-driven penetration-testing agents, or reinforcement-learning exploit and attack-path planners.
  • Red-team tradecraft: C2 frameworks (e.g. Cobalt Strike, Sliver, Mythic), evasion and OPSEC, and testing endpoints protected by modern EDR/XDR.
  • Purple-team and adversary-emulation fluency: MITRE ATT&CK, and platforms such as VECTR or Atomic Red Team.
  • Hands-on with AI red-teaming frameworks such as PyRIT or Garak, and fluent in MITRE ATLAS, the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, and the NIST AI Risk Management Framework.
  • Model Context Protocol (MCP), building clients/servers, or testing them and RAG pipelines for tool/prompt-injection abuse.
  • Cloud penetration-testing depth or multi-cloud breadth; threat-intelligence-driven operations; depth in an advanced offensive specialty (malware development, advanced red-team operations, or adversarial ML research).
  • Published research, open-source contributions, or talks at DEF CON (incl. the AI Village / Generative Red Team), BSides, x33fcon, or Black Hat, or strong showings in AI-security competitions like HackAPrompt.
  • Certifications are a plus, not a gate, offensive (e.g. OSCP, OSEP, OSED, OSCE3, CRTO, CRTL, CPTS, CWES, CWEE, CAPE) and emerging AI-security (e.g. the OffSec AI Red Teamer (OSAI / AI-300), the SANS/GIAC AI security line, the HTB AI Red Teamer path).

How you'll work

You'll work with considerable autonomy on moderately complex engagements and influence the team's technical direction through your expertise. You'll embed with each service line and the AI & Tooling Lead rather than build in isolation; ship software with engineering rigor (reproducibility, evaluation, safety guardrails, human-in-the-loop where offensive operations demand it); deliver findings and tooling with reproduction steps, severity, business impact, and remediation; track risk in the enterprise risk platform; and operate within the organization's acceptable-use-of-AI policies and offensive security rules of engagement.

Work at Home Requirements: To ensure Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees’ ability to work effectively, the self-provided internet service of Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees must meet the following criteria: At minimum, a download speed of 25 Mbps and an upload speed of 10 Mbps is required; wireless, wired cable or DSL connection is suggested. In certain roles, the minimum recommended internet speed required by Humana may not be sufficient for business needs. Humana reserves the right to require associates to upgrade their internet service if necessary. Work from a dedicated space lacking ongoing interruptions to protect member PHI / HIPAA information.Travel: While this is a remote position, occasional travel to Humana's offices for training or meetings may be required.

Scheduled Weekly Hours

40

Pay Range

The compensation range below reflects a good faith estimate of starting base pay for full time (40 hours per week) employment at the time of posting. The pay range may be higher or lower based on geographic location and individual pay will vary based on demonstrated job related skills, knowledge, experience, education, certifications, etc.$117,600 - $161,700 per yearThis job is eligible for a bonus incentive plan. This incentive opportunity is based upon company and/or individual performance.

Humana, Inc. and its affiliated subsidiaries (collectively, “Humana”) offers competitive benefits that support whole-person well-being. Associate benefits are designed to encourage personal wellness and smart healthcare decisions for you and your family while also knowing your life extends outside of work. Through our Humana insurance services and our CenterWell healthcare services, we make it easier for the millions of people we serve to achieve their best health – delivering the care and service they need, when they need it. jobs.excerpt: Turner & Townsend are looking for an experienced Senior Cost Manager and/or Quantity Surveyor to act as the key day-to-day client interface, ensuring that client objectives are met through the delivery of a value-added cost management service across a portfolio of commercial real estate and construction projects.
jobs.description:
Turner & Townsend are looking for an experienced Senior Cost Manager and/or Quantity Surveyor to act as the key day-to-day client interface, ensuring that client objectives are met through the delivery of a value-added cost management service across a portfolio of commercial real estate and construction projects.

To be successful in this role, you must have excellent communication skills and be comfortable operating in a client-facing environment. The ideal candidate will be self-motivated, driven, and capable of working independently as well as collaboratively within a team. In this significant position, you will be responsible for providing leadership and direction while embedding and promoting the purpose, values, and vision of Turner & Townsend.


Responsibilities:

  • Estimating and negotiating change orders throughout the construction lifecycle.
  • Provide estimating, cost planning, and budget management services, including producing and presenting final cost plans.
  • Review and participate with design teams, contractors, and project stakeholders in the development and validation of cost estimates.
  • Support cost management delivery across a range of commercial real estate asset classes, including office, retail, industrial, mixed-use, multifamily, hospitality, and other development projects.
  • Reconcile changes and assist project teams to ensure cost and budget data is accurate and aligned with project objectives.
  • Communicate and meet with owners, developers, project managers, consultants, and contractors to gather project status information and prepare cost estimate updates.
  • Prepare written comments and analyses of contractor submissions, including executive summaries, budget reviews, and commercial recommendations.
  • Coordinate all sources of cost information for cost discussions, including contractor pricing, subcontractor bids, consultant estimates, market benchmarks, and quantity take-offs.
  • Inform and drive engineering and design priorities based on cost impact and project budget objectives.
  • Work proactively with minimal supervision to resolve cost and scheduling issues.
  • Manage cost checks and carry out valuations on larger projects, ensuring timely and accurate cost validation processes.
  • Participate effectively in post-contract cost management, change control, and cost variance management processes.
  • Manage cost impact assessments, contingency management, commitment tracking logs, and forecast reporting.
  • Prepare funding data presentations and coordinate value engineering (VE) sessions with key stakeholders.
  • Develop cost plans and estimates throughout the design phase, delivering updated cost plans at key project milestones.
  • Provide commercial input to design optioneering and value engineering exercises.
  • Review contractor and subcontractor pricing and lead negotiations on behalf of clients to achieve fair and competitive contract pricing.
  • Perform quantity surveying, cost controls, and change management activities throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Ensure post-contract cost variances and change control processes are managed effectively.
  • Participate in project due diligence activities, cost audits, budget reviews, draw reviews, and ongoing financial monitoring of construction projects.
  • Support the review of project budgets, cost-to-complete forecasts, contingency utilization, and funding requirements throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Ensure cost auditing and valuation work is managed effectively and that robust validation and reporting processes are in place.
  • Carry out the production of monthly cost reports, including budget performance, cost variance analysis, contingency tracking, and forecasted final costs.
  • Ensure final accounts are negotiated and agreed upon in a timely manner.
  • Compile built-cost and benchmarking records for future cost planning and market analysis.
  • Identify, coach, and mentor talent to realize their potential and celebrate the success of others.
  • Display excellence in leadership and service delivery on commissions in line with the conditions of appointment.
  • Financial Management: Utilize internal software to track ongoing margin levels, monthly fee/resource forecasts, and financial performance for each commission.
  • Implement and maintain internal Business Management Systems and company delivery methodologies to ensure consistent delivery of best practices for clients and the business.
  • Be a role model who drives a one-business culture that achieves great outcomes by striking the right balance for our people, clients, stakeholders, and society.
  • SOX control responsibilities may be part of this role and must be adhered to where applicable.
  • Bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Cost Management, Quantity Surveying, Engineering, Real Estate, or a related construction field.
  • Minimum 5-7 years of relevant experience working in a cost management, quantity surveying, or construction cost control role.
  • RICS accredited or working toward accreditation is preferred.
  • Experience leading cost management services on medium to large-scale commercial real estate and construction projects of moderate to high complexity.
  • Experience supporting owner-side project delivery, capital projects, project monitoring, construction lending support, cost verification, draw reviews, or financial oversight functions is a plus.
  • Construction consultancy experience is strongly preferred.
  • Good knowledge of construction industry technical matters, including procurement strategies, value management, value engineering, budgeting, and cost controls.
  • Strong understanding of project financial management, change management, cost forecasting, and reporting processes.
  • Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and client-facing skills.

*On-site presence and requirements may change depending on our client's needs.

The base salary range for this role is $130K-$150K USD. This range reflects the company's good faith estimate of the base salary for this position at the time of the posting.
