ABOUT THE COMPANY

Republic Services, Inc. (NYSE: RSG) is a leader in the environmental services industry. We provide customers with the most complete set of products and services, including recycling, waste, special waste, hazardous waste and field services. Our industry-leading commitments to advance circularity and support decarbonization are helping deliver on our vision to partner with customers to create a more sustainable world.


In 2025, Republic’s total company revenue was $16.6 billion, and adjusted EBITDA was $5.3 billion. We serve 13 million customers and operate more than 1,000 locations, including collection and transfer stations, recycling and polymer centers, treatment facilities, and landfills.


Although we operate across North America, the collection, recycling, treatment, or disposal of materials is a local business, and the dynamics and opportunities differ in each market we serve. By combining local operational management with standardized business practices, we drive greater operating efficiencies across the company while maintaining day-to-day operational decisions at the local level, closest to the customer.


Our customers, including small businesses, major corporations and municipalities, want a partner with the expertise and capabilities to effectively manage their multiple recycling and waste streams. They choose Republic Services because we are committed to exceeding their expectations and helping them achieve their sustainability goals. Our 42,000 team members understand that it's not just what we do that matters, but how we do it.


Our company values guide our daily actions:

  • Safe: We protect the livelihoods of our colleagues and communities.
  • Committed to Serve: We go above and beyond to exceed our customers’ expectations.
  • Environmentally Responsible: We take action to improve our environment.
  • Driven: We deliver results in the right way.
  • Human-Centered: We respect the dignity and unique potential of every person.

We are proud of our high employee engagement score of 86. We have an inclusive and diverse culture where every voice counts. In addition, our team positively impacted 5.1 million people in 2024 through the Republic Services Charitable Foundation and local community grants. These projects are designed to meet the specific needs of the communities we serve, with a focus on building sustainable neighborhoods.


STRATEGY

Republic Services’ strategy is designed to generate profitable growth. Through acquisitions and industry advancements, we safely and sustainably manage our customers’ multiple waste streams through a North American footprint of vertically integrated assets.

We focus on three areas of growth to meet the increasing needs of our customers: recycling and waste, environmental solutions and sustainability innovation.

With our integrated approach, strengthening our position in one area advances other areas of our business. For example, as we grow volume in recycling and waste, we collect additional material to bolster our circularity capabilities. And as we expand environmental solutions, we drive additional opportunities to provide these services to our existing recycling and waste customers.


Recycling and Waste

We continue to expand our recycling and waste business footprint throughout North America through organic growth and targeted acquisitions. The 13 million customers we serve and our more than 5 million pick-ups per day provide us with a distinct advantage. We aggregate materials at scale, unlocking new opportunities for advanced recycling. In addition, we are cross-selling new products and services to better meet our customers’ specific needs.


Environmental Solutions

Our comprehensive environmental solutions capabilities help customers safely manage their most technical waste streams. We are expanding both our capabilities and our geographic footprint. We see strong growth opportunities for our offerings, including PFAS remediation, an increasing customer need.

Sustainability Innovation

Republic’s recent innovations to advance circularity and decarbonization demonstrate our unique ability to leverage sustainability as a platform for growth.


The Republic Services Polymer Center is the nation’s first integrated plastics recycling facility. These innovative sites process rigid plastics from our recycling centers, producing recycled materials that promote true bottle-to-bottle circularity. We also formed Blue Polymers, a joint venture with Ravago, to develop facilities that will further process plastic material from our Polymer Centers to help meet the growing demand for sustainable packaging. We are building a network of Polymer Centers and Blue Polymer facilities across North America.


Our customers are increasingly looking for decarbonization solutions, and we are leveraging our network of landfills to meet that need. Republic is committed to harnessing landfill gas, a natural byproduct of decomposing waste, and converting it to energy. Republic has partnered with renewable gas developers to construct Renewable Natural Gas (RNG) plants at our landfills, expanding beyond the 77 projects we currently have to make progress towards our goal to beneficially reuse 50% more biogas by 2030 (2017 baseline year).

  • Barron’s 100 Most Sustainable Companies
  • CDP Discloser
  • Dow Jones Best-In-Class Indices
  • Ethisphere’s World’s Most Ethical Companies
  • Fortune World’s Most Admired Companies
  • Great Place to Work
  • Sustainability Yearbook S&P Global

jobs.description:
Find your calling at Mercy!

The Patient Service Representative (PSR) is the first point of contact for patients and visitors. The PSR ensures that the patient experience is positive and seamless by managing front desk operations and workflows.

Position Details:

Patient Service Representative

Mercy Hospital St. Louis
Location: Remote (Must live in Missouri, Oklahoma, or Arkansas)
Schedule: Full-Time, 40 Hours Weekly

Position Overview

Mercy Hospital St. Louis is seeking a compassionate, customer-focused, and detail-oriented Patient Service Representative (PSR) to join our team. As the first point of contact for patients and visitors, the Patient Service Representative plays a vital role in creating a positive and seamless patient experience.

This position supports patients and care teams across Arkansas, Oklahoma, Illinois, and Kansas while working remotely. Candidates must reside within Missouri and be available to attend occasional onsite meetings or training as required.

The PSR is responsible for managing front-end patient access functions, scheduling appointments, maintaining accurate patient records, and providing exceptional customer service while ensuring compliance with Mercy policies and confidentiality standards.

Key Responsibilities

  • Greet patients and verify patient identity in a prompt, courteous, and professional manner.
  • Manage incoming phone calls and respond to patient inquiries effectively.
  • Perform patient check-in, check-out, and appointment scheduling activities.
  • Create and maintain patient records within Epic and other electronic health record systems.
  • Process mail, scanning, RightFax documentation, copying, and other administrative tasks.
  • Maintain accurate electronic health records and ensure chart accuracy.
  • Balance and reconcile cash drawers daily according to established procedures.
  • Demonstrate working knowledge of office and clinic equipment, including computers, scanners, fax machines, copiers, calculators, and credit card processing equipment.
  • Review department communications promptly and actively participate in team meetings and process improvement initiatives.
  • Support the implementation of new Epic enhancements and workflow changes.
  • Maintain a safe, clean, and welcoming environment while following Infection Control Guidelines.
  • Adhere to Mercy safety policies and report incidents according to established procedures.
  • Protect patient confidentiality and comply with all privacy and security requirements.
  • Perform additional duties and special projects as assigned.

Minimum Qualifications

Education

  • High school diploma or equivalent required.

Skills, Knowledge & Abilities

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to interact professionally with patients, providers, and colleagues.
  • Excellent customer service skills with a patient-centered approach.
  • Proficiency with basic computer applications, data entry, and word processing.
  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy when handling patient information and documentation.
  • Ability to maintain confidentiality and comply with privacy policies and procedures.
  • Ability to adapt to changing priorities and work effectively in a fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to handle challenging situations professionally and with composure.
  • Must successfully attend and complete Clinic Core Front Desk Training following hire.

Preferred Qualifications

  • One year of medical office, healthcare, patient access, or related administrative experience.
  • Experience working with Epic or other electronic health record systems.
  • Previous experience in scheduling, registration, or patient-facing healthcare roles.

Physical Requirements

  • Ability to occasionally push, pull, and/or lift up to 50 pounds.
  • Ability to stand and walk throughout the workday as needed.
  • Ability to grip, reach, bend, kneel, twist, and squat while performing job duties.

Why Mercy?

At Mercy, we are committed to delivering compassionate care and exceptional service. As a Patient Service Representative, you will play a key role in supporting patients throughout their healthcare journey while working as part of a collaborative and mission-driven team.

This is a remote position; however, candidates must reside in Missouri and be able to participate in occasional onsite meetings, training, or departmental events as required.

Join Mercy and help create a welcoming, efficient, and positive experience for every patient we serve.

Why Mercy?

From day one, Mercy offers outstanding benefits - including medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, tuition support, and matched retirement plans for team members working 32+ hours per pay period.

Join a caring, collaborative team where your voice matters. At Mercy, you'll help shape the future of healthcare through innovation, technology, and compassion. As we grow, you'll grow with us.

Job Title: In-Home Physician Per Diem - Dodge City

We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.

Do you have a passion for engaging with people and helping them on their journey to better health? Signify Health, part of CVS Health®, is seeking a Per Diem Physician to provide In-Home Health Evaluations, engaging with people in the comfort of their own homes and helping bridge gaps in care.

You’ll play a critical role in building trusted relationships to make people healthier, helping bring flexible, comprehensive and personalized health evaluations right to people’s front doors.

Job highlights
The visit, which lasts about 45 minutes, allows for time to connect one-on-one and answer health questions. It includes a medication and medical history review, a physical evaluation, and, if ordered by the person’s health plan, additional diagnostic tests (i.e., diabetic eye exams, spirometry, etc.). You’ll use an iPad and an intuitive clinical workflow for each evaluation and are not required to prescribe medicine, order lab tests or alter people’s current treatment regimen.

In this role, you will:

  • Bring your heart into every visit, joining a national network of purpose-driven clinicians dedicated to improving health outcomes

  • Be part of our efforts to visit millions of people nationwide with the goal of providing connections to the right care for people’s unique needs

  • Work with Signify Health as a clinician colleague, fulfilling the requirements of the specified role

  • Be flexible to travel locally and within licensed states, as needed

  • Conduct virtual visits as needed

  • Provide all Signify Health services as indicated including Diagnostic & Preventive Services products (i.e., spirometry, DEE, bone density screening, etc.)

A Note on Our Work Environment:

As an in-home clinician, your primary workplace is the private residence of health plan members. We are dedicated to meeting health plan members where they are, wherever they call home. These environments are diverse and may present a variety of conditions. Candidates must be able to comfortably and safely perform their duties in homes that may contain household pets, secondhand smoke and other potential airborne allergens or irritants.

Why Clinicians Enjoy Working with Signify Health
“Many of the people I see are shocked that a physician is coming to their home to visit with them one-on-one. When you sit down and have an unhurried conversation about their health, they are impressed, happy, and understand that their health plan and care team cares about them.” - M.L., MD

“The primary care physician gets a snapshot of a person in an office setting, but with Signify Health, we see things like the number of steps to enter their home, the state of disrepair those steps may be in, and the person’s ability to function comfortably and with ease in their own home. We can make referrals to the individual’s health plan, encourage the participation of their loved ones, and ensure their PCPs are aware of their health and overall quality of life.” - C.H., MD

Per diem employees qualify for:

  • Hourly base rate, plus additional incentive structure (i.e., per visit completed, other incentives may apply)

  • Malpractice insurance coverage (during Signify Health-related activities)

  • Supplies and other perks

Required & Preferred Qualifications (MDs and DOs)

  • Active, unrestricted license(s) in coverage area(s)

  • Multi-state licenses (preferred)

12

This pay range represents the base hourly rate or base annual full-time salary for all positions in the job grade within which this position falls. The actual base salary offer will depend on a variety of factors including experience, education, geography and other relevant factors.

Our people fuel our future. Our teams reflect the customers, patients, members and communities we serve and we are committed to fostering a workplace where every colleague feels valued and that they belong.

jobs.description:
Role Purpose
The Software Integrations Developer will be the architect of connectivity within our digital ecosystem. You will design, develop, and maintain robust integration solutions that bridge the gap between disparate systems, ensuring seamless data flow and high-performance processing. By leveraging the Microsoft Azure stack, you will transform complex business requirements into scalable, automated integration workflows that drive organizational efficiency.

Key Accountabilities

  • Data Engineering & Pipeline Development: Design and implement end-to-end data pipelines (batch and streaming) using Azure Data Factory / Synapse Pipelines and Databricks.

  • ETL/ELT Development: Develop scalable ETL/ELT workflows using PySpark, SQL, and Databricks notebooks to process large-scale datasets efficiently.

  • Data Ingestion: Build and optimize data ingestion frameworks for structured and unstructured data from multiple enterprise and external sources.

  • Databricks & Lakehouse Architecture: Lead the design and implementation of Databricks-based lakehouse architecture, including Delta Lake and medallion (bronze, silver, gold) data layers.

  • Spark Optimization: Optimize Spark jobs for performance, scalability, and cost efficiency, including partitioning, caching, and cluster tuning.

  • Data Governance & Processing: Implement data versioning, incremental processing, and ensure high data quality, consistency, and governance standards.

  • Azure Data Platform: Utilize Azure services such as Data Factory, Data Lake Storage, Synapse Analytics, and Key Vault to build secure, scalable data solutions.

  • Application & Systems Integration: Design, build, and maintain integration solutions using Azure Functions, Logic Apps, and Service Bus / Event Grid to connect line-of-business applications, SaaS platforms, and external services with the data platform.

  • API Development & Management: Develop and expose secure, well-documented REST APIs and event-driven endpoints, handling publishing, versioning, throttling, and authentication through Azure API Management.

  • Event-Driven & Real-Time Messaging: Implement reliable, decoupled event-driven and near-real-time integration patterns using Event Hub, Event Grid, and Service Bus for resilient message and data exchange across systems.

  • Performance & Optimization: Monitor and continuously optimize data workflows for reliability, performance, and cost efficiency

    • DevOps & Governance: Manage code repositories, CI/CD pipelines, and deployments using Azure DevOps, ensuring high-quality documentation and best practices.

    Collaboration & Stakeholder Engagement: Work closely with business stakeholders and technical teams to translate requirements into scalable data solutions and provide technical leadership.

What Success Looks Like
Reliable and scalable Azure integration architectures with 99.9% uptime, optimized data throughput, and minimal technical debt; clear technical and API documentation; strict adherence to security governance; and seamless data flow that earns positive feedback from business stakeholders.

Candidate Profile

Experience & Capability

  • 5+ years of experience in Data Engineering / Data Platform development.

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience with Azure Databricks.

  • Strong experience with Azure Data Factory, ADLS Gen2, and Synapse Analytics.

  • Proven experience in building enterprise-scale data pipelines.

  • Hands-on experience building application and API integrations using Azure Functions, Logic Apps, and Azure API Management.

  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments and full SDLC lifecycle.

Technical Strength

  • Development: Strong proficiency in Python (PySpark), SQL, and experience working with Databricks notebooks for scalable data processing and transformation logic.

  • Data Design: Deep knowledge of ETL/ELT design patterns, including Slowly Changing Dimensions (SCD), medallion architecture (bronze, silver, gold), and data modelling for analytics.

  • Platforms & Tools: Expert-level experience with Azure Data Factory / Synapse Pipelines, Azure Data Lake Storage, and Azure Databricks including Delta Lake.

  • Integration & APIs: Hands-on experience designing integration and API solutions with Azure Functions, Logic Apps, Service Bus / Event Grid, and Azure API Management, including REST API design and secure authentication (OAuth 2.0 / managed identities).

    • Databricks Expertise: Advanced hands-on experience with Spark optimization, cluster management, job orchestration, and performance tuning in Databricks.

    Bonus Strengths: Experience with streaming technologies, Microsoft Fabric, CI/CD for data platforms, or Power BI will be considered a significant advantage.

Mindset & Behaviours
• Design-first and quality-focused mindset.
• Comfortable working in ambiguity and evolving requirements.
• Strong communicator able to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences.
• Proactive, collaborative, and continuous improvement oriented.
• Demonstrates strong sense of urgency and ownership.

Why Join

This role offers an opportunity to lead and shape the organization's modern data platform strategy, especially around Azure and Databricks adoption. You will work on high-impact data initiatives, enabling analytics, AI, and digital transformation programs across the business.

You’ll be part of an IT function that is evolving from delivery-focused to value-driven, with strong executive visibility and the opportunity to define best practices under the OneGP model. The role offers meaningful ownership, technical stretch, and the chance to work with modern Microsoft technologies, including Power Platform, Azure integrations, and emerging AI and Copilot capabilities. If you’re motivated by building things the right way, influencing how others build, and seeing your work adopted at scale, this role offers both challenge and long-term growth.

The visit, which lasts about 45 minutes, allows for time to connect one-on-one and answer health questions. As an in-home clinician, your primary workplace is the private residence of health plan members. We are dedicated to meeting health plan members where they are, wherever they call home. We can make referrals to the individual’s health plan, encourage the participation of their loved ones, and ensure their PCPs are aware of their health and overall quality of life.” - C.H., MD

jobs.description:
Connexus Credit Union - Who We Are:

Serving members across all 50 states, Connexus Credit Union is a member-focused cooperative that is proud to return profits to member-owners through high yields for checking accounts and deposit products, as well as competitive rates on our loans. We are a remote first employer with the majority of our employees residing in the upper Midwest.

As an employer we foster collaboration and high performance to achieve excellence. We holistically care for and develop our employees to thrive personally and professionally. We are proud to share our success with our employees and those we serve.

Connexus offers an Amazing Benefits package:

  • 25 days of paid time off and 10 paid holidays

  • 16 hours of paid Volunteer Time Off

  • 401K Retirement with up to 6% employer match

  • Excellent Health, Dental, Vision insurance, including multiple plan options

  • Health Savings Account with generous employer contributions

  • Employer paid Life insurance, Short-Term and Long-Term Disability

  • Tuition Reimbursement from $4,000 - $7,000 per calendar year

  • Robust Learning and Development program that includes an annual professional development stipend

About the Role:

Seeking a highly motivated Senior Internal Auditor who combines strong audit and financial institution knowledge with exceptional communication, critical thinking, and professional judgment. This individual will lead audit engagements from planning through reporting, independently assess risk and control effectiveness, provide credible challenge to management, and serve as the Auditor-in-Charge by coordinating audit activities, providing direction and feedback to team members, and helping ensure the delivery of high-quality audit work.

The ideal candidate communicates with confidence and credibility at all levels of the organization, demonstrates executive presence, and can analyze complex issues to identify root causes and practical solutions. They must be capable of translating technical findings into clear, concise, and actionable recommendations. Strong verbal and written communication skills are essential, as success in this role depends on the ability to build credibility, influence outcomes, and deliver high-quality audit work in a fast-paced environment.

Prior internal audit, banking, or financial institution experience is required, along with demonstrated critical thinking, independent judgment, professional skepticism, sound decision-making, and the ability to effectively lead and mentor peers during audit engagements.

Responsibilities:

  • Produce quality workpapers that adhere to documented standards and requirements of the Institute of Internal Auditors (IIA) with the International Professional Practices Framework which includes standards, core principles and a code of ethics. All work produced by an Sr. Internal Auditor is required to be conducted in accordance these professional standards.

  • Participate in annual risk assessment and planning activities as assigned.

  • Execute moderately complex audits in compliance with audit standards and internal procedures; maintain independence and objectivity.

  • Lead and execute moderately complex audit projects including setting audit objectives, scope and preparing audit programs, assigning work to team, oversee audit progress and deadlines.

  • Document control narratives/flowcharts and conduct audit testing to evaluate control effectiveness.

  • Review all audit workpapers to ensure completeness, accuracy, and adherence to standards and internal procedures.

  • Develop actionable recommendations to address identified control gaps.

  • Draft summary reports and leads management discussions to report adequacy of internal controls and compliance with regulatory requirements and management practices.

  • Responsible for communicating audit results, recommendations, and conclusions to management.

  • Acts as SME to other team members and organizational business partners.

  • Perform moderately complex follow up activities to determine adequacy of corrective actions taken, includes validation of regulatory issues.

  • Adhere to audit schedule and ensures completion of assignments and audits in the timeframe and hours allowed. Sets timeline expectations for individual contributors assigned to the audits they are in-charge of and hold individuals accountable for meeting those deadlines. Escalates roadblocks to lead.

  • Conduct special projects or audits at the request of management.

  • Comply with all Federal Regulations as they pertain to your job duties, including BSA.

Position Requirements:

  • This position is Remote.

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Business Management, Finance, or Accounting, or commensurate experience is Required.

  • 3+ years of combined experience working within Internal Audit and a financial organization (such as a bank or credit union) is Required.

  • Advanced skill presenting findings, conclusions, alternatives, and information clearly and concisely is Required.

  • Demonstrated critical thinking, research, problem solving and organizational skills with consistent exercise of discretion and independent judgement is Required.

  • Significant prior knowledge of internal controls concepts and practices is Required.

  • Prior experience in creating, generating, and maintaining data, reports, queries, etc. is Required.

  • Certifications are preferred: CIA, CISA, CFE, CPA, CCUIA.

  • Represent the Office of the CEO with professionalism and discretion when appropriate.

Cross-Functional Execution

  • Identify organizational bottlenecks and recommend improvements to operating rhythms, decision-making processes, and organizational effectiveness.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in a Chief of Staff, strategy, external affairs, or similar externally-facing high-execution role

About Servier

Servier in the U.S. is a Boston-based, commercial-stage biopharmaceutical company launched by Servier Group in 2018. As a privately held organization, Servier is uniquely positioned to advance cutting-edge science, tackle underserved therapeutic areas and make patients the focus of every strategic decision.

Role Summary

As a member of the Public Affairs and Policy team, the Associate Director, Government Affairs is a critical role within Corporate Affairs and Servier. This role advances Servier’s federal and state government affairs objectives through stakeholder engagement, policy intelligence, lobbying firm management, and development of targeted advocacy strategies that support access to Servier therapies in the US. This position reports to the Director, Public Affairs and Policy and works collaboratively across Servier, including regular partnership with US colleagues in Market Access, Communications, Regulatory Affairs, Legal, and other cross-functional teams. The role uses policy intelligence and political insights to assess government affairs implications and develop engagement strategies for priority federal and state issues that impact Servier’s business, industry, and patients. This position will act as a representative of Servier in government affairs settings, ensuring thoughtful engagement with key policymakers, staff, trade associations, advocacy partners, and other external stakeholders.

You are a motivated self-starter with strong political judgment, relationship management skills, and the ability to work on multiple projects simultaneously both individually and in cross-functional environments. You have strong written and oral communications skills, federal government affairs experience, and preferably biopharma or healthcare policy experience. You are comfortable translating external political, legislative, and stakeholder dynamics into clear business-relevant recommendations. You thrive in a challenging and dynamic environment that can change and improve the lives of patients.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Lead government affairs planning and execution across priority federal issues relevant to Servier’s business, policy agenda, and patient access objectives.
  • Collaborate with the Corporate Affairs team and internal cross-functional partners to guide government affairs initiatives addressing evolving federal policy, legislative, and reimbursement developments.
  • Support development of short-term and long-term impact analyses of proposed federal policies and political developments on Servier’s U.S. business and propose practical engagement strategies.

  • Develop briefing materials, leave-behinds, policy summaries, meeting preparation documents, and follow-up communications that support government affairs engagement, drawing on first-pass drafts and trackers produced by the Policy Intelligence & Operations role.
  • Clearly and strategically articulate Servier’s positions on assigned federal and state government affairs issues to policymakers and other external stakeholders under supervision of Policy leadership.
  • Support issue escalation and rapid response by identifying engagement opportunities, stakeholder sensitivities, and external signaling relevant to business decisions.

Job Description

Candidate Profile

Education and Required Skills

  • Bachelor’s degree required, in the field of public policy, public health, political science, law, or a related field; advanced degree preferred.
  • 8+ years of experience in government affairs, public policy, healthcare advocacy, legislative strategy, trade association work, or related external affairs roles.
  • Experience in biopharma, healthcare, Capitol Hill, government, advocacy organizations, consulting, or trade associations strongly preferred.
  • Consistent record in identifying political and policy trends affecting the pharmaceutical industry and public health and advancing government affairs strategies to address potential barriers.
  • Demonstrated commitment to ensuring patient access to innovative medicines and the importance of a thriving biopharmaceutical industry.
  • Experience managing external consultants or lobbying firms, including workplans, deliverables, issue prioritization, and follow-through.
  • Excellent organizational and project management skills—demonstrated ability to independently manage assigned work streams.
  • Ability to manage numerous, competing priorities under pressure while effectively collaborating with internal partners.
  • Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills, with the ability to tailor messaging for both senior leaders and external stakeholders.
  • Deep knowledge of the legislative and regulatory process, Congressional engagement, healthcare policy, and the biopharmaceutical policy environment.
  • Knowledge and understanding of drug pricing, Medicare and Medicaid coverage and reimbursement, the Inflation Reduction Act, 340B, state prescription drug affordability review board policy, and other issues affecting patient access and innovation.
  • Experience developing engagement strategies, stakeholder briefs, meeting materials, leave-behinds, and policy analyses to support advocacy goals.
  • Proven ability to analyze political, policy, and regulatory developments to assess business impact and provide strategic recommendations to leadership.
  • Possess exceptional communication skills, both oral and written, with the ability to translate complex concepts into clear, concise, and actionable insights for leaders and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated ability to work across functions, regions, and cultures while exhibiting enterprise-level leadership with the ability to inspire, motivate, and drive results.

Vistaprint Corporate Solutions (VCS) provides exciting career opportunities in a fast-moving, entrepreneurial environment that is simplifying how companies distribute brand-consistent materials. As the B2B arm of VistaPrint, we continuously test ideas and make data-driven decisions to deliver a peerless e-commerce solution for our corporate customers. Our talented team of dedicated professionals is revolutionizing the custom print industry with our innovative ProShop platform – a custom-branded storefront that empowers organizations to quickly and easily create, customize, and order any print or promotional product while maintaining brand control. Learn more about how you can contribute to our dynamic, growing company at VistaprintCorporate.com.

About the Role

During this important phase in our business growth, VCS is seeking a highly skilled and organized Business Intelligence Manager to lead a team of skilled analysts. In this role, you will serve as both a hands-on leader and strategic manager, driving critical data governance and analytics initiatives while guiding a high-performing analytics team. Advancing our journey, you will leverage automation and scalable solutions to establish and maintain a trusted single source of truth for VCS data, empowering stakeholders with the tools and insights needed to make informed decisions and reducing reliance on ad hoc reporting.

As a team leader, you will provide strategic direction and mentorship across the Sales Metrics Analysts, Business Analysts, and Product Analyst functions within VCS, ensuring alignment on priorities, data standards, reporting practices, and analytical insights that support organizational objectives and drive continuous improvement.

By providing a bridge between the sales department and other business units, such as marketing and finance, you will play a crucial role in aligning organizational goals with sales objectives. Are you characterized by a constant quest for improvement? Do you demand analytical prowess and a keen understanding of sales dynamics? This role will be stimulating and rewarding for those who are drawn to a career that melds analytical thinking with operational excellence and who thrives in roles that support and elevate both team and overall business performance.

What You Will Do

  • Architectural Leadership: Design and partner with engineering to deliver high-performance tables, dynamic views, and data pipelines, ensuring optimal query performance and scalability for Fulfillment Data Consumers.

  • Strategic Dashboarding: Develop sophisticated, "at-a-glance" visualizations in Looker that translate trends and efficiencies into actionable insights.

  • AI Integration: Leverage Snowflake Cortex to deploy LLM-powered functions or predictive forecasting directly within our data platform.

  • Domain Expertise: Analyze complex data to optimize fulfillment metrics, propose changes to our planning strategies, or help our fulfillment centers run more optimally.

  • Provide leadership oversight to ensure that—across all the programs we're working on throughout VCS and with our cross-functional stakeholders—we prioritize our work and resources effectively, measure impact, and deliver results.

  • Cross-Functional Partnership: Act as a consultant to leaders across Product Management, Sales, Finance, Systems Integrations, and others, transforming vague business questions into rigorous analytical frameworks and developing mutually beneficial working relationships.

Qualifications & Requirements

  • Experience: 7–12 years of progressive experience in data analytics or business intelligence, with a background in technical project/program management or product management.

  • Leadership: 3+ years of experience building and managing a team.

  • SQL Mastery: Expert-level proficiency in SQL.

  • Technical Stack: Experience with JIRA and Advanced Dashboarding platforms (Power BI, Tableau, or Sigma).

  • AI/ML Familiarity: Hands-on experience (or strong theoretical knowledge) with Snowflake Cortex functions (e.g., COMPLETE, EXTRACT_ANSWER, SUMMARIZE) or similar SQL-based AI tools.

  • Visionary Execution: Ability to work alongside senior leadership to set the tooling and system vision, improving operational efficiency and the overall quality of operations.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Experience collaborating with product organizations, finance, and other business functions to design, implement, or integrate technical solutions.

  • Communication: Experience communicating and translating non-technical to technical (and vice versa) requirements and discussions, as well as coordinating and running multiple organizational projects.

  • Project Management: The ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously, often with competing priorities, both as an IC and for your team.

  • Optimization & Prioritization: A keen eye for continuous optimization. You have the ability to discern the urgency and importance of work, find creative ways to use the full potential of our existing tools, and advocate for novel solutions.

  • Analytical Skills: The ability to analyze data to identify the largest strategic opportunities for the organization and use data-driven insights to provide high-impact recommendations.

Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with commercial business models and processes, including customer lifecycle management, sales and service operations, commission structures, and performance measurement.

  • Data and Analytics: Python, SQL, Quantum Metrics, and Google Analytics

  • Data Platforms: Experience with Snowflake, AWS and SAP.

  • Data Transformation: Experience using DBT for transformation.

  • Version Control: Experience using GIT.

  • BI/Dashboarding: Experience using Looker.

jobs.excerpt: AECOM is seeking a motivated and technically strong surface Senior Mining Engineer I to join our growing Mining team supporting projects across North America.
jobs.description:
AECOM is seeking a motivated and technically strong surface Senior Mining Engineer I to join our growing Mining team supporting projects across North America. The successful candidate will contribute to mining projects from early-stage studies through detailed engineering and construction support while working as part of multidisciplinary project teams.

This individual will collaborate with senior mining engineers, project managers, and engineering discipline leads to develop practical and innovative engineering solutions for mining clients. The role requires solid technical knowledge, sound engineering judgment, and the ability to manage multiple assignments while continuing to build technical expertise in mine planning and engineering.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support clients in evaluating and developing mining solutions, including mine access planning, mining method selection, mine development strategies, and supporting infrastructure.
  • Assist with open pit mine design, phase planning, and optimization to support safe and efficient resource extraction.
  • Perform waste dump design, haul road design, fleet evaluations, and equipment analysis to support mining operations.
  • Develop mine schedules and production plans under the guidance of senior mining engineers.
  • Assist with the preparation of capital and operating cost estimates to support engineering studies and project evaluations.
  • Coordinate with mining, civil, geotechnical, structural, mechanical, electrical, process, environmental, and water resources engineering teams.
  • Prepare engineering calculations, technical reports, specifications, and design packages for mining projects.
  • Participate in interdisciplinary design reviews and assist in resolving technical challenges throughout project execution.
  • Provide engineering support during field investigations, construction activities, commissioning, and operational troubleshooting as required.
  • Travel approximately 20% domestically and internationally, including occasional extended assignments.
  • Ensure engineering work complies with client requirements, applicable industry standards, and AECOM quality procedures.

Minimum Qualifications

  • BS in Mining Engineering or a related engineering discipline and 4+ years of relevant experience or demonstrated equivalency of experience and/or education.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 6 years of progressive mining engineering experience with an emphasis on surface mining.
  • Experience using mine planning software such as MineSight (MPSO), Deswik (Spatial-LHS-IS), Datamine (NPVS/Minemax), Vulcan, or similar applications.
  • Experience using Whittle or other pit optimization software.
  • Experience supporting conceptual studies, prefeasibility studies, feasibility studies, or detailed engineering projects.
  • Familiarity with open pit mine planning, production scheduling, haulage analysis, and equipment selection.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
  • Ability to work effectively in multidisciplinary engineering teams while managing multiple project assignments.
  • Engineer-in-Training (EIT) certification or progression toward Professional Engineer (PE) licensure is considered an asset.
  • No sponsorship will be offered for this role now or in the future.
  • No relocation will be offered for this role.

At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously. To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.

About AECOM

AECOM is proud to offer comprehensive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees. Depending on your employment status, AECOM benefits may include medical, dental, vision, life, AD&D, disability benefits, paid time off, leaves of absences, voluntary benefits, perks, flexible work options, well-being resources, employee assistance program, business travel insurance, service recognition awards, retirement savings plan, and employee stock purchase plan.

AECOM is the global infrastructure leader, committed to delivering a better world. As a trusted professional services firm powered by deep technical abilities, we solve our clients’ complex challenges in water, environment, energy, transportation and buildings. Our teams partner with public- and private-sector clients to create innovative, sustainable and resilient solutions throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm that had revenue of $16.1 billion in fiscal year 2025. Learn more at aecom.com.

What makes AECOM a great place to work

You will be part of a global team that champions your growth and career ambitions. Work on groundbreaking projects - both in your local community and on a global scale - that are transforming our industry and shaping the future. With cutting-edge technology and a network of experts, you’ll have the resources to make a real impact. Our award-winning training and development programs are designed to expand your technical expertise and leadership skills, helping you build the career you’ve always envisioned. Here, you’ll find a welcoming workplace built on respect, collaboration and community—where you have the freedom to grow in a world of opportunity.

As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we believe in your potential and are here to help you achieve it. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Work with Us. Change the World.

At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. Whether improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water, or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. We are the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve the world’s most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations.

There has never been a better time to be at AECOM. With accelerating infrastructure investment worldwide, our services are in great demand. We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of over 50,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world.

We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us.

jobs.description:
Responsibilities

We are looking for a Data Scientist / ML Platform Engineer to contribute across the full ML development lifecycle — from model building and experimentation to production deployment and monitoring. Core responsibilities are in applied data science and MLOps, with secondary contributions to data engineering and light platform operations. This role works within established platform patterns alongside dedicated infrastructure engineers, without requiring their involvement for routine ML and data tasks. All work is performed in a HIPAA-governed, FedRAMP-compliant healthcare analytics environment.

What you'll do:

  • Develop, train, and evaluate ML models (classification, regression, clustering, anomaly detection) and contribute to LLM-based capabilities such as RAG pipelines and prompt evaluation.

You'll join experienced professionals who are passionate about solving meaningful problems and delivering measurable customer outcomes.

Overview

  • This is a fully remote position open to candidates located in the United States or Canada. Occasional travel is required for leadership meetings, customer engagements, and company events.

Strategic Technology Leadership

  • Lead Engineering as a single accountable organization spanning application engineering, R&D, quality engineering, release management, and DevOps/Infrastructure.
  • Support the CTO in shaping the company's long-term technology vision while owning and executing the engineering strategy required to deliver that vision through disciplined execution, operational excellence, continuous improvement, and measurable business outcomes.
  • Drive modernization of our enterprise technology platform—anchored in .NET, C#, React, Oracle, DevOps, CI/CD, and modern engineering practices—to improve scalability, reliability, security, developer productivity, and delivery predictability.

AI-Enabled Engineering & Product Delivery

  • Establish engineering standards, governance, review practices, and quality controls that ensure AI-assisted development meets enterprise standards for quality, security, compliance, and maintainability.
  • Ensure AI capabilities—both customer-facing and internal—meet healthcare requirements for accuracy, auditability, privacy, security, and regulatory compliance.

Engineering Execution, Estimation & Delivery Excellence

  • Own engineering execution from concept through customer delivery, ensuring solutions are appropriately estimated, staffed, architected, developed, tested, released, and supported with first-time quality.
  • Establish industry-leading engineering estimation, capacity planning, and delivery forecasting disciplines that enable confident customer commitments, predictable execution, and measurable improvements in estimation accuracy over time.

Customer Value & Business Impact

  • Ensure engineering teams understand the customer and business outcomes their work enables.
  • Balance customer commitments, platform reliability, engineering capacity, technical debt, and long-term technology investments to maximize customer and business value.

Engineering Operations

  • Own engineering KPIs including engineering estimation accuracy, delivery predictability, engineering velocity, cycle time, defect rates, MTTR, release stability, code quality, and engineering productivity.
  • Develop executive dashboards providing transparent insight into engineering performance, forecasting accuracy, quality, productivity, and organizational health.
  • Continue advancing CI/CD, automated testing, release automation, developer experience, engineering tooling, and AI-assisted engineering workflows to improve engineering efficiency and delivery quality.
  • Champion automation wherever it creates measurable business value.
  • Build repeatable engineering processes that scale with organizational growth.

Architecture, Quality & Reliability

  • Establish high standards for software quality, maintainability, performance, security, architectural consistency, and AI-assisted software development.

Organization & Leadership

  • Partner across Product, Sales, Professional Services, Customer Success, Support, Marketing, and executive leadership to solve enterprise-wide challenges, align priorities, and ensure coordinated execution across the customer lifecycle.

jobs.description:
About Sezzle:

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

About the Role:

We are seeking a talented and motivated Privacy Manager who is best in class, with a high IQ plus a high EQ. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a rapidly growing team, with abundant prospects for career advancement.

Sezzle is building a formal, company-wide privacy program on the NIST Privacy Framework, and we are hiring the person who will build it and run it. This is a ground-floor build with the hard parts already cleared: executive sponsorship is in place, the implementation roadmap is defined, and the core program materials are drafted. Your job is to turn that foundation into an operating program, and then to own the program as it matures.

As our Privacy Manager, you will drive the implementation end to end: the enterprise data map, the privacy risk assessments, the privacy review process, the de-identification standard, and the governance rhythm that keeps it all running. This role sits at the intersection of privacy and product. The goal is not to slow the business down; it is to give every data initiative a fast, well-documented path to yes, including the data-driven products and analytics that are central to Sezzle’s strategy. You will ensure our data practices protect our users across the US and Canada while enabling our product and engineering teams to build at speed.

What You’ll Do:

  • Build the program: Drive Sezzle’s implementation of the NIST Privacy Framework from roadmap to operating program, including Current and Target Profiles, gap analysis, a prioritized and costed action plan, and ongoing monitoring, aligned with US state and federal requirements (CCPA/CPRA and other state comprehensive privacy laws, GLBA, TCPA) and Canadian privacy laws (PIPEDA and Quebec’s Law 25).
  • Run privacy review: Own privacy risk assessments and Privacy Impact Assessments (PIAs) for new products, features, and third-party vendors, and operate an intake and disposition process that gives every proposal a fast, documented answer: approved, approved with controls, or needs redesign.
  • Own the data map and consumer rights: Build and maintain the enterprise data inventory and data map in partnership with Engineering, tracking the lifecycle of consumer information, and manage the automation and fulfillment of consumer access, deletion, and opt-out requests.
  • Operationalize privacy-enhancing techniques: Administer Sezzle’s de-identification and aggregation standard and its approval workflow so that data-driven products and analytics ship with the right controls designed in from the start.
  • Embed privacy-by-design: Partner directly with Engineering, Product, and Marketing teams during early-stage development so that privacy requirements are designed in, not bolted on.
  • Govern, measure, and report: Run the cadence of Sezzle’s cross-functional privacy working group, maintain the program’s decision log and obligations register, track program metrics, and support executive and board-level reporting. Collaborate closely with the Information Security team to manage, investigate, and mitigate privacy incidents and cross-border data transfer risks.

What We Look For:

  • Proven Builder: 4+ years of dedicated experience managing data privacy programs, including at least one program or major program component (a data inventory, a consumer rights operation, a privacy review process) that you stood up from early stage to steady state rather than inherited. High-growth fintech, e-commerce, or SaaS experience operating in both the US and Canada is ideal.
  • Framework Fluency: Hands-on experience implementing a recognized privacy or security framework (NIST Privacy Framework strongly preferred; NIST CSF or ISO 27701 also relevant), including profiles or maturity assessments, gap analyses, and action plans.
  • Deep Regulatory Knowledge: Strong working knowledge of major North American privacy frameworks (CCPA/CPRA and the broader US state privacy law landscape, TCPA, GLBA, PIPEDA, Quebec Law 25) and a sharp knack for translating complex legal mandates into clear, actionable business processes.
  • Product-Enablement Mindset: You treat privacy as the path to yes. You are fluent in de-identification, aggregation, and other privacy-enhancing techniques as tools that let data products launch responsibly, and you can defend the line between what is de-identified and what is not.
  • Cross-Functional Communication: High emotional intelligence (EQ) with the ability to influence technical and non-technical stakeholders alike, run a cross-functional working group, and present clearly to executives.
  • Problem-Solving Ownership: A self-starter mindset with the ability to manage multiple high-stakes projects simultaneously in an environment where speed and agility matter.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • CIPM (privacy program management) plus CIPP/US or CIPP/C; CIPT is a plus.
  • Technical familiarity with modern privacy tech platforms (e.g., OneTrust, Securiti.ai, WireWheel) and data infrastructure analytics.
  • Experience navigating financial regulations and compliance frameworks (e.g., GLBA, PCI-DSS) alongside traditional consumer privacy laws.
  • Public-company experience, including supporting audit committee or board-level reporting.

About You:

  • You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.
  • You’re not bound by convention - your success, and much of the fun, lies in developing new ways to do things.
  • You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.
  • You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.

About this position:

We're looking for an Influencer Development Specialist to activate and grow a defined segment of creators on the Mavely platform. This is a creator-facing role at the heart of Later's creator monetization business, focused on moving creators through key activation milestones and driving measurable Commissionable GMV (CGMV) growth following every touchpoint. You'll operate within structured CRM pipelines, leveraging data, targeted outreach, and 1:1 conversations to turn leads into revenue-generating creators. You'll partner closely with Campaigns, Lifecycle, and RevOps teams to align on creator opportunities and surface insights that shape platform and product strategy. Success is defined by your ability to drive sustained CGMV growth and platform adoption across your book of business.

What you'll be doing:

Pipeline Activation & Execution

  • Manage a defined portfolio of creators within CRM pipelines, prioritizing high-impact opportunities for activation and growth, including assigned specialty segments.
  • Execute structured outreach sequences and targeted follow-ups to drive engagement, meetings booked, and platform activation.
  • Maintain strong CRM hygiene, ensuring accurate tracking of touchpoints, pipeline movement, and creator status across your book of business.
  • Identify patterns in high-performing creators and replicate successful activation strategies across your pipeline.

Creator Engagement & Growth

  • Schedule and lead 1:1 calls with creators to drive activation, educate on platform value, and share influencer monetization strategies.
  • Guide creators through key activation milestones, including link creation, brand alignment, and early revenue generation.
  • Deliver tailored, actionable recommendations that help creators increase earnings on Mavely, informed by creator demographic data and niche.
  • Build trust and maintain ongoing relationships with creators to drive sustained platform engagement and revenue growth.

Revenue Impact

  • Drive measurable CGMV growth following creator touchpoints by influencing platform usage and monetization behaviors.
  • Track and optimize performance against core KPIs, including meetings booked, activation rates, and post-touchpoint revenue lift.
  • Analyze pipeline performance and outreach effectiveness to continuously improve conversion and engagement rates.
  • Leverage data and insights to prioritize efforts and maximize impact across your portfolio.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Insights

  • Partner with Campaigns, Lifecycle, and RevOps teams to align on creator opportunities, pipeline strategy, and performance insights.
  • Surface creator feedback and behavioral trends to inform product, marketing, and lifecycle improvements.
  • Contribute to the evolution of pipeline strategies, outreach frameworks, and activation playbooks.
  • Stay informed on creator trends and platform behaviors to continuously refine activation strategies.

What success looks like:

  • Within the first 30 days, you have a clear understanding of your creator pipeline, have completed initial outreach sequences, and are booking 1:1 calls with creators across your book of business.
  • By 90 days, you are hitting core activation KPIs, including meetings booked and activation rates, and can articulate what drives high-performing creators in your segment.
  • By 6 months, your touchpoints are driving measurable, sustained CGMV growth, and you have refined your outreach approach using data and performance insights.
  • Within your first year, you are recognized as a trusted partner by creators in your portfolio and have contributed meaningfully to activation playbooks and cross-functional pipeline strategy.

What you bring:

We are committed to building an inclusive, supportive place for you to do the best and most rewarding work of your career. If you identify with any of the following, we encourage you to apply!

  • 2-4 years of experience in a client-facing, revenue-driving role such as Sales, Account Management, Customer Success, or similar.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence behavior and drive outcomes through direct communication, including calls and email outreach.
  • Experience working within a CRM (HubSpot preferred) and managing a pipeline or book of business.
  • Data-driven mindset with the ability to connect actions to revenue outcomes and optimize based on performance.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to build trust and communicate with clarity and empathy.
  • Strong understanding of social media, affiliate marketing, and the creator ecosystem.
  • Highly organized and adaptable, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and maintain consistent follow-through in a fast-paced environment.
  • Experience in the creator economy, influencer marketing, or affiliate platforms is a plus.

How you work:

  • Driven by Impact: You deliver results that matter, prioritizing high-value work, meeting deadlines, and adapting quickly while keeping outcomes clear.
  • Strategic & Customer-Centric: You anticipate risks and opportunities, connect decisions to long-term growth, and build trust through proactive insights.
  • Curious & Growth-Oriented: You seek knowledge, ask sharp questions, and apply learnings fast, challenging the status quo with a mindset of improvement.

We leverage data from trusted third-party compensation sources to help us understand the market value of a role based on function, level, geographic location, and scope. We have offices in Boston, MA; Vancouver, BC; and Vancouver, WA. For select positions, we are open to hiring fully remote candidates. We post our positions in the location(s) where we are open to having the successful candidate be located.

Their money lands where it should, when it should, with clarity and confidence.

We’re looking for a Payment Operations Lead to help build and scale the operational desks that support Mercury Bank’s payment rails. You’ll bring deep payments knowledge, strong team leadership, and a systems-minded approach to making operational work more efficient through process design, tooling, automation, and AI.

This is a high-trust role for someone who understands both the precision and pace required in payment operations. You’ll lead a team responsible for keeping money movement running smoothly across international wires, domestic wires, RTP, ACH, and checks, improving how work gets done, and building the operating rhythms, controls, and tools that help Mercury scale without losing quality.

  • Improve operational efficiency through better processes, tooling, automation, AI-enabled workflows, dashboards, and measurement systems that reduce manual effort while preserving judgment and control.

This person is the technical face of KlearNow to our customers, and the customer's advocate inside our Product and Engineering teams.

    Most of the work is proactive and consultative. The Customer Solutions Architect builds a deep understanding of how each customer actually runs their customs and trade operations, then designs and refines platform configurations that fit those workflows. They lead customer training, run technical business reviews alongside the Customer Success Manager, and advise customers on how to get more value from the platform as their volumes, lanes, and compliance requirements change.

    They own the technical understanding of the issue, reproduce and isolate root cause, translate it into terms Engineering can act on, and stay with it through resolution keeping the customer informed and confident throughout, and making sure they understand what changed and why.

    This is a high-leverage, high-visibility role for someone who is equally credible in a debugging session and in front of a customer's VP of Supply Chain/Trade Compliance.

Core Responsibilities

    Customer Advocacy and Relationship Leadership

    • Capture, structure, and prioritize customer feedback, feature requests, and friction points; maintain a clear view of what customers need and why.

    • Represent the customer in product planning discussions, backlog reviews, and roadmap conversations with data and specific examples.

    • Demonstrate value realization of KlearNow solutions through ongoing customer engagement and success planning.

    • Relay customer feedback, technical blockers, and solution gaps internally to influence product direction.

    Customer Enablement and Training

    • Design and deliver platform training for new and existing customers including onboarding sessions, role-based workshops, admin deep-dives, and refresher training after releases.

    • Develop and deliver reusable technical collateral, POVs, and hands-on engagements tailored to customer needs.

    • Advise customers on platform configuration and best practices so their setup reflects their actual operational workflows.

    • Collaborate with customers to identify net-new use cases and align the KlearNow platform with long-term strategies.

    Solutions Design and Cross-Functional Partnership

    • Partner with Customer Success Managers on account health, renewal risk tied to technical issues, and expansion opportunities that require technical validation.

    • Support Sales and Solution Consulting on technical questions for existing accounts, including scoping for expansions.

    Technical Liaison and Issue Resolution

    • Serve as the primary technical point of contact between assigned customers and internal Product and Engineering teams.

    • Lead technical discovery, solution design, and scoping to advance identified growth opportunities that lead to an increase in ARR.

    • Align technical execution with account team strategy and customer success goals, ensuring long-term platform expansion.

    • Drive escalations end to end: own the internal follow-through, set and manage customer expectations on timelines, and communicate status until closure.

    • Partner with Support on complex or repeat issues, and help define when an issue belongs in Support versus Engineering.

Required and Preferred Qualification

    • 6–10 years in a customer-facing technical role: solutions architect, solutions engineer, technical account manager, implementation engineer, or technical support engineer.

    • Demonstrated ability to own technical escalations and coordinate resolution across Support, Product, and Engineering.

    • Demonstrate ability to understand customer’s needs and provide thought leadership to influence and build trust at multiple levels.

    • Excellent written and verbal communication. Able to explain a technical problem to an engineer and a business impact to an executive in the same day.

    • Proven experience delivering training or enablement to customer audiences of varying technical skill.

    • Highly organized, self-directed, and comfortable operating with ambiguity in a role that is being defined as it is built.

    • Bachelor's degree in a technical or business field, or equivalent practical experience.

    Preferred Qualifications

    • Domain experience in customs brokerage, freight forwarding, trade compliance, or logistics technology. Familiarity with customs entries and global trade compliance.

    • Exposure to AI/ML-enabled products and how to set customer expectations around model-driven output.

    • Experience helping stand up a new function, playbook, or process from scratch.

KlearNow operates in a dynamic regulatory environment; IEEPA tariff changes, duty rate volatility, and evolving customs modernization initiatives mean our customers are under constant pressure. The best CSMs here don't just support a software product; they help customers navigate the intersection of technology and trade policy. If that sounds like the kind of work that gets you out of bed in the morning, we want to talk.

Welocalize combines AI, automation, and human expertise to support enterprises in more than 300 languages, enabling accurate, culturally aligned, and compliant multilingual content at scale.

About the Role

  • Welocalize is expanding its network of accessibility testers to validate the language-specific accessibility of localized digital content: web pages, applications, and documents.
  • You will serve as a native-language expert reviewer, confirming that accessibility elements not only survive translation but are accurate, understandable, and functional in the target language (Spanish).
  • This role requires fluency in the target language, hands-on experience with assistive technology in that language, and familiarity with Digital Accessibility standards and guidelines such as PDF/UA, WCAG 2.1 & 2.2, and EN 301 549 to complement accessibility testing done internally.
  • Work is assigned on a project basis. You will receive a defined scope, a testing checklist, and access credentials. Findings are reported in a structured defect log and specific bug tracking system.

What You Will Do

The actual scope will vary by assignment, but the general extent of this role is outlined below.

  • Language Validation: Confirm correct language codes in HTML and PDF metadata, and identify mixed-language content missing proper declarations.
  • In-Language Screen Reader Testing: Using native-language screen readers (JAWS, NVDA, VoiceOver, TalkBack, or Narrator), review translated accessible text — including hidden elements, tooltips, error messages, alt text, and UI labels — for accuracy, natural phrasing, and clarity when read aloud.
  • Multimedia Accessibility Review: Evaluate captions, transcripts, and audio descriptions for accuracy, synchronization, and natural language, and confirm multimedia controls are properly labeled in the target language.
  • Defect Reporting: Log findings with WCAG/PDF-UA references, supporting screenshots or recordings, and severity classifications; participate in review calls with the QA Lead as needed.

What We Are Looking For

Required

  • Native or near-native fluency in Spanish; you are the authoritative voice on whether translated content reads naturally and is understandable.
  • Demonstrated hands-on experience testing digital content with assistive technology/AT.
  • Working knowledge of WCAG 2.1 & 2.2 AA and EN 301 549.
  • Ability to evaluate content from a native-speaker accessibility perspective — not just technical compliance, but real-world usability for screen reader users who speak the language.
  • Reliable access to relevant devices and operating systems to replicate real-world usage in the target locale.

Nice to have

  • Strong written communication skills in English for defect reporting and general communications.
  • Experience with PDF accessibility testing using PAC 3 or Adobe Acrobat Pro Accessibility Checker.
  • Familiarity with internationalization, localization, and translation workflows; understanding of how accessibility elements can be affected during format conversion.
  • Personal use of assistive technology.

Tools and Environment

  • Welocalize provides access credentials and a structured test plan per engagement. Testers are expected to supply their own device and assistive technology setup appropriate to the target locale.
  • Commonly used tools in this role include:
    • Screen readers: JAWS, NVDA, VoiceOver (macOS/iOS), TalkBack (Android), Narrator (Windows)
    • Browser/screen reader pairings aligned to the target locale's most common usage patterns
    • Caption and transcript review: native video players, .srt/.vtt file review
    • PDF accessibility: PAC 3, Adobe Acrobat Pro (provided where required)
    • Defect logging: Jira bug tracking system is most frequently used

What to Expect

  • Assignments are project-based with clear scope documents, test checklists, and agreed turnaround timelines provided before work begins.
  • Scope for each engagement will specify the exact language, content type, pages or documents in scope, and priority areas.
  • You will not be expected to remediate or fix issues; your role is testing and reporting.
  • Welocalize values feedback: if checklist items are unclear or a finding falls outside the defined scope, flag it and we will address it.

How to Apply

  • Click on Apply Now button and share with us the following:
    • A brief introduction covering your language, screen reader experience, and accessibility background.
    • Any relevant certifications (CPACC, WAS, DHS Trusted Tester, or equivalent).

jobs.description:
Sobre a Zippi

Estamos na missão de impulsionar os 22 milhões de micro e pequenos negócios (MPEs) no Brasil com soluções financeiras que realmente atendem às suas necessidades.

Fomos pioneiros no uso do PIX como plataforma de crédito, permitindo que MPEs acessem capital de giro de forma instantânea. Com apenas um toque, nossos clientes conseguem pagar despesas do negócio e ainda contar com até 10 dias para pagar, garantindo um fluxo de caixa consistente para suas operações.

Desde o nosso lançamento, há quatro anos, alcançamos a lucratividade e vivemos um período de crescimento exponencial. Até hoje, já concedemos mais de R$ 10 bilhões em crédito para micro e pequenos negócios em todo o Brasil. Estamos escalando rapidamente para nos tornarmos a principal solução de capital de giro no mercado brasileiro de MPBs, que movimenta cerca de R$ 3,5 trilhões por ano. Assim como os cartões de crédito transformaram o consumo, a Zippi está redefinindo a forma como os pequenos negócios gerenciam seu fluxo de caixa — com acesso instantâneo, integração fluida e soluções construídas para necessidades reais do dia a dia.

Nosso sucesso é impulsionado por uma abordagem altamente automatizada e baseada em dados. Construímos uma infraestrutura tecnológica avançada, capaz de processar grandes volumes de dados de pagamentos e crédito, o que nos permite realizar a análise de risco, a liberação e a cobrança de crédito em escala, mantendo unit economics sólidos. Gerenciamos todo o ciclo de crédito internamente, alavancando ciência de dados de ponta para tomar decisões em tempo real com alto nível de precisão.

Com o apoio de investidores de alto nível, como Y Combinator e Tiger Global, formamos um time de tecnologia de calibre global focado em construir um futuro em que todo pequeno negócio no Brasil possa prosperar. Se você busca a oportunidade de gerar impacto real em uma causa que vale a pena, em uma das startups que mais crescem em mercados emergentes, atuando em uma oportunidade multibilionária — a Zippi é o lugar certo para você.

Sobre o Time

A área de Finance da Zippi já passou pela fase de construir a rotina do zero. Hoje, o gargalo não é mais absorver operação, é escalar sem crescer headcount na mesma proporção, trocando controle manual em planilha por consulta direta a dados e rotinas apoiadas em IA.

Adoção de IA já é prática do dia a dia do time (triagens, automações, agentes conectados a Notion e Slack), e buscamos alguém que opere assim por padrão.

Sua Missão

Assumir a operação financeira do dia a dia da Zippi (contas a pagar, tesouraria, aplicações, reembolsos e fechamento gerencial) com excelência e zero erro, sendo a referência da empresa para pagamento, reembolso e compras desde o primeiro dia.

Ao mesmo tempo, elevar o patamar da rotina: escrever suas próprias consultas SQL, entregar automações apoiadas em IA e migrar controles de planilha manual para dados, liberando a Controladoria para focar em análise e projetos.

Para isso, esperamos intensidade e responsabilidade: alguém que cuide do caixa da empresa como se fosse seu e trate o próprio trabalho com a importância de quem é diretamente responsável por uma parte crítica da operação.

Suas responsabilidades no dia a dia:

  • Executar contas a pagar, reembolsos e compras com excelência operacional;
  • Ser o ponto focal da empresa junto aos bancos, dominando tesouraria, aplicações e conciliação bancária;
  • Assumir o fechamento gerencial e demais atividades de Controladoria;
  • Escrever suas próprias consultas SQL para os controles recorrentes do escopo, direto no Metabase/HEX, sem depender de extração de terceiros;
  • Identificar e construir oportunidades de automação e uso de IA na própria rotina, com ganho mensurável de tempo;
  • Colaborar com Contabilidade, Fiscal, FinOps e FP&A garantindo boa experiência para todos os times internos.

Requisitos (eliminatórios):

  • SQL: já usa SQL na rotina de trabalho ou em projeto próprio (joins, agregações) para extrair, cruzar e conciliar dados, e sabe o que fazer quando o número não bate;
  • IA como ferramenta de trabalho: usa IA no dia a dia com objetivo claro, decompõe a tarefa em vez de pedir a resposta pronta, confere o output e reconhece onde a revisão humana é obrigatória;
  • Trato com dados: conciliação e batimento entre fontes distintas (extrato bancário, ERP, base de dados), leitura crítica de número, Excel/Google Sheets avançado;
  • Conhecimento em gestão bancária, aplicações financeiras e fluxo de caixa;
  • Muita intensidade, responsabilidade, organização e cumprimento rigoroso de prazos diários.

Diferenciais:

  • Python para automação e análise;
  • Experiência com ERP (MXM) e APIs bancárias;
  • Ferramentas de automação e workflow (n8n, Zapier, Pipefy, Power Automate);
  • Ter construído algo com IA além de conversa: agente, automação, rotina com MCP, script apoiado por IA;
  • Experiência prévia com automação de processos financeiros;
  • Vivência em fintech ou empresa regulada.

Por que vir para a Zippi?

  • Uma causa pela qual vale a pena lutar - Nossa missão é ajudar micro e pequenas empresas a prosperar. Seu trabalho impactará diretamente milhões de empreendedores brasileiros, ampliando o acesso financeiro em um mercado enorme e carente de soluções.
